ro31_8220.en: Ro31-8220 is a bisindolylmaleimide compound originally developed as a protein kinase C (PKC) inhibitor. Because it contains an adenosine-binding scaffold like sirtuins, it was repurposed and found to inhibit SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range.

podophyllotoxin.en: Lignan from Podophyllum peltatum that inhibits tubulin polymerization; precursor to etoposide.

aifm2.en: AIFM2 (apoptosis-inducing factor mitochondria-associated 2) is the gene that encodes FSP1; originally described as a pro-apoptotic mitochondrial protein, it was renamed ferroptosis suppressor protein 1 upon its identification as a GPX4-independent ferroptosis suppressor.

fin56.en: FIN56 is a Class III ferroptosis inducer (FIN) that activates squalene synthase, diverting mevalonate-pathway flux away from CoQ10 and depleting the FSP1 substrate, while also promoting GPX4 degradation via acetyl-CoA carboxylases.

mboat1.en: MBOAT1 is an estrogen-receptor-driven lyso-phospholipid acyltransferase suppressing ferroptosis via PE-MUFA membrane remodeling.

mboat2.en: MBOAT2 is an androgen-receptor-driven lyso-phospholipid acyltransferase suppressing ferroptosis via PE-MUFA membrane remodeling.

ribonuclease_iii.en: Family of double-stranded RNA-specific endoribonucleases, including Drosha and Dicer, that catalyze microRNA and siRNA precursor processing.

formamide.en: Simple one-carbon amide whose scaffold underlies aminoguanidine's chemical classification.

lys122.en: Lysine 122 (K122) of mitochondrial MnSOD/SOD2 — a key acetylation site deacetylated and activated by SIRT3, governing mitochondrial superoxide dismutation.

hydroxyurea.en: Hydroxyurea is a small molecule inhibitor of ribonucleotide reductase used as an antineoplastic and immunosuppressive agent.

bevacizumab.en: A humanised monoclonal antibody against VEGF-A that neutralises circulating vascular endothelial growth factor; the first antiangiogenic agent approved by the FDA (2004, colorectal cancer), used in combination with chemotherapy across a wide range of tumour types.

e_selectin.en: E-selectin (SELE, CD62E, ELAM-1) is an inducible endothelial adhesion molecule of the selectin family that mediates leukocyte tethering and rolling on inflamed endothelium; its soluble form serves as a circulating biomarker of endothelial activation.

h3k56ac.en: Acetylation of histone H3 at lysine 56 (H3K56ac) — a globular-domain mark carried on newly synthesized H3 that coordinates nucleosome assembly, DNA replication and repair, and is deacetylated by SIRT1, SIRT2, SIRT3, and SIRT6 to promote genome stability and lifespan.

momp.en: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the irreversible point-of-no-return in intrinsic apoptosis, releasing cytochrome c and Smac to activate caspases.

intestinal_stem_cell.en: Intestinal stem cells (ISCs) are LGR5+ stem cells at the base of intestinal crypts that drive epithelial renewal. They are vulnerable to mtDNA mutations and NAD+ depletion, which impair their regenerative capacity through UPRmt activation.

flow_mediated_dilation.en: Flow-mediated dilation is the standard non-invasive measurement of endothelial function, quantitating the percent widening of the brachial artery by ultrasound after reactive hyperemia from cuff occlusion; it is largely nitric-oxide mediated and independently predicts cardiovascular events.

andy_crump.en: Andy Crump is a scientist and science communicator who has worked extensively with Satoshi Ōmura and the Kitasato Institute on the history and impact of Ivermectin.

rituximab.en: Rituximab is a chimeric IgG1 monoclonal antibody against the B-cell surface antigen CD20, used as targeted therapy in B-cell lymphomas and leukemias and as a B-cell-depleting agent in autoimmune disease.

gamma_h2ax.en: γ-H2AX is the phosphorylated form of the histone variant H2AX at serine 139 (Ser139), generated by ATM, ATR, and DNA-PK kinases in response to DNA double-strand breaks. It is the canonical molecular marker for double-strand break detection and repair kinetics.

deacetylation.en: Enzymatic removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues on proteins and other molecules, principally catalyzed by NAD+-dependent sirtuin deacetylases and opposing acetyltransferases.

egf.en: Epidermal growth factor is a 53-amino-acid, 6 kDa secreted peptide of the EGF module family and the founding ligand of the EGFR/ErbB receptor tyrosine kinase system; it drives proliferation, differentiation and survival in epithelia, and its dysregulation feeds both SASP secretion and tumour growth.

incoherent_bivalent_motif.en: A minimal three-node network motif in which a drug-inhibited Target relays two opposing (incoherent) signals to a downstream Output—proposed as the universal structural basis of drug hormesis.

orp1l.en: Oxysterol-binding protein-related protein 1L (ORP1L, gene OSBPL1) is a Rab7 effector and sterol-sensing lipid transfer protein that couples cholesterol levels in late endosomes and autophagosomes to the formation of ER membrane contact sites, thereby positioning autophagosomes for lysosomal fusion.

aids.en: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome is the advanced clinical stage of untreated HIV infection, defined by severe CD4 T-cell depletion and by a set of specific opportunistic infections and malignancies; combination antiretroviral therapy prevents its development in most treated individuals.

telomerase.en: Catalytic function: Telomerase is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

5_fluorouracil.en: Fluoropyrimidine antimetabolite chemotherapy drug that inhibits thymidylate synthase and incorporates into RNA/DNA.

trail.en: TNF-related apoptosis-inducing ligand (TNFSF10); a death ligand that selectively induces apoptosis in cancer cells via DR4/DR5 and Caspase-8, with therapeutic strategies targeting recombinant ligand, agonistic antibodies, and disarming resistance mechanisms.

herpes_zoster.en: Reactivation of latent varicella zoster virus causing a painful vesicular rash (shingles); risk rises with aging and immunodeficiency.

elastic_fibers.en: Elastic fibers are insoluble extracellular matrix assemblies in which a cross-linked amorphous elastin core is ensheathed within a fibrillin-based microfibrillar scaffold; they provide reversible elastic recoil in large arteries, lung, skin and ligaments and also sequester TGF-beta growth factors.

titin.en: The largest known protein, encoded by TTN, spanning the half-thick filament of the sarcomere as a chain of 244 folded domains; it acts as a molecular spring, providing passive elasticity and serving as a mechanosensor that transmits stretch to signalling pathways.

tyrosinase.en: Tyrosinase (hTyr) is the rate-limiting copper enzyme of melanin biosynthesis; its overexpression in rodent brain recapitulates age-dependent Neuromelanin accumulation and Parkinson's Disease-like pathology, implicating enzymatic melanogenesis in pigment-driven vulnerability.

atg14l.en: A mammalian-specific subunit of the Vps34–Beclin 1 complex that directs autophagosome formation and endosome–autophagosome fusion to the phagophore.

synapse.en: A Synapse is the specialized junction between neurons where neurotransmitters released from Synaptic Vesicles cross the cleft to activate postsynaptic receptors; dopaminergic synapses of the Nigrostriatal System are central to motor control and degenerate in Parkinson's Disease.

mitochondrial_quality_control.en: The collective cellular mechanisms that maintain mitochondrial homeostasis, including mitochondrial dynamics (fission/fusion), mitophagy, mitochondrial biogenesis, and proteostasis within the organelle.

frontotemporal_dementia.en: Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative syndrome affecting frontal/temporal lobes, causing behavioral and language decline.

glutamate_dehydrogenase_gdh.en: Mitochondrial enzyme that catalyzes the reversible oxidative deamination of L-glutamate to α-ketoglutarate, coupling amino-acid catabolism to the TCA cycle and insulin secretion; inhibited by SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylation.

muscle_hypertrophy.en: The increase in skeletal muscle cross-sectional area and mass through gains in contractile protein, driven by mechanical loading and anabolic signaling.

human_growth_hormone.en: A pituitary peptide hormone that promotes somatic growth; indirectly activates mTOR and is considered a pro-aging hormone when elevated exogenously.

pyruvate.en: Three-carbon keto acid that is the end product of glycolysis and the primary mitochondrial fuel, entering mitochondria via the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) to feed the TCA cycle.

c_met.en: c-Met (MET receptor tyrosine kinase) is the receptor for Hepatocyte Growth Factor, driving cell growth, motility, and invasion.

nrti.en: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, antiretroviral drugs that also block LINE-1 and HERV retrotransposition, reducing cGAS-STING-driven inflammation and SASP in aging.

fkbp12.en: FKBP12 (FKBP1A) is a 12 kDa peptidyl-prolyl isomerase of the FKBP family whose rapamycin/FK506-binding pocket couples ligand occupancy to allosteric inhibition of the FRB domain of mTOR. It is the intracellular receptor for rapamycin and for the calcineurin inhibitors FK506 and tacrolimus.

mmp.en: Matrix Metalloproteinases; zinc-dependent endopeptidases that degrade extracellular matrix components and regulate the pericellular environment

p40phox.en: p40phox (NCF4) is the fourth cytosolic subunit of the NOX2 NADPH oxidase,

glaxosmithkline.en: GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) is a British multinational pharmaceutical company. It donates Albendazole for the global effort to eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis.

nurd_complex.en: The NuRD (Nucleosome Remodeling and Deacetylase) complex couples ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling with histone deacetylation.

lapatinib.en: Lapatinib is a reversible ATP-competitive small-molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor that targets the intracellular domains of EGFR/HER1 and HER2, used in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer.

tenovin_1_and_tenovin_6.en: Small-molecule sirtuin inhibitors that block SIRT1/SIRT2 deacetylation of p53, causing p53 hyperacetylation and activation with anticancer activity.

kynurenine.en: Kynurenine (Kyn) is a central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway produced from tryptophan, acting as an immunosuppressive signaling molecule via AhR activation and as a precursor for downstream metabolites including quinolinic acid and kynurenic acid.

brown_adipose_tissue.en: Mitochondria-rich thermogenic fat that expends energy as heat via UCP1; activated by cold exposure, a classic mitohormetic stimulus.

nigrostriatal_system.en: The Nigrostriatal System is a major dopaminergic pathway connecting the Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta to the dorsal striatum (caudate nucleus and putamen), central to motor control and selectively vulnerable in Parkinson's Disease.

fas.en: Fas (CD95/APO-1/FasR/TNFRSF6) is a TNF-superfamily death receptor that assembles the DISC with FADD and Caspase-8 to trigger extrinsic apoptosis, and whose blockade of Caspase-8 diverts signaling into RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis.

arterial_stiffening.en: Arterial stiffening is a consequence of aging and various diseases, characterized

atp_synthase.en: ATP synthase (Complex V) is the mitochondrial enzyme that catalyzes ATP synthesis from ADP and inorganic phosphate using the proton gradient generated by the electron transport chain.

dnmt3b.en: DNMT3b (DNA Methyltransferase 3 beta) is a de novo methyltransferase that works alongside DNMT3a to establish new DNA Methylation patterns.

v_atpase.en: The V-ATPase (Vacuolar-type H+-ATPase) is a multi-subunit proton

toren_finkel.en: American MD/PhD scientist and Professor of Medicine at the University of Pittsburgh; director of the Center for Metabolism and Mitochondrial Medicine; former Chief of the Cardiovascular Branch at NHLBI/NIH; leading researcher in mitochondrial biology, aging, and the mitohormesis concept

amyotrophic_lateral_sclerosis_als.en: A fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by progressive loss of

stat1.en: STAT1 is a latent cytoplasmic transcription factor and the canonical effector

il_10.en: Interleukin-10 is an anti-inflammatory cytokine that suppresses pro-inflammatory signaling and limits tissue damage during immune responses.

mdc1.en: MDC1 is a large BRCT-domain scaffold protein that binds gamma-H2AX at DNA double-strand breaks and orchestrates RNF8/RNF168-mediated ubiquitin signalling and downstream repair factor recruitment.

exosomes.en: Small extracellular vesicles (30-150 nm) that mediate intercellular communication by transferring proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids

tradd.en: TRADD (TNFR1-associated death domain protein) is an adaptor that nucleates TNF receptor 1 signaling complexes, bifurcating into caspase-8-driven apoptosis or NFκB/ MAPK-mediated survival and inflammation — a pivotal node in cancer cell fate.

vitamin_a.en: Vitamin A is the fat-soluble retinoid family — retinol, retinal, retinoic acid, and retinyl esters — required for vision, epithelial integrity, and retinoic-acid-dependent gene transcription, and a direct radical-trapping anti-ferroptotic nutrient whose provitamin A precursors are the carotenoids beta- and alpha-carotene and beta-cryptoxanthin.

ccl2.en: C-C motif chemokine ligand 2 (MCP-1), a prototypical SASP chemokine that recruits monocytes and macrophages via CCR2.

bmp_signaling_pathway.en: Bone Morphogenetic Protein (BMP) signaling is a branch of the TGF-β superfamily that regulates bone formation, embryonic patterning, neurodevelopment, and tissue homeostasis through SMAD-dependent and SMAD-independent transduction.

h2a_x.en: H2A histone variant whose Ser139-phosphorylated form (γ-H2A.X) marks DNA double-strand breaks and is required for DNA-damage-induced senescence and SASP.

matrix_metalloproteinase.en: Zinc-dependent endopeptidases (MMPs) that degrade extracellular matrix; MMP-2 and MMP-9 mediate tumor invasion, metastasis, and angiogenesis.

polymerization.en: Polymerization is a process of reacting monomer molecules together

vimentin.en: Vimentin is a type III intermediate filament protein that provides structural support to the cytoskeleton and is involved in cell integrity, motility, autophagy, vesicle trafficking, and proteostasis.

senescent_cell_anti_apoptotic_pathways.en: A network of pro-survival pathways (BCL-2 family, PI3K/Akt, p53 modulation, UPR) that let senescent cells resist apoptosis and persist, forming the molecular basis for senolysis.

glomerular_filtration_rate.en: Glomerular filtration rate (GFR) measures how much blood the kidneys filter per minute and declines with age; reduced eGFR is linked to accumulation of advanced glycation end products and cardiometabolic risk.

mitotalens.en: Mitochondria-targeted transcription activator-like effector nucleases that cleave mutant mtDNA to shift heteroplasmy toward wild-type genomes; an experimental gene-editing strategy for mitochondrial disease.

macular_degeneration.en: Macular Degeneration (especially Age-related Macular Degeneration, AMD)

tissue_plasminogen_activator.en: Serine protease that converts Plasminogen to Plasmin at fibrin surfaces,

glyco_oxidative_proteostasis_shield.en: The Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield (GOPS) is a therapeutic strategy

lithium.en: Lithium is an alkali-metal ion used as a mood stabilizer that inhibits GSK3β, modulates inositol signaling, and induces autophagy, with emerging neuroprotective and pro-longevity interest alongside a narrow therapeutic index.

geroprotectors.en: Compounds or interventions that slow aging and extend healthspan by targeting the conserved hallmarks of aging.

fasl.en: Fas ligand (CD95L/CD178); a TNF-superfamily death ligand that activates Caspase-8 via Fas receptor signaling to initiate the extrinsic apoptotic pathway and maintain immune homeostasis.

tnks2.en: Tankyrase 2 (TNKS2/PARP5B) is a poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase that PARsylates target proteins including TFEB, regulating their stability and function; it shares redundant roles with TNKS1 in telomere and Wnt signaling.

trastuzumab.en: Trastuzumab is a recombinant monoclonal antibody targeting the HER2 (ERBB2) receptor, a foundational targeted therapy for HER2-positive breast and gastric cancers that blocks HER2 signaling, promotes ADCC, and serves as a delivery vector for anticancer payloads.

aminochrome.en: Aminochrome is an intermediate product in the oxidation of Dopamine that can form neurotoxic oligomers with Alpha-synuclein or polymerize to form Neuromelanin.

spindle_assembly_checkpoint.en: The surveillance network that delays anaphase until every kinetochore is correctly attached to spindle microtubules, halting APC/C activity through the Mad2-BubR1-Bub3-Cdc20 mitotic checkpoint complex.

jak_stat_signaling.en: A cytokine-responsive signaling axis (notably JAK-STAT3) that promotes a pro-inflammatory SASP and is a target of senomorphic interventions.

immunotherapy.en: Cancer treatment harnessing the immune system via checkpoint blockade, cell therapies, and cancer vaccines.

phospholipid.en: Glycerophospholipids forming cellular membranes; their polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) content at the sn-2 position determines susceptibility to lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis.

amurensin_g.en: Amurensin G is a resveratrol tetramer (stilbenoid oligomer) from Vitis amurensis reported as a micromolar sirtuin inhibitor with anticancer activity.

phenoage.en: A second-generation epigenetic clock trained on a composite of clinical blood biomarkers to estimate biological age and all-cause mortality risk.

hur.en: HuR (ELAVL1, Hu antigen R) is a ubiquitously expressed RNA-binding protein of the ELAVL family with three RNA-recognition motifs that binds AU-rich elements in 3-prime UTRs and stabilises the bound mRNAs. It is an m6A reader that cooperates with IGF2BP1, and it couples ambient temperature to expression of heat-shock and metabolic mRNAs.

putrescine.en: The simplest of the polyamines, a 1,4-diaminobutane produced by ornithine decarboxylase and used as the aminopropyl acceptor in spermidine synthesis; it is both the rate-limiting entry point into polyamine metabolism and a substrate for N-acetyltransferase and polyamine oxidase.

bicarbonate.en: Bicarbonate (hydrogencarbonate, HCO3-) is the conjugate base of carbonic acid

adp_ribose.en: Free ADP-ribose is the monomer cleaved from PAR/MAR by hydrolases; it gates TRPM2 calcium influx and is degraded by Nudix enzymes to AMP and ribose-5-phosphate, coupling PAR turnover to Ca2+ signaling and NAD+ salvage cost.

speech_development.en: Speech development is the emergence of intelligible spoken language from babbling through first words to complex syntax, a process depending on auditory input, motor planning, myelination and — metabolically — on adequate brain creatine and energy supply.

ucp1.en: Uncoupling protein 1, the BAT-resident mitochondrial carrier that dissipates the proton gradient as heat, enabling thermogenesis and cold-induced mitohormesis.

damp.en: Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns; endogenous molecules released from damaged or stressed cells that activate innate immunity

crp.en: C-reactive protein, a calcium-dependent pentraxin and hepatically synthesized acute-phase reactant used as the standard circulating marker of systemic inflammation.

bh3_mimetics.en: BH3 mimetics are small-molecule inhibitors (e.g., ABT-737, navitoclax, venetoclax) that mimic BH3-only proteins to displace pro-apoptotic effectors from anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins, inducing Apoptosis.

ventricular_arrhythmias.en: Ventricular arrhythmias are abnormal rapid heart rhythms originating in the ventricles; resveratrol reduces them in preclinical models via antioxidant, ion-channel, and eNOS-modulating actions.

h3k9ac.en: Acetylation of histone H3 at lysine 9 (H3K9ac) — an euchromatic, transcription-permissive mark that is removed by the sirtuins SIRT1 and SIRT6 to impose gene silencing, suppress NF-κB, and facilitate DNA repair.

her2.en: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2; also known as ErbB-2

mmp_2.en: Matrix metalloproteinase-2 (gelatinase A), a zinc-dependent SASP protease and mortality-associated senescence biomarker.

adam17.en: ADAM17 (TACE) is a zinc metalloprotease and the dominant cell-surface sheddase, releasing soluble TNF-alpha, IL-6 receptor, EGFR ligands and other ectodomains; it is the target of broad-spectrum metalloproteinase inhibitors.

histone_h4.en: Histone H4 is one of the five core histone proteins that form the nucleosome,

hsf1.en: HSF1 (heat shock factor 1, HSTF1) is the mammalian stress-activated transcription factor that trimerises on heat and other proteotoxic stress, binds inverted NGAAN repeats in heat shock element promoters, and induces the chaperone network. It is held inactive by Hsp90 and is a validated cancer dependency.

hyperlipidemia.en: A metabolic disorder characterized by elevated concentrations of lipids (cholesterol and/or triglycerides) in the blood, commonly induced by chronic mTOR inhibition with rapamycin.

parp_inhibitors.en: Chemical properties: PARP inhibitors is a chemical substance with defined molecular structure, functional groups, and physicochemical properties that determine its biological activity.

oligodendrocytes.en: Oligodendrocytes are the myelinating glial cells of the central nervous system, responsible for the myelin sheath enabling saltatory conduction. They are exceptionally vulnerable to Oxidative Stress due to high iron content, low glutathione, and lipid-rich membranes.

sam.en: S-adenosylmethionine, the universal methyl donor that DNMT1 uses to transfer methyl groups to cytosine, generating 5-methylcytosine and S-adenosylhomocysteine during DNA methylation.

methylfolate.en: Methylfolate (L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active methylated folate that donates methyl groups to homocysteine remethylation and the methylation cycle.

braf.en: BRAF (B-Raf Proto-Oncogene, Serine/Threonine Kinase) is a protein kinase

kdm5c.en: KDM5C (Lysine Demethylase 5C, also called JARID1C) is an X-linked H3K4

erythropoiesis.en: Bone-marrow production of red cells from hematopoietic stem cells through erythroid progenitors and reticulocytes, ending in enucleation and organelle clearance — the process whose terminal steps define which cell-death machinery mature erythrocytes retain.

erastin.en: Erastin is the prototype ferroptosis inducer that triggers iron-dependent cell death by inhibiting the system Xc- cystine/glutamate antiporter.

hydrogen_sulfide.en: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) is a colourless, water-soluble gas and the third member of the mammalian gasotransmitter family alongside nitric oxide and carbon monoxide. It is generated by the transsulfuration enzymes CBS and CSE and acts largely by S-sulfhydrating protein cysteines to hydropersulfides.

lactobacillus.en: Lactobacillus is a genus of Gram-positive, lactic-acid-fermenting bacteria abundant in fermented foods, the vaginal tract, and the gut, where it supports barrier integrity and metabolic health.

induced_neural_stem_cells.en: Induced Neural Stem Cells (iNSCs) are neural stem cells generated directly

glucosepane.en: Glucosepane is the most abundant and chemically stable protein-protein

kdm6a.en: KDM6A (Lysine Demethylase 6A, also called UTX) is an X-linked H3K27me3

histone_methylation.en: Histone methylation adds methyl groups to lysine or arginine residues on histones, activating or repressing transcription depending on the site and degree of methylation.

histone_h2b.en: Histone H2B is one of the four canonical core histones, present as two copies per nucleosome octamer as the obligate partner of H2A; its best-known modification is K120 monoubiquitination, a co-transcriptional mark that is an obligate precursor to H3K4 and H3K79 methylation, and its C-terminal motif is a major docking site for FACT and TFIIS.

diabetic_retinopathy.en: Microvascular complication of diabetes causing damage to the retinal capillaries, leading to capillary apoptosis, neovascularization, and vision loss

wnt4.en: Wnt4 is a secreted Wnt ligand regulating β-catenin-independent and -dependent signaling in kidney, sex determination, and stem-cell quiescence.

g1_phase.en: The G1 Phase (Gap 1 phase) is the first gap phase of the Cell Cycle,

htt.en: Gene encoding huntingtin, a large scaffold protein whose CAG repeat expansion causes Huntington's disease.

hdl3.en: HDL3 is the small, dense, discoidal HDL subfraction that accepts cellular cholesterol via ABCA1 and matures into HDL2 through LCAT-driven cholesteryl ester formation.

app.en: Amyloid precursor protein, an integral membrane protein whose proteolysis

lymphocytes.en: Lymphocytes are a type of white blood cell in the vertebrate immune system.

par.en: PAR is the toxic poly(ADP-ribose) polymer death signal linking PARP1 hyperactivation to mitochondrial AIF release.

genome_stability.en: The maintenance of genetic integrity through faithful DNA replication, repair, and telomere protection, supported by sirtuin-dependent deacetylation of histones and suppression of retrotransposons.

kinase.en: Kinases are enzymes that catalyze the transfer of the gamma-phosphate of ATP to substrate hydroxyl groups (kinase activity), regulating nearly every signaling pathway. Protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site that can be exploited by kinase inhibitors repurposed against sirtuins.

single_cell_omics.en: Single-cell omics comprises technologies (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, single-cell proteomics) that resolve cellular heterogeneity in autophagy, lysosomal, and metabolic programs across tissues, development, and disease.

cenp_a.en: CENP-A is the centromere-specific histone H3 variant whose centromere targeting domain uniquely replaces H3 in centromeric nucleosomes, defining centromere identity epigenetically and licensing kinetochore assembly for chromosome segregation.

mdm2.en: MDM2 (Mouse double minute 2 homolog) is a nuclear phosphoprotein

mlst8.en: Mammalian lethal with Sec13 protein 8 (mLST8), also known as GβL, is

stat.en: Signal transducer and activator of transcription family mediating JAK-STAT signaling downstream of interferons in necroptotic inflammation.

down_syndrome.en: Trisomy 21 disorder with accelerated aging, APP overdosage, and early Alzheimer pathology.

metabolic_flexibility.en: The capacity of cells and organisms to switch between fuel sources (glucose vs fatty acids) in response to nutrient availability and energy demand

liposomes.en: Liposomes are self-assembled spherical vesicles of one or more phospholipid bilayers that encapsulate hydrophilic and hydrophobic cargo for drug delivery, improving solubility and bioavailability.

factor_xiiia.en: Factor XIIIa is the activated plasma transglutaminase of the coagulation cascade that covalently cross-links fibrin monomers into an insoluble clot, a step that fixes clot architecture and resistance to fibrinolysis.

whamm.en: WHAMM (WASP Homolog Associated with Actin, Membranes, and Microtubules) is a WASP-family nucleation-promoting factor that links Arp2/3 actin assembly to ER/Golgi and autolysosomal membranes, supporting autophagosome formation and autophagic lysosome reformation.

receptor.en: A receptor is a protein that binds a specific ligand and converts that binding into a cellular signal; receptors include GPCRs, receptor tyrosine kinases, nuclear receptors, cytokine and pattern-recognition receptors, and ligand-gated ion channels, and constitute the largest drug-target class in pharmacology.

magnolol.en: A biphenyl neolignan from Magnolia species, structural analog of honokiol, with neuroprotective, anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant activities.

mnng.en: MNNG (N-methyl-N'-nitro-N-nitrosoguanidine) is a methylating alkylating agent and the classic experimental trigger of PARP1 hyperactivation and parthanatos.

orexin.en: Hypothalamic neuropeptide (also called hypocretin) that promotes wakefulness, arousal, feeding, and reward; signals through two G-protein-coupled receptors, OX1R (HCRTR1) and OX2R (HCRTR2).

bhlh_lz_transcription_factors.en: Basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper (bHLH-LZ) transcription factors

centromere.en: The centromere is a specialized Chromosome region where Kinetochore assembles

neurogenesis.en: Neurogenesis is the process by which nervous system cells (neurons)

l_lactate.en: L-lactate is the physiological stereoisomer of lactate generated predominantly

autonomic_nervous_system.en: The involuntary branch of the peripheral nervous system (sympathetic and parasympathetic) that regulates visceral function and, via HRV, mirrors recovery capacity.

auranofin.en: Auranofin (Ridaura) is an oral gold(I) coordination compound — the triethylphosphine gold complex of tetraacetylthioglucose — FDA-approved for rheumatoid arthritis (1985) and repurposed as a first-in-class covalent inhibitor of the selenoprotein thioredoxin reductases (TXNRD1/TXNRD2), under clinical investigation as an anticancer, antiparasitic, and antibacterial agent.

cox_2.en: Catalytic function: COX-2 is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

acute_myeloid_leukemia.en: A hematologic malignancy driven by recurrent mutations such as DNMT3A R882H, with epigenetic dysregulation cooperating with other mutations to drive leukemogenesis from preleukemic clonal hematopoiesis.

eosinophil_peroxidase.en: Heme peroxidase of eosinophils that generates hypobromous acid from bromide and H2O2 during eosinophilic inflammation.

tissue_repair.en: Tissue Repair is the biological process of restoring tissue architecture and function after injury through coordinated inflammation, proliferation, extracellular matrix deposition, and remodeling, often involving stem and progenitor cells.

vta.en: The ventral tegmental area (VTA) is a midbrain nucleus located adjacent

mitochondrial_uncoupling.en: Dissipation of the proton motive force across the inner mitochondrial membrane, decoupling electron transport from ATP synthesis and releasing heat.

pi3k_akt_signaling.en: The PI3K-Akt signaling pathway is a key intracellular pathway that regulates

tak1.en: TGFβ-activated kinase 1, a MAP3K that activates p38 MAPK and mTOR signaling to promote SASP.

huwe1.en: HECT, UBA and WWE domain-containing protein 1 (HUWE1), also known as

eif5a.en: eIF5A (Eukaryotic Translation Initiation Factor 5A) is a highly

adaptive_immune_system.en: Antigen-specific immunity (T/B cells) shaped by cGAS-STING priming and chemokine-driven CNS infiltration.

endothelium_dependent_dilation.en: Flow-mediated vasodilation mediated by endothelial NO, prostacyclin and EDHF — the standard test of endothelial function, and one of the earliest measurable signs of vascular ageing and cardiovascular risk.

biological_aging.en: The functional decline of physiological systems with time, distinguishable from chronological age and measurable by multi-system aging clocks.

atg_genes.en: ATG genes encode the core autophagy machinery first identified in yeast and named Apg/Nir/Atg; the roughly 35 human ATG genes encode the ULK1, class III PI3K and ubiquitin-like conjugation systems that build, close and deliver autophagosomes.

cdna.en: Complementary DNA synthesized from an RNA template by reverse transcriptase; also used to refer to cytoplasmic DNA fragments in the context of cGAS-STING signaling

foodborne_disease.en: Foodborne disease is any illness acquired from contaminated food or drink, spanning bacterial, viral and parasitic infections plus preformed toxins, and estimated by WHO at roughly 866 million cases and 1.5 million deaths annually.

dendritic_cells.en: Professional antigen-presenting cells that activate naive T lymphocytes; their activity is enhanced by low-dose mTOR inhibition, improving vaccine and anti-tumor immunity.

erk_signaling.en: Extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK) signaling is a major MAPK

cystic_fibrosis.en: Autosomal recessive disease caused by CFTR channel dysfunction, producing thick airway mucus, chronic Pseudomonas infection, pancreatic insufficiency and progressive bronchiectasis, and now treatable with CFTR modulators.

geraldol.en: A 3'-O-methylated flavonoid and COMT-generated metabolite of fisetin with uncharacterized senolytic and antioxidant pharmacology.

tnfr1.en: TNFR1 (Tumor Necrosis Factor Receptor 1), also known as DR1, is

cadpr.en: Cyclic ADP-ribose (cADPR) is a novel cyclic nucleotide second messenger

terminal_differentiation.en: Terminal Differentiation is the irreversible process by which a cell exits the cell cycle and acquires a stable, specialized functional identity.

cervical_cancer.en: Cervical cancer is a cancer arising from the cervix. It is due to

oscp.en: OSCP (Oligomycin Sensitivity Conferral Protein, encoded by ATP5PO) is a peripheral stalk subunit of mitochondrial F1Fo-ATP synthase (Complex V). It connects the catalytic F1 head to the membrane-embedded Fo rotor and confers sensitivity to the inhibitor oligomycin.

erralpha.en: ERRα (estrogen-related receptor alpha, encoded by ESRRA) is an orphan

liposome_encapsulation.en: A drug-delivery strategy that entraps therapeutic or diagnostic agents within phospholipid bilayer vesicles (liposomes) to improve solubility, stability, targeting, and pharmacokinetics.

cdkn1a.en: CDKN1A (p21) is a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor and key downstream effector of p53, mediating cell cycle arrest and senescence.

biomarkers.en: In the field of Geroscience, biomarkers are essential tools for measuring

platelet_aggregation.en: The process by which activated platelets adhere to one another to form a hemostatic plug or pathological thrombus.

lipid_synthesis.en: Definition: Lipid Synthesis is a fundamental biological process that maintains cellular and organismal homeostasis. It involves coordinated molecular events regulated by signaling pathways and ...

ck1.en: CK1 (Casein kinase 1) is a conserved serine/threonine kinase family that phosphorylates the BH3-only protein Bid to inhibit its cleavage by Caspase-8, dampening mitochondrial apoptotic amplification.

apoe4.en: Apolipoprotein E epsilon 4 allele, the major genetic risk factor for Alzheimer's disease that amplifies cGAS-STING/IFN-I microglial signaling.

cd47.en: CD47 is a ubiquitously expressed immunoglobulin-superfamily receptor that

uprmt.en: The mitochondrial unfolded protein response is a retrograde stress pathway that restores mitochondrial proteostasis and mediates mitohormetic lifespan extension.

system_xc.en: System Xc- is a cystine/glutamate antiporter at the plasma membrane whose activity is required for glutathione synthesis and ferroptosis resistance.

mda5.en: MDA5 (IFIH1) is a cytosolic RIG-I-like receptor that senses long double-stranded RNA and signals through MAVS to IRF3/IRF7-dependent type I interferon production.

indole_3_propionic_acid.en: Gut microbiota-derived tryptophan metabolite with potent antioxidant,

irf3.en: Interferon regulatory factor 3 is a transcription factor that mediates type I interferon and SASP production.

ecm.en: The Extracellular Matrix (ECM) is a complex network of extracellular

extracellular_vesicles.en: Membrane-bound particles that package cGAMP and mtDNA to propagate cGAS-STING activation between CNS cells.

pulmonary_fibrosis.en: A chronic, progressive lung disease characterized by scarring (fibrosis) of lung tissue

cdk9.en: Cyclin-dependent kinase 9, the catalytic subunit of P-TEFb that phosphorylates RNA polymerase II CTD Ser2 and releases promoter-proximal pausing, and a transcriptional vulnerability in cancer.

pd_l1.en: Programmed death-ligand 1 (CD274/B7-H1); a transmembrane protein that inhibits T-cell function by binding PD-1, serving as a key immune checkpoint in cancer and a target modulated by SASP signaling in the senescent tumor microenvironment.

lamp2.en: LAMP2 is a heavily glycosylated lysosomal membrane glycoprotein with three

locus_coeruleus.en: The Locus Coeruleus (LC) is a nucleus in the pons of the brainstem involved with physiological responses to stress and panic. It is the principal site for the synthesis of norepinephrine in the brain.

lipotoxicity.en: Lipotoxicity is the tissue damage caused by accumulation of lipid intermediates (especially saturated fatty acids and ceramides) in non-adipose tissues, driving insulin resistance, ER stress, and inflammation.

myelin.en: Myelin is a multilamellar lipid-protein sheath that wraps around

peroxisome.en: Peroxisomes are small, membrane-bound organelles found in nearly all

vkorc1.en: VKORC1 is the 163-residue endoplasmic-reticulum membrane oxidoreductase that recycles vitamin K epoxide back to vitamin K hydroquinone, sustaining gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors, and is the pharmacological target of warfarin.

bim.en: Bim (Bcl-2-like protein 11) is a potent pro-apoptotic BH3-only member

hiv.en: Etiology and pathophysiology: HIV is a medical condition characterized by specific pathological changes in cellular, tissue, or organ function. Its development involves genetic, environmental, ...

jeanho_yun.en: South Korean biochemist at Dong-A University; co-author of the seminal 2014 "Mitohormesis" Cell Metabolism paper with Toren Finkel

heteroplasmy.en: The coexistence of wild-type and mutant mitochondrial DNA molecules within a single cell, tissue, or individual; the fraction of mutant genomes determines disease penetrance and is the target of mtDNA-editing therapies.

rab5.en: Rab5 is a small GTPase that acts as the master regulator of early endosome fusion, motility, and maturation, handing off to Rab7 and intersecting with autophagic membrane traffic.

complex_iv.en: Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) is the terminal enzyme of the

ischemic_stroke.en: Ischemic stroke is acute brain injury from arterial occlusion and hypoxia-ischemia; methylene blue has investigational neuroprotective relevance.

isobutyl_nitrite.en: Isobutyl nitrite is an alkyl nitrite inhalant ("popper") and potent oxidizing agent that induces methemoglobinemia by oxidizing hemoglobin iron.

retinoic_acid.en: Active metabolite of vitamin A and potent differentiation inducer used to drive embryonic stem cell lineage commitment.

raf.en: RAF kinases (ARAF, BRAF, CRAF) are central to the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK MAPK cascade; RAF/MEK-dependent oxidative cell death connects to ferroptosis upstream pathways.

trna.en: Transfer RNA (tRNA) adapters decode mRNA codons into amino acids during translation; the specialized tRNA[Ser]Sec carries selenocysteine and, with its Um34 modification, enables UGA recoding.

foxo_transcription_factors.en: Forkhead box O (FOXO) transcription factors are a family of proteins that regulate genes involved in cell growth, metabolism, and Apoptosis (e.g., Bim and Puma).

cortisol.en: The primary glucocorticoid stress hormone released by the adrenal cortex that mobilizes energy and, when chronically elevated, suppresses HRV and recovery.

sarcoptes_scabiei.en: The parasitic mite that causes scabies in humans and animals; the burrowing female lives in the stratum corneum, provoking intense pruritus and a type I hypersensitivity reaction to mite faeces and saliva.

prostaglandins.en: Prostaglandins are lipid-derived autacoids produced from arachidonic acid via cyclooxygenase and terminal synthases; local mediators of inflammation, pain, fever, vascular tone, and platelet function.

lipid_nanoparticles.en: Lipid nanoparticles are self-assembling nanoscale lipid assemblies that encapsulate nucleic acids and proteins, using ionizable lipids to enable endosomal escape and cytosolic delivery of mRNA.

bid.en: Pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein of the Bcl-2 family that links extrinsic death receptor signaling to the intrinsic mitochondrial apoptotic pathway via tBid-mediated activation of Bax and Bak.

rgd_peptide.en: The RGD tripeptide motif (Arg-Gly-Asp) is the canonical cell-adhesion sequence recognized by integrins in the extracellular matrix; RGD-based peptides and mimetics are used to block adhesion, angiogenesis, and tumor metastasis.

lps.en: Lipopolysaccharide, a major component of the outer membrane of Gram-negative

ciliary_neurotrophic_factor_receptor.en: The ciliary neurotrophic factor receptor is a heterotrimeric cell-surface

cetuximab.en: Cetuximab is a chimeric monoclonal antibody against EGFR used in metastatic

vitamin_b12.en: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) is a water-soluble vitamin essential for

compound_c.en: Compound C (also known as Dorsomorphin or BML-275) is a potent, selective,

diethylcarbamazine.en: Diethylcarbamazine (DEC) is a piperazine-derived antifilarial drug that also exhibits anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and emerging anticancer activities, including suppression of tumor-promoting inflammation and lymphangiogenesis.

ikappab.en: IκB (inhibitor of NF-κB) proteins are a family of cytoplasmic inhibitors

nucleosome.en: The Nucleosome is the fundamental structural unit of Chromatin. It

caspase_6.en: Caspase-6 is an executioner caspase activated in the terminal phase of apoptosis, best known for cleaving nuclear lamin A to drive nuclear disassembly and chromatin condensation.

skp2.en: F-box component of the SCF ubiquitin ligase that binds phosphorylated CDK inhibitors p27 and p21, represses the FoxO transcription factors and p53, and thereby promotes cell-cycle progression and senescence bypass.

fadd.en: FADD (Fas-associated via death domain) is a critical adaptor protein

mef.en: Mouse embryonic fibroblasts, primary cells isolated from mouse embryos and widely used in cell biology and senescence studies.

cell_cycle_arrest.en: A regulated halting of cell cycle progression at the G1 or G2/M phase, induced by CDK inhibition and Rb hypophosphorylation through both p53-dependent and p53-independent pathways, and exploited by anticancer agents such as apigenin.

gemcitabine.en: Gemcitabine is a nucleoside analog used as a chemotherapy agent that induces DNA replication stress and apoptosis by inhibiting DNA synthesis and ribonucleotide reductase.

xist.en: A long non-coding RNA that drives X-chromosome inactivation by coating the inactive X chromosome and recruiting chromatin-modifying enzymes that establish repressive marks.

type_2_diabetes.en: Chronic metabolic disorder characterized by insulin resistance and progressive pancreatic beta-cell dysfunction, driving hyperglycemia and multiorgan complications.

ikappabalpha.en: IκBα (encoded by NFKBIA) is the prototypical member of the IkappaB family of NFκB inhibitors. It is the primary negative regulator of the canonical NFκB signaling pathway, controlling the activation kinetics and duration of inflammatory and immune responses.

calreticulin.en: Calreticulin (CRT, CALR) is an ER calcium-binding chaperone with three domains that also functions as a cell-surface 'eat-me' signal driving phagocytic clearance, a plasminogen receptor on the tumor surface, and a regulator of both MeCP2 and NRF2 activity.

ca2.en: Ca2+ (calcium ion) is a ubiquitous intracellular second messenger that

epigenetic_remodeling.en: Epigenetic Remodeling is the dynamic reorganization of chromatin and nuclear architecture—via DNA methylation, histone modification, and nucleosome repositioning—to alter gene expression without changing the DNA sequence, central to development, reprogramming, and aging.

pyruvate_dehydrogenase.en: Mitochondrial enzyme complex that converts pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, the committed step feeding the TCA cycle. Its activity gates glucose-derived carbon entry into the mitochondrial citrate–acetyl-CoA axis.

pik3ca.en: PIK3CA encodes the p110alpha catalytic subunit of class I PI3K, the most frequently mutated oncogene in breast cancer, where gain-of-function hotspot variants in exons 9 and 20 constitutively activate the PI3K-AKT-mTOR axis.

paracrine_reprogramming.en: Paracrine reprogramming is the process by which SASP factors secreted by

h4k16ac.en: Acetylation of histone H4 at lysine 16, an active chromatin mark deposited by KAT8/MOF and read by bromodomain proteins; it blocks nucleosome stacking, marks active promoters and is the substrate SIRT2 and HDAC modules remove to permit mitotic chromosome condensation.

frailty.en: A clinical syndrome of decreased reserve and vulnerability in older adults, linked to chronic inflammation and inflammaging.

protein_kinase_a.en: Kinase that phosphorylates DRP1 at Ser637 to inhibit mitochondrial fission.

coronary_artery_constriction.en: Coronary artery constriction refers to the pathological narrowing of the coronary arteries that supply oxygenated blood to the heart muscle, reducing myocardial blood flow and precipitating ischemia.

tascc.en: TOR-autophagy spatial coupling compartment, an mTORC1-autophagy signaling hub in senescent cells that couples amino-acid recycling to sustained SASP translation.

histone_h2a.en: Histone H2A is one of the four canonical core histones, present as two copies per nucleosome octamer; it supplies the acidic patch on the nucleosome surface that most bromodomain and PHD finger readers bind, carries modification sites including H2AK119ub, and is the base protein from which H2A.Z, H2A.X, H2A.J and macroH2A variants are derived.

adp_ribosylation.en: ADP-ribosylation is a reversible post-translational modification in which

scramblase.en: Calcium-activated phospholipid scramblases (TMEM16F/ANO6, PLSCR family) that externalize phosphatidylserine — the eat-me signal executed in eryptosis and apoptosis.

heart_disease.en: Heart disease refers to various conditions that affect the heart, including

anticancer.en: Anticancer therapy denotes systemic treatment of malignancy with cytotoxic, targeted, hormonal, or immunologic agents; the modern pharmacopea spans alkylators, antimetabolites, anti-microtubules, kinase inhibitors, antibody-drug conjugates, and checkpoint blockade.

fibrinolysis.en: The physiological and pharmacological breakdown of fibrin clots by plasmin, controlled by the balance between tissue-type and urokinase-type plasminogen activators and their inhibitor PAI-1; the counterpart of coagulation and the target of thrombolytic therapy.

tyrosine_kinase.en: Enzymes that transfer a phosphate group from ATP onto tyrosine residues of substrate proteins, functioning as binary on/off switches in signalling; the group is split into receptor tyrosine kinases and non-receptor cytosolic kinases and constitutes the largest single drug target class in oncology.

rapalogs.en: Rapalogs are analogs and derivatives of rapamycin (sirolimus) that inhibit mTORC1 via the FKBP12-FRB interface; used as immunosuppressants, anticancer agents, and geroprotectors, and like rapamycin can exhibit hormetic dose responses.

rna_polymerase_i.en: RNA Polymerase I (Pol I) is the eukaryotic enzyme responsible for transcribing ribosomal RNA (rRNA) genes — including 18S, 5.8S, and 28S rRNA — in the nucleolus. Pol I activity is the rate-limiting step for ribosome biogenesis and is tightly coupled to cellular growth and energy status.

hmgb1.en: High Mobility Group Box 1, a nuclear alarmin and potent SASP factor released from senescent cells that drives inflammation and immune activation via TLR and RAGE signaling

idh2.en: Mitochondrial isocitrate dehydrogenase 2; deacetylated and activated by SIRT3 to regenerate NADPH and reduced glutathione, suppressing mitochondrial ROS; also required for SIRT3-dependent antioxidant responses during dietary restriction.

spermine.en: The highest polyamine in the putrescine-spermidine-spermine pathway, a tetravalent polycation that binds nucleic acids, scavenges free radicals, and regulates chromatin, translation and innate immune sensing.

mectizan.en: Mectizan is the Merck brand name for Ivermectin formulated for human use, especially against Onchocerciasis and lymphatic filariasis; the same molecule is under Cancer repurposing study.

dna_replication_stress.en: DNA Replication Stress describes a state of inefficient or stalled

mpos.en: Mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress. A cellular stress condition arising when mitochondrial precursor proteins accumulate excessively in the cytosol, leading to proteotoxicity and cell death.

cytokinesis.en: Cytokinesis is the physical division of the cytoplasm that completes cell division, executed by an actomyosin contractile ring constricting the cleavage furrow followed by ESCRT-mediated abscission of the intercellular bridge.

nitrobenzene.en: Nitrobenzene is an industrial aromatic compound that causes acquired Methemoglobinemia

coenzyme_a.en: Coenzyme A is the universal thiol-containing acyl carrier of metabolism, a cofactor for over 100 enzyme reactions including acetyl-CoA generation, fatty acid synthesis and oxidation, and the TCA cycle. It is synthesised from pantothenic acid and degraded by pantothenate kinase.

metabolites.en: Metabolites are the small-molecule intermediates and end products of enzyme-catalyzed metabolism; their collective profile (the metabolome) shifts with age and microbiome composition.

cdk4_6.en: CDK4 and CDK6 are closely related Cyclin-Dependent Kinases that

hesperetin.en: Citrus flavonoid with antioxidative, antifibrotic, and senescence-modulating activity via autophagic flux restoration and ROS reduction.

beta_adrenergic_receptor.en: G protein-coupled receptors for catecholamines (norepinephrine and epinephrine) comprising β1, β2, and β3 subtypes. They mediate sympathetic nervous system control of heart rate, smooth-muscle relaxation, lipolysis, thermogenesis, and post-exercise metabolic responses.

mesenchymal_stem_cells.en: Multipotent stromal cells that can donate healthy mitochondria to reverse senescence; their mesenchymal gene program is also acquired by endothelial cells undergoing EndoMT in vascular aging.

fundc1.en: Outer mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a receptor for ubiquitin-independent mitophagy, particularly under hypoxic conditions.

complex_iii.en: Complex III (cytochrome bc1 complex, ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase)

src.en: Proto-oncogenic tyrosine kinase that phosphorylates Caspase-8 at Tyr380, inhibiting apoptosis and promoting migration; frequently activated in cancers.

lc3b.en: Microtubule-associated protein 1B light chain 3 (MAP1LC3B), the most abundant mammalian ATG8-family protein. LC3B is lipidated to the inner autophagosomal membrane and acts as a membrane-bound binding platform for cargo receptors through LIR motif recognition; it is the standard biochemical marker of autophagic flux.

amyl_nitrite.en: Amyl nitrite is a volatile alkyl nitrite vasodilator, historical cyanide antidote, and oxidizing inhalant that induces methemoglobinemia.

rotenone.en: Rotenone is a naturally occurring isoflavonoid pesticide and classic Complex I inhibitor used to model Parkinson's disease through mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress.

cross_link_breakers.en: Compounds that cleave established advanced glycation end-product (AGE) and protein cross-links; relevant to glyco-oxidative proteostasis and adrenochrome-related protein damage.

hdacs.en: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) are enzymes that remove acetyl groups from

xiap.en: X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis protein (BIRC4); the most potent and only IAP family member with direct caspase-inhibitory activity, regulated by opposing phosphorylation signals from TBK1 and Akt and targeted by Smac mimetics in cancer.

nucleus_pulposus.en: Gelatinous inner core of the intervertebral disc, composed of notochordal-derived cells embedded in a proteoglycan-rich matrix; its degeneration is central to intervertebral disc degeneration.

thyroid_hormones.en: Thyroid hormones are the primary hormonal regulators of metabolic rate, modulating mitochondrial oxygen consumption and sodium-potassium ATPase activity and thereby setting resting metabolic rate.

superoxide_dismutase.en: Superoxide Dismutase (SOD) is an enzyme that alternately catalyzes

lamin_a.en: Lamin A is a nuclear-envelope intermediate-filament protein encoded by LMNA; defective processing produces progerin and drives progeroid syndromes.

miltefosine.en: A zwitterionic alkylphosphocholine that is the only oral drug licensed for visceral leishmaniasis, killing the parasite by disrupting membrane lipid organisation and impairing lipid signalling.

rank.en: RANK (TNFRSF11A) is a 616-residue type I transmembrane TNF receptor family

cyclooxygenase.en: Cyclooxygenase (COX, prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase, PTGS) is the heme peroxidase family that converts arachidonic acid to prostaglandin H2, committing it to the prostanoid branch of eicosanoid metabolism. COX-1 is constitutive and supports gastric cytoprotection and platelet aggregation; COX-2 is largely inducible and drives inflammatory prostaglandin synthesis, which is why NSAIDs are both analgesic and ulcerogenic.

alkylating_agent.en: A class of cytotoxic compounds that transfer alkyl groups to nucleophilic sites in DNA, proteins and RNA, most characteristically the N7 position of guanine, producing monoadducts, intrastrand and interstrand crosslinks that block replication and transcription; the oldest class of cancer chemotherapy.

dicer.en: Cytoplasmic RNase III enzyme that cleaves pre-miRNA hairpins and long dsRNA into mature miRNA/siRNA duplexes for loading onto Argonaute in RISC.

parp.en: Catalytic function: PARP is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

oct4.en: Oct4 (POU5F1) is a POU-domain transcription factor and core pluripotency factor, one of the four Yamanaka reprogramming factors.

smad7.en: Smad7 (SMAD Family Member 7) is an inhibitory SMAD protein that acts as an antagonist of Transforming Growth Factor-beta (TGF-beta) signaling. It binds physically to the TGF-beta Type I receptor, preventing downstream pathway activation and thereby regulating cell differentiation, tissue fibrosis, and cell death.

tlr9.en: Endosomal Toll-like receptor that senses unmethylated CpG DNA and modulates cGAS expression in a context-dependent manner.

drug_resistance.en: Acquired or intrinsic reduction in cancer cell sensitivity to therapeutic agents.

satellite_cells.en: Satellite Cells are muscle-resident Pax7+ stem cells that repair skeletal muscle and can be rejuvenated by transient Yamanaka factor expression.

respiratory_chain_complex_i.en: Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase) is the largest ETC enzyme; it oxidizes NADH, reduces ubiquinone, pumps protons, and is a major superoxide source.

tdp_43.en: TAR DNA-binding protein 43, an RNA-binding protein whose mitochondrial mislocalization in ALS/FTD triggers cGAS-STING activation via mtDNA release.

ogg1.en: OGG1 (8-oxoguanine DNA glycosylase 1) is a bifunctional glycosylase

smad.en: SMAD proteins are the primary intracellular signal transducers of the TGF-beta

senomorphic.en: A senomorphic is an intervention that suppresses the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) and other detrimental features of senescent cells without necessarily inducing their death.

separase.en: Cysteine protease that cleaves cohesin at the onset of anaphase, releasing sister chromatids so that each can migrate to a daughter cell; its activity is gated by APC/C-dependent destruction of securin.

rheb.en: Rheb (Ras homolog enriched in brain) is a small GTPase that directly binds and activates mTORC1 in its GTP-bound state; it is inhibited by the TSC1-TSC2 GAP and thus couples growth-factor and energy signals to autophagy suppression.

pegylation.en: Covalent attachment of polyethylene glycol chains to a protein, peptide or lipid surface, used to extend circulating half-life, reduce immunogenicity and improve solubility and pharmacokinetics of therapeutic agents.

ptdins3p.en: Phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PtdIns3P) is an endosome- and autophagosome-enriched phosphoinositide generated by Vps34 that recruits WIPI/Atg18 effectors for autophagosome nucleation and expansion.

bip.en: BiP (GRP78, HSPA5) is the endoplasmic-reticulum-resident Hsp70 chaperone that binds misfolded proteins to keep the three unfolded protein response sensors repressed and is the primary transcriptional target of the UPR.

synaptic_plasticity.en: Synaptic plasticity is the activity-dependent strengthening or weakening of synapses; in dopaminergic circuits it is modulated by Neuromelanin-associated Dopamine handling and is impaired in Parkinson's Disease.

plasminogen.en: Inactive zymogen precursor of Plasmin, synthesised in the liver and circulating

adhd.en: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder is a common neurodevelopmental disorder beginning in childhood, characterized by persistent inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity, with pathophysiology involving dopaminergic and noradrenergic signalling in prefrontal cortex and striatum.

ldha.en: Lactate dehydrogenase A, the muscle-type M subunit of the LDH

h3k9me3.en: H3K9me3 is the trimethylation of histone H3 at lysine 9, a repressive chromatin mark that nucleates heterochromatin and stable gene silencing.

gapdh.en: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) is the NAD+-dependent glycolytic enzyme catalyzing the GAP to 1,3-BPG conversion, and a moonlighting protein that senses oxidative stress and translocates to the nucleus to promote apoptosis.

stacs.en: Sirtuin Activating Compounds (STACs) are a structurally diverse class

nsaids.en: NSAIDs (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) are a chemically diverse drug class that reduce pain, fever and inflammation by inhibiting cyclooxygenase and suppressing prostaglandin synthesis, carrying class risks of gastrointestinal bleeding, renal injury, blood pressure elevation and thrombotic cardiovascular events.

metabolome.en: The metabolome is the complete set of small-molecule chemicals—metabolic intermediates, hormones, and signaling metabolites—present in a biological sample, cell, or organism at a given time.

2_deoxy_d_glucose.en: 2-deoxy-D-glucose (2DG) is a glucose analog that inhibits glycolysis and triggers a mitohormetic ROS response, extending lifespan in model organisms.

park7.en: PARK7 (also known as DJ-1) is a multifunctional protein that plays a

covid_19.en: Infectious respiratory disease caused by SARS-CoV-2, ranging from asymptomatic infection to severe pneumonia, ARDS, and multi-organ involvement

hpa_axis.en: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, the neuroendocrine cascade that translates psychological and physiological stress into glucocorticoid release from the adrenal cortex.

hydroxycitrate.en: (-)-Hydroxycitric acid is a competitive inhibitor of ATP-citrate lyase that

motor_neurons.en: Motor neurons are the cholinergic upper and lower neurons of the motor system, forming a two-neuron descending pathway that terminates on skeletal muscle; lower motor neurons subdivide into alpha, beta and gamma types whose properties are matched to the muscle fibres they innervate.

vitamin_k_epoxide_reductase.en: Vitamin K epoxide reductase is the VKORC1-encoded endoplasmic-reticulum enzyme system that recycles vitamin K epoxide back to the hydroquinone cofactor required by gamma-glutamyl carboxylase; inhibiting it blocks gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors and is the mechanism of warfarin anticoagulation.

sgk1.en: Serum- and glucocorticoid-induced protein kinase 1 (SGK1) is a member

monoamine_oxidase.en: Monoamine oxidase (also known as MAO) is a family of enzymes

mettl3.en: Methyltransferase-like 3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A writer complex that regulates RNA fate and autophagy flux via TFEB, and also reshapes enhancer-promoter contacts to drive SASP in senescence.

colloidal_silver.en: Colloidal silver is a suspension of silver nanoparticles in water, marketed as a broad-spectrum antimicrobial with no approved therapeutic indication. Its antimicrobial plausibility has not been supported by clinical evidence, and chronic ingestion causes irreversible argyria.

bioavailability.en: Bioavailability is the fraction of an administered dose of a compound that reaches systemic circulation unchanged and is available at the site of action to produce a biological effect.

propidium_iodide.en: A membrane-impermeant DNA dye (PI) that marks cells with ruptured plasma membranes — the workhorse viability counterstain for lytic vs non-lytic death.

metabolic_reprogramming.en: - Aerobic Glycolysis: Also known as the Warburg Effect, where cells prefer Glycolysis even in the presence of oxygen.

mmp_3.en: Matrix metalloproteinase-3 (stromelysin-1), a SASP protease that remodels the ECM and promotes EMT, tumorigenesis and tissue ageing.

complex_ii.en: Succinate dehydrogenase, the only TCA-cycle enzyme also embedded in the electron transport chain, oxidizing succinate and feeding electrons to ubiquinone.

polymerase_chain_reaction.en: A DNA amplification method that uses a thermostable DNA polymerase and thermal cycling through denaturation, annealing and extension to make millions of copies of a target sequence from a starting amount as small as a single molecule.

shingles_vaccine.en: Recombinant subunit (glycoprotein E + AS01B adjuvant) or live-attenuated vaccine that prevents herpes zoster and may attenuate age-related inflammaging.

antioxidant_supplementation_paradox.en: High-dose exogenous antioxidant supplementation can increase mortality

human_serum_albumin.en: Human serum albumin (HSA) is the most abundant plasma protein and a biocompatible nanocarrier used for drug delivery, including fisetin-loaded HSA nanoparticles.

caspase_1.en: Caspase-1 is an enzyme that, when activated by the NLRP3 Inflammasome,

p300.en: P300 (EP300) is a transcriptional coactivator and histone acetyltransferase

kdm4.en: Lysine demethylase 4 family, JmjC histone demethylases that erase H3K9me3/me2 to open chromatin and promote SASP factor expression.

sympathetic_nervous_system.en: The "fight, flight, or freeze" branch of the autonomic nervous system that releases catecholamines and cortisol, lowers HRV, and drives the acute stress response.

resting_metabolic_rate.en: The energy expended by a post-absorptive organism at rest in a thermoneutral environment, excluding activity, thermic effect of food, and growth. RMR is the largest single component of daily energy expenditure and is determined primarily by fat-free mass.

starvation.en: Starvation is a state of severe nutrient deficiency that triggers
