opportunistic_infection.en: An opportunistic infection is a disease caused by a normally harmless organism that becomes pathogenic because the host's defences are impaired; the classic setting is advanced HIV/AIDS, but iatrogenic immunosuppression, transplant, ageing, and biologicals are now comparably important causes.

tumor_suppressor.en: A tumor suppressor is a protein that protects a cell from one step on

uric_acid.en: Uric acid (UA, 2,6,8-trihydroxypurine) is the end-product of purine metabolism in humans, produced by xanthine oxidase-mediated oxidation of hypoxanthine and xanthine. It functions as both a major endogenous antioxidant in plasma and, at elevated concentrations, a pro-oxidant and crystallizing agent that activates the NLRP3 inflammasome. Hyperuricemia is an independent risk factor for gout, cardiovascular disease, and metabolic syndrome.

retinal_photoreceptors.en: Retinal photoreceptors are the light-sensitive rod and cone neurons of the retina that depend on SIRT3- and SIRT5-mediated NAD+-dependent mitochondrial health for survival.

insulin_receptor.en: The INSR-encoded receptor tyrosine kinase that binds insulin,

mitochondrial_matrix.en: The compartment enclosed by the inner mitochondrial membrane, site of the TCA cycle and mtDNA.

necrosome.en: The RIPK1–RIPK3–MLKL signaling complex that executes necroptosis — assembled when caspase-8 is absent or inhibited, converting a death-receptor stimulus into lytic, DAMP-releasing inflammatory cell death.

tumorigenesis.en: The multi-step process by which normal cells transform into cancer cells through accumulation of genetic and epigenetic alterations

irf7.en: Interferon regulatory factor 7 is the master transcriptional regulator of type I and type III interferon responses, acting downstream of pattern-recognition receptors via TBK1 and cooperating with IRF3 at interferon-stimulated response elements.

plekhm1.en: PLEKHM1 (pleckstrin homology domain-containing family member 1) is a multi-domain autophagosome/endolysosome tethering effector that binds Rab7, the HOPS tethering complex, and LC3/GABARAP via an LIR motif to drive autophagosome-lysosome and endosome-lysosome fusion; biallelic loss causes an osteolysis syndrome.

hepatocyte.en: The principal parenchymal cell of the liver, responsible for metabolism, detoxification, protein synthesis, and rapid regenerative response.

brain_cancer.en: Malignant primary tumours of the central nervous system — chiefly glioblastoma,

dna_methyltransferase.en: DNA methyltransferases (DNMTs) are enzymes responsible for establishing and maintaining DNA methylation patterns.

mercs.en: Mitochondria-ER contact sites (MERCS) are physical connections between the endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria that facilitate calcium transfer, lipid synthesis, and signaling, with important roles in cellular senescence and neurodegenerative disease.

icam_1.en: ICAM-1 (CD54) is a single-pass type I cell-surface glycoprotein of the immunoglobulin superfamily and the principal ligand for the beta2 integrins LFA-1 and Mac-1. It mediates leukocyte firm adhesion and transendothelial migration, is induced by inflammatory cytokines, and doubles as the entry receptor for major-group rhinoviruses.

cd8_t_cells.en: Cytotoxic CD8+ T lymphocytes that mediate pathogen-specific and anti-tumor immunity; their memory subset is increased by mTOR inhibition, improving vaccine responses.

anemia.en: A condition of reduced red blood cell mass or hemoglobin, causing impaired oxygen delivery; a mild, reversible cytopenia associated with chronic mTOR inhibition.

protein_tyrosine_phosphatases.en: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases (PTPs) are a family of enzymes that

oncogene.en: An oncogene is a Gene that has the potential to cause Cancer when mutated,

cohesin.en: Cohesin is a multi-subunit SMC complex that mediates sister chromatid cohesion, DNA looping for transcriptional regulation, and homologous recombination repair.

catechol.en: Catechol (pyrocatechol, 1,2-dihydroxybenzene) is an organic ortho-diphenol compound, the parent scaffold of the catecholamine family and a key intermediate in melanin formation and adrenochrome research.

histone_acetylation.en: Histone acetylation is a dynamic epigenetic modification where an

histone_h2ax.en: Histone H2AX is a variant of the core H2A histone that constitutes roughly 2-25% of total H2A depending on cell type, and whose phosphorylation at Ser139 (gamma-H2AX) is the earliest and most widely used molecular marker of DNA double-strand breaks.

igf1r.en: IGF1R (CD221) is a ubiquitously expressed receptor tyrosine kinase of the insulin receptor family. It is a disulfide-linked alpha2beta2 tetramer that signals through IRS/Shc to PI3K-AKT-mTOR and RAS-MAPK, is obligatory for prenatal growth, and is a driver and validated-on-target-but-hard-to-drug cancer dependency.

wolman_disease.en: Wolman disease is the infantile form of lysosomal acid lipase deficiency (LAL-D), an autosomal recessive LIPA mutation causing cholesteryl ester and triglyceride accumulation, with vomiting, failure to thrive, adrenal calcification, and death usually within the first year.

dr5.en: TRAIL-R2 (TNFRSF10B, CD262) — the second functional TRAIL death receptor, a death-domain-containing TNF-superfamily receptor that signals through FADD/caspase-8 to apoptosis or, when caspase-8 is blocked, RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis.

cardiomyocyte.en: Cardiomyocytes are striated, contractile muscle cells of the heart

interferon_stimulated_genes.en: Collection of genes transcriptionally induced by type I interferon signaling that encode antiviral and inflammatory effector proteins.

aryl_hydrocarbon_receptor.en: The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is a ligand-activated transcription factor that senses environmental toxins and endogenous metabolites, including kynurenine, regulating immune responses, xenobiotic metabolism, and cell differentiation.

chk1.en: CHK1 (CHEK1) is the CMGC-family serine/threonine checkpoint kinase activated by ATR at stalled replication forks; it delays cell-cycle progression by inhibiting CDC25 phosphatases and activating WEE1, and is a major oncology drug target.

proanthocyanidins.en: Proanthocyanidins (oligomeric proanthocyanidins, OPCs) are polymeric/oligomeric flavonoid polyphenols (condensed tannins) built from flavan-3-ol units, with potent antioxidant, vascular, and SIRT1-modulatory anti-aging activity.

major_histocompatibility_complex_class_i.en: Major histocompatibility complex class I (MHC-I) molecules are found on the surface of nearly all nucleated cells.

clear_network.en: The Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation network, a transcriptional program centered on TFEB/TFE3 that coordinates lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy gene expression.

ceruloplasmin.en: Ceruloplasmin is a 1065-residue, six-domain plasma multicopper oxidase that carries 6–7 copper atoms and oxidises Fe2+ to Fe3+ for transferrin loading, while serving as the major copper transport protein and an acute-phase reactant.

multidrug_resistance.en: Multidrug Resistance (MDR) is the phenomenon where tumor cells become

brugia_timori.en: Brugia timori is a filarial nematode causing Lymphatic Filariasis in eastern Indonesia (Timor), targeted by mass ivermectin/albendazole administration.

srt1720.en: SRT1720 is a synthetic small-molecule STAC (sirtuin activating compound) developed by Sirtris Pharmaceuticals as a potent SIRT1 activator. It belongs to the imidazothiazole class and is structurally distinct from resveratrol.

wuchereria_bancrofti.en: Wuchereria bancrofti is a lymphatic filarial nematode transmitted by mosquitoes that causes lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis); chronic infection drives inflammation and immunosuppression with indirect cancer-relevant implications.

timp3.en: TIMP3 (Tissue Inhibitor of Metalloproteinases 3) is an endogenous secreted inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) and members of the ADAM and ADAMTS families. Among the four TIMP family members, TIMP3 is unique in its tight association with the extracellular matrix (ECM).

t_cell_receptor.en: A heterodimeric membrane receptor on T cells that recognizes peptide-MHC complexes, initiating adaptive immune responses; TCR gene rearrangement during thymopoiesis generates the diverse receptor repertoire.

hepatocyte_growth_factor.en: Hepatocyte Growth Factor (HGF, scatter factor) is a pleiotropic cytokine and the sole ligand of the c-Met receptor tyrosine kinase.

hmga2.en: HMGA2 is a small oncofetal chromatin architectural protein of the high-mobility-group AT-hook family that acts as an oncogene by repressing cell differentiation, is the best-characterised target of the let-7 microRNA and a key downstream effector of LIN28, and is upregulated in senescence where it cooperates with the Rb pathway.

hocl_mediated_oxidation.en: HOCl-mediated Oxidation refers to the chemical process where hypochlorous

nanocrystals.en: Nanocrystals are carrier-free aggregates of pure drug molecules in the nanometer range that increase surface area and dissolution velocity of poorly soluble compounds.

sirt3_sirt4_ratio.en: The SIRT3/SIRT4 Ratio is the quantitative balance between two opposing

alpha_lipoic_acid.en: Alpha-lipoic acid (ALA) is a sulfur-containing compound that acts as

cd36_receptor.en: CD36 is a member of the class B scavenger receptor family and is involved

propolis.en: A resinous mixture produced by honeybees from plant exudates, used in traditional medicine for its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties

mcu.en: The mitochondrial calcium uniporter (MCU) is a highly selective ion channel in the inner mitochondrial membrane that mediates calcium uptake into the mitochondrial matrix, regulating energy metabolism, cell death, and senescence.

proteinopathy.en: Diseases driven by misfolded and aggregated proteins, sharing cytosolic dsDNA generation as a unifying trigger of cGAS-STING activation.

rankl.en: RANKL (TNFSF11) is a 317-residue type II transmembrane TNF superfamily

nox4.en: NOX4 (NADPH oxidase 4) is a constitutively active NADPH oxidase

humphry_osmond.en: British psychiatrist who co-proposed the adrenochrome hypothesis of schizophrenia and coined the term ''psychedelic

apitox.en: A standardized honeybee (Apis mellifera) venom preparation used in apitherapy research for its anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer properties

pex5.en: PEX5 encodes the PTS1 receptor, a cytosolic shuttling receptor that recognizes

monocytes.en: Circulating mononuclear leukocytes of the innate immune system that differentiate

systemic_lupus_erythematosus.en: A chronic autoimmune disease characterized by loss of self-tolerance, autoantibody production, and multi-organ inflammation driven by immune complex deposition.

p65.en: p65 (RELA) is the 551-residue Rel-family subunit of NF-kB that supplies the transactivation domains. It is the dominant transcription factor of canonical NF-kB signalling, held inactive in the cytoplasm by I-kB, and released by IKK-mediated phosphorylation and proteasomal destruction of the inhibitor. Activity is gated principally by reversible lysine acetylation.

elephantiasis.en: The advanced end-stage of chronic lymphedema, in which long-standing lymphatic dysfunction produces massive swelling, thickened hyperkeratotic skin and fibrosis of a limb or the genitalia. The term describes a syndrome rather than a disease - lymphatic filariasis is the commonest tropical cause, with podoconiosis a close second.

sphingomyelin.en: A phosphosphingolipid synthesized from ceramide; a structural component of membranes and a reservoir for ceramide generation via sphingomyelinases.

histone_acetyltransferase.en: Histone Acetyltransferase (HAT) is a class of enzymes that transfer an acetyl group from acetyl-CoA to specific lysine residues on histone tails.

camp.en: Cyclic Adenosine Monophosphate (cAMP) is a vital hydrophilic intracellular

aminoguanidine_hcl.en: Aminoguanidine hydrochloride is the hydrochloride salt of aminoguanidine,

escrt.en: The Endosomal Sorting Complexes Required for Transport (ESCRT) is a protein

gcn2.en: General control nonderepressible 2 (GCN2) is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates eIF2α in response to amino acid starvation, including tryptophan depletion mediated by IDO1.

nuclear_receptor.en: Members of a superfamily of ligand-activated transcription factors that bind hormone, retinoid, vitamin D, fatty acid or xenobiotic ligands and regulate target gene transcription through a zinc-finger DNA-binding domain, a ligand-binding domain and two activation functions.

atg4.en: Atg4 is a cysteine protease that processes the C-terminus of Atg8 family

transcription.en: Transcription is the first step of gene expression, in which a particular

chloroquine.en: Chloroquine is an autophagy inhibitor and antimalarial drug that blocks autophagosome-lysosome fusion by raising lysosomal pH; it is used in combination cancer therapy and is a rare trigger of methemoglobinemia, with higher risk in G6PD deficiency.

lymphatic_filariasis.en: Lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) is a neglected tropical disease caused by filarial nematodes (Wuchereria bancrofti, Brugia spp.) transmitted by mosquitoes, treated with Ivermectin, Diethylcarbamazine, and Albendazole.

mtrr.en: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is an enzyme that maintains methionine synthase in its active B12-dependent reduced state for homocysteine remethylation.

heparin.en: Heparin is a Glycosaminoglycan Anticoagulant that potentiates Antithrombin

rheumatoid_synovial_fluid.en: The inflammatory exudate found in the joint cavities of individuals with rheumatoid arthritis, characterized by altered volume, cellularity, and biochemical composition.

stress_induced_premature_senescence.en: Stress-Induced Premature Senescence (SIPS) is a form of Cellular

michael_addition.en: The Michael addition (or Michael reaction) is a nucleophilic addition

nanoemulsions.en: Nanoemulsions are thermodynamically unstable but kinetically stable oil-in-water or water-in-oil dispersions (20–200 nm) that enhance the solubility, permeability, and bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs.

ftsj1.en: FTSJ1 is an X-linked tRNA 2′-O-methyltransferase that installs the Um34 modification on selenocysteine tRNA (tRNA[Ser]Sec), a modification required for efficient UGA recoding of selenocysteine during translation.

nox2.en: NOX2 (gp91ᵖʰᵒˣ, NADPH oxidase 2) is the prototypical catalytic subunit

gata3.en: GATA3 is a zinc-finger pioneer transcription factor that drives luminal differentiation

pex6.en: PEX6 is a peroxisomal AAA+ ATPase that, as a heterohexamer with PEX1, extracts ubiquitinated PEX5 from the peroxisomal membrane to recycle the import receptor and prevent pexophagy; PEX6 mutations cause Zellweger-spectrum peroxisome biogenesis disorders.

diaphorase.en: Diaphorase is an alternative name for NADH-dependent cytochrome b5 reductase, the enzyme that reduces methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin.

srebp.en: Sterol regulatory element-binding proteins — the SREBP1/SREBP2 family of ER-anchored basic helix-loop-helix transcription factors whose proteolytic processing controls cholesterol synthesis (SREBP-2) and fatty-acid/lipogenesis (SREBP-1c).

p2x7_receptor.en: P2X7 (P2RX7) is an ATP-gated, non-selective cation channel that functions as a

methyl_donor.en: Methyl donors are compounds that provide a labile methyl group (−CH₃)

electrophile.en: Electrophile is a concept related to Adrenochrome and catecholamine metabolism.

melas.en: Mitochondrial encephalomyopathy with lactic acidosis and stroke-like episodes, a maternally inherited mitochondrial disorder

senescence_associated_heterochromatin_fo.en: SAHF are DAPI-dense, transcriptionally silent heterochromatin structures assembled by HIRA/ASF1a/macroH2A that enforce stable senescence arrest by repressing E2F-driven proliferation genes.

capecitabine.en: Capecitabine is an orally bioavailable fluoropyrimidine carbamate prodrug of 5-fluorouracil, converted in three enzymatic steps with preferential activation in tumour tissue; it is a standard agent in colorectal and breast cancer.

nmnat.en: NMNAT (Nicotinamide mononucleotide adenylyltransferase) is a family of

cytoplasmic_chromatin_fragments.en: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (CCFs) are nuclear DNA fragments released into the cytosol of senescent cells due to Lamin B1 downregulation and nuclear envelope collapse, serving as key ligands for cGAS-STING-dependent SASP activation.

heparin_induced_thrombocytopenia.en: Heparin-induced thrombocytopenia is an immune-mediated, highly prothrombotic adverse drug reaction to heparin in which IgG antibodies against platelet factor 4-heparin complexes activate platelets via Fc gamma RIIa, causing thrombocytopenia with paradoxically high rates of venous and arterial thrombosis.

atg5.en: Atg5 (Autophagy-related 5) is a protein essential for the initiation

apc_c.en: The Anaphase-Promoting Complex/Cyclosome (APC/C) is a ~1.5 MDa multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase that governs metaphase-to-anaphase transition, mitotic exit, and Mcl-1 degradation during mitotic arrest.

trif.en: TIR-domain-containing adaptor protein inducing interferon-β (TRIF/TICAM1), the sole adaptor for TLR3 signaling and a key branch of TLR4 signaling that activates IRF3, NF-κB, and STAT1.

oma1.en: OMA1 is a mitochondrial inner-membrane zinc metalloprotease activated by mitochondrial stress; it cleaves OPA1 and DELE1 to couple dynamics, mitophagy, and the integrated stress response.

muscle_stem_cell.en: Muscle Stem Cells (satellite cells) are Pax7+ resident progenitors that repair skeletal muscle and exit quiescence upon injury.

bnip3l.en: BCL2/adenovirus E1B interacting protein 3-like (BNIP3L/NIX), an outer mitochondrial membrane mitophagy receptor for hypoxia-induced mitophagy

mody1.en: MODY1 is maturity-onset diabetes of the young type 1, caused by heterozygous pathogenic variants in HNF4A, producing a progressive, sulfonylurea-responsive form of monogenic diabetes.

age_related_diseases.en: Diseases whose incidence and severity increase with chronological age, driven by fundamental aging processes such as cellular senescence, inflammation, and macromolecular damage.

androgen_receptor.en: A nuclear receptor activated by androgens, central to prostate development and a key driver and therapeutic target in prostate cancer.

sulforaphane.en: Sulforaphane (SFN) is an isothiocyanate compound from cruciferous vegetables

central_nervous_system.en: The brain and spinal cord, the anatomical compartment in which cGAS-STING signaling regulates glial activation, neuronal homeostasis, and neuroinflammation.

myelosuppression.en: Dose-limiting suppression of bone marrow blood-cell production by cytotoxic chemotherapy, producing neutropenia, anaemia and thrombocytopenia.

cgamp.en: 2'3'-cyclic GMP-AMP; a cyclic dinucleotide second messenger produced by cGAS that activates STING

tumorigenicity.en: The capacity of a cell, tissue, or agent to form a tumor when introduced

acute_lung_injury.en: Acute inflammatory lung condition causing hypoxemic respiratory failure

phagocytic_lysosome_reformation.en: Phagocytic Lysosome Reformation (PLR) is the process by which Lysosomes

quinolinic_acid.en: Quinolinic acid (QA) is a downstream metabolite of the kynurenine pathway and an NMDA receptor agonist that is neurotoxic at elevated concentrations, also serving as a precursor for NAD+ synthesis.

sasp_remodeling_aminochrome_complex.en: A conceptual entity describing aminochrome (oxidized adrenochrome) interaction with the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype, linking redox-driven senescence to indolequinone stress.

14_3_3_protein.en: 14-3-3 proteins are a family of conserved regulatory molecules that bind

beta_blockers.en: Beta blockers are adrenergic receptor antagonists that block beta-adrenergic signalling, chiefly slowing heart rate, reducing contractility and lowering blood pressure; they are cornerstone drugs in heart failure, ischaemic heart disease and arrhythmia, and their antimicrobial and anti-longevity reputations are not supported by trial data.

antagomirs.en: Antagomirs are a class of chemically engineered Oligonucleotide that

cell_proliferation.en: Cell proliferation is the process by which cells grow and divide to produce

synthetic_lethality.en: Synthetic lethality is a genetic or pharmacological concept where simultaneous disruption of two genes or pathways causes cell death, while disruption of either alone is tolerated.

diabetic_cardiomyopathy.en: Cardiac dysfunction occurring in diabetic patients independent of coronary artery disease and hypertension, driven by mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, and metabolic inflexibility.

thioredoxin_1.en: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1, TXN) is a ubiquitously expressed ~12 kDa cytosolic oxidoreductase that maintains thiol redox balance, regulates redox-sensitive signaling via ASK1, NF-κB and HIF-1α, regenerates peroxiredoxins, and is one of the few antioxidant proteins whose systemic overexpression prolongs mouse lifespan and protects the heart.

berberine.en: Berberine is a quaternary ammonium alkaloid from Berberis and related plants with pleiotropic effects on glucose, lipid, and inflammatory pathways; it lacks a catechol structure and does not inhibit COMT.

dnmt3a.en: DNMT3a (DNA Methyltransferase 3 alpha) is a de novo methyltransferase responsible for establishing new DNA Methylation patterns.

ddx3x.en: DDX3X (DEAD-box helicase 3 X-linked) is an X-linked RNA helicase involved

phospholipase_c.en: Phospholipase C is the family of inositol lipid hydrolases (PLCβ, γ, δ, ε, ζ, η) that cleave phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate into IP3 and DAG, converting receptor activation into calcium release and protein kinase C activation; PLCζ is the sperm factor that triggers egg activation.

mitochondrial_integrity.en: Maintenance of mitochondrial structure, function, and homeostasis via balanced fusion and fission.

atg15.en: Atg15 is an Autophagy protein in yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae)

african_programme_for_onchocerciasis_con.en: The African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control (APOC) was an international programme that aimed to eliminate Onchocerciasis as a public health problem in Africa.

decitabine.en: Decitabine (5-aza-2''-deoxycytidine; trade name Dacogen) is a deoxyribose nucleoside analog that functions as a potent DNA Methyltransferase (DNMT) inhibitor.

inner_mitochondrial_membrane.en: Highly folded inner membrane of mitochondria that forms cristae and houses the OXPHOS complexes.

bubr1.en: BubR1 (BUB1B) is a mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine kinase essential for the spindle assembly checkpoint; SIRT2 extends lifespan in BubR1 hypomorphic progeroid mice.

neurotransmission.en: Neurotransmission is the process by which signaling molecules called neurotransmitters are released by the axon terminal of a neuron and bind to and react with the receptors on the dendrites of another neuron.

ck2.en: Casein kinase 2 is a ubiquitous serine/threonine protein kinase that restrains NF-κB and senescence.

vascular_endothelial_injury.en: Vascular endothelial injury is direct damage to the endothelium from mechanical trauma, ischemia-reperfusion, oxidative stress, toxins or inflammatory mediators, causing glycocalyx shedding, junction loss, permeability changes and pro-thrombotic/pro-inflammatory conversion of the vessel surface.

taurine.en: A conditionally essential sulfur-containing amino acid with roles in bile acid conjugation, osmoregulation, calcium handling, antioxidant defense, and mitochondrial translation; declines with age and supports longevity phenotypes when supplemented.

aspirin.en: Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) is an irreversible cyclooxygenase inhibitor used for analgesia, antipyresis, anti-inflammation, and antithrombotic prophylaxis; its cardiovascular efficacy is modified by COMT genotype.

matrix_metalloproteinases.en: Matrix Metalloproteinases (MMPs) are a family of calcium-dependent, zinc-containing

cdc20.en: Cell division cycle 20 (CDC20) is a ~55 kDa WD40 repeat protein that serves as the essential co-activator of the APC/C E3 ubiquitin ligase, governing the metaphase-to-anaphase transition and mitotic exit.

thymus.en: Primary lymphoid organ where T cells develop, undergo selection, and are exported to the periphery; undergoes age-related involution.

messenger_rna.en: Messenger RNA (mRNA), the ribonucleic acid transcript that conveys genetic information from DNA to the ribosome for protein synthesis.

fis1.en: Mitochondrial fission 1 protein (FIS1) is a outer mitochondrial membrane protein that recruits DRP1 to initiate mitochondrial fission, playing a key role in mitochondrial dynamics and quality control.

cyclophilin_d.en: Cyclophilin D (CypD) is a mitochondrial matrix peptidyl-prolyl isomerase that serves as the primary positive regulator of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore (mPTP), playing a key role in calcium homeostasis, cell death, and senescence.

differentiation.en: The process by which a less specialized cell becomes a more specialized cell type, driven by transcription factor networks and epigenetic remodeling.

n_acetylcysteine.en: N-Acetylcysteine (NAC) is the N-acetyl derivative of L-cysteine; it acts as a mucolytic and, more importantly, as a precursor that replenishes intracellular Glutathione and supports antioxidant defense.

cyclin_d.en: Cyclin D (CCND1/CCND2/CCND3) is the family of G1/S-specific regulatory subunits that activate CDK4 and CDK6 to phosphorylate Retinoblastoma Protein, release E2F, and commit cells to S phase; CCDN1 amplification and overexpression are among the most common oncogenic lesions in human cancer.

insulin_sensitivity.en: Insulin Sensitivity refers to the efficiency with which cells (primarily

hexokinase_2.en: Hexokinase 2 (HK2) is the enzyme that catalyzes the first step of glycolysis; it is highly expressed in cancer cells and is a key node of the Warburg Effect, bound to mitochondria to suppress apoptosis.

malaria.en: Plasmodium infection of erythrocytes; oxidative stress opens cation channels, eryptosis clears infected cells and parasites, eryptosis-lowering erythrocyte traits (G6PD deficiency, sickle trait, thalassemia) confer partial protection, and pro-eryptotic xenobiotics slow parasitemia.

regulatory_t_cell.en: FoxP3+ immunosuppressive T cells maintaining tolerance; induced by TGF-beta, IDO1, and AhR signaling.

mitochondrial_processing_peptidase.en: Matrix protease (MPP) that cleaves N-terminal mitochondrial targeting sequences from imported proteins, including the PINK1 MTS.

stilbene.en: Stilbenes are a class of Polyphenols organic compounds characterized

m_csf.en: Macrophage colony-stimulating factor (CSF-1) cytokine that binds CSF1R to drive monocyte and macrophage differentiation, microglial maintenance and tumour-associated macrophage polarisation.

eif4g.en: eIF4G is the large scaffolding subunit of the eIF4F cap-binding complex, binding eIF4E, eIF4A, eIF3 and poly(A)-binding protein to assemble the 43S preinitiation complex, and acting as the convergence point for mTORC1 and MNK1 control of translation.

gsk3beta.en: Glycogen synthase kinase 3β (GSK3β) is a kinase that phosphorylates TFEB

alpha_tocopherol.en: Alpha-tocopherol is the principal form of Vitamin E, selectively retained in human plasma and tissue by alpha-tocopherol transfer protein; the reference chain-breaking antioxidant of membranes and lipoproteins.

flavan_3_ols.en: Flavan-3-ols (flavanols) are a subclass of flavonoid polyphenols comprising monomeric catechins/epicatechins and their gallates, which polymerize into proanthocyanidins; abundant in tea, cocoa, and fruit with antioxidant and vascular benefits.

heart.en: Muscular pump organ whose cardiomyocytes, conduction, and natriuretic signaling set systemic perfusion.

synaptic_vesicles.en: Synaptic Vesicles are presynaptic organelles that store and release neurotransmitters such as Dopamine and Norepinephrine; their cycling is regulated by Alpha-synuclein and disrupted in Parkinson's Disease.

chronic_obstructive_pulmonary_disease.en: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a progressive inflammatory lung disease characterized by long-term breathing problems and poor airflow. The main symptoms include shortness of breath, cough, and sputum production.

homeostasis.en: Homeostasis is the state of steady internal, physical, and chemical

fibromyalgia.en: A chronic pain syndrome characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, sleep disturbances, and cognitive difficulties, with emerging evidence of bioenergetic dysfunction linking it to creatine metabolism.

plasmin.en: A broad-spectrum serine protease generated from plasminogen by plasminogen

cytarabine.en: Cytarabine (cytosine arabinoside, ara-C) is a cytidine analog antimetabolite that

acsl4.en: Acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 4; an enzyme that activates polyunsaturated fatty acids for incorporation into membrane phospholipids, a key positive regulator of ferroptosis.

navitoclax.en: Navitoclax (ABT-263) is an orally bioavailable BH3-mimetic that inhibits BCL-2/BCL-xL/BCL-w, acting as a senolytic and anticancer agent limited by thrombocytopenia.

dopaminochrome.en: Dopaminochrome is an aminochrome intermediate formed by the Oxidation

lipid_hydroperoxide.en: A peroxidized polyunsaturated fatty acid (LOOH) formed when a lipid peroxyl radical abstracts a hydrogen atom from an adjacent PUFA; the primary peroxidation product that decomposes to reactive aldehydes.

fsp1.en: Ferroptosis suppressor protein 1 (FSP1, formerly AIFM2) is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein that uses NAD(P)H to reduce ubiquinone (CoQ10) to ubiquinol, a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant, acting as a GPX4-independent, parallel brake on ferroptosis.

lys68.en: Lysine 68 (K68) of mitochondrial MnSOD/SOD2 — an acetylation site deacetylated and activated by SIRT3, cooperating with Lys122 to control superoxide dismutation.

fos.en: FOS proto-oncogene, a basic leucine zipper transcription factor that dimerizes with JUN family members to form AP-1 complexes driving proliferation, inflammation, and fibrosis genes.

c_flip.en: FLICE-like inhibitory protein (c-FLIP/CFLAR) — an enzymatically inactive caspase-8 homolog whose isoforms set the apoptose/necroptose/pyroptose switch by tuning caspase-8 activity inside death receptor and inflammasome complexes.

lipopolysaccharide.en: Gram-negative bacterial outer-membrane endotoxin (LPS) that activates Toll-like receptor 4 and drives sterile and septic inflammation, redox stress, and inflammaging.

mitochondrial_membrane_potential.en: The mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm) is the proton-motive force across the inner mitochondrial membrane; its glutamate-induced collapse is attenuated by methylene blue and neuroprotective phenothiazines.

thymic_epithelial_cells.en: Stromal cells in the thymus cortex and medulla that form a supportive network essential for T cell development, selection, and tolerance induction.

doxycycline.en: Doxycycline is an antibiotic that interferes with mitochondrial translation,

proteins.en: Proteins are large biomolecules of amino-acid chains that perform catalytic, structural, and signaling functions. They are major targets of Oxidative Stress, undergoing side-chain oxidation, backbone fragmentation, and carbonylation that disrupt function.

vasopressin.en: Posterior-pituitary peptide hormone regulating water homeostasis and vasoconstriction; implicated in brain aging, redox stress, and autophagy modulation.

paclitaxel.en: Paclitaxel (also known as Taxol) is a widely used chemotherapy agent

ptdins_4_5_p2.en: Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PtdIns(4,5)P2) is a plasma-membrane-enriched phosphoinositide that regulates endocytosis, autophagosome closure, and autophagic lysosome reformation.

takotsubo_cardiomyopathy.en: Acute, reversible left ventricular systolic dysfunction triggered by intense emotional or physical stress, mediated by catecholamine surge, oxidative stress, and lipid peroxidation.

vascular_inflammation.en: Vascular inflammation is the coordinated recruitment and activation of circulating leukocytes into the vessel wall, driven by endothelial and mural-cell NF-kB signalling that induces VCAM-1, ICAM-1, MCP-1 and GM-CSF; it is the shared mechanism of atherosclerosis, aneurysm, heart failure and vasculitis.

cyclophosphamide.en: Cyclophosphamide is a nitrogen mustard alkylating agent and prodrug used as a chemotherapy medication and immunosuppressant.

glycine.en: Glycine is the smallest amino acid and a versatile metabolite that serves as a building block for glutathione, creatine, heme, purines, and collagen, and acts as an inhibitory neurotransmitter.

pattern_recognition_receptors.en: Germline-encoded innate immune sensors that detect pathogen-derived and endogenous nucleic acids and danger signals, initiating inflammatory responses.

apoe.en: Apolipoprotein E is a 299-residue lipid carrier and the principal ligand for LDL-receptor-family receptors; the human epsilon2/3/4 isoforms differ at residues 112 and 158, with APOE epsilon4 the largest genetic risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer disease.

cortactin.en: A Src-family kinase substrate encoded by CTTN on chromosome 11q13 that binds F-actin and the Arp2/3 complex, stabilising branched actin networks at cell protrusions and thereby driving migration, invadopodia formation and membrane trafficking.

lymphedema.en: Lymphedema is the accumulation of protein-rich interstitial fluid from impaired lymphatic drainage, causing chronic tissue swelling, fibrosis and recurrent cellulitis.

castor2.en: CASTOR2 is a protein that forms a complex with CASTOR1 to function as

trpm2.en: TRPM2 (Transient Receptor Potential Melastatin-Related Channel 2) is a calcium-permeable non-selective cation channel expressed highly in the brain, immune system, and cardiovascular system. It functions as an oxidative stress sensor whose prolonged activation leads to calcium overload and cell death.

methyl_groups.en: Methyl groups (-CH3) are one-carbon units transferred in methylation reactions that regulate neurotransmitter metabolism, gene expression, and detoxification.

nod_like_receptors.en: A family of ~20 cytosolic innate immune receptors built on a nucleotide-binding NACHT domain, encompassing signal-transducing NOD1/NOD2 and inflammasome-forming NLRs such as NLRP1, NLRP3, and the NAIP-NLRC4 inflammasome.

fenofibrate.en: Fenofibrate is a fibrate and orally absorbed PPAR-alpha agonist prodrug whose active metabolite fenofibric acid lowers triglycerides and VLDL by driving lipoprotein lipase and suppressing apoC-III; it does not reduce cardiovascular events in diabetes trials.

slc6a8.en: The gene encoding the principal creatine transporter (CT1) on chromosome Xq28; mutations cause creatine transporter deficiency, an X-linked form of cerebral creatine deficiency syndrome associated with intellectual disability, epilepsy, and speech delay.

bromodomain.en: Bromodomains are ~110-residue acetyl-lysine reader modules that translate histone acetylation into recruitment of transcriptional machinery, forming the reader tier of the writer-reader-eraser system alongside BET family proteins such as BRD2/3/4.

mitosis.en: Mitosis is the process of Cell Division in which a single Eukaryotic Cell divides its duplicated Chromosomes into two identical daughter nuclei. It consists of stages: Prophase, Prometaphase, Metap...

model_organisms.en: Model organisms are non-human species used in biomedical research to understand biological processes, such as aging, in a controlled environment.

coronary_heart_disease.en: Coronary Heart Disease (CHD), also known as Coronary Artery Disease

lewy_bodies.en: The primary component of Lewy bodies is phosphorylated Alpha-synuclein. Other proteins, such as Ubiquitin and p62, are also commonly found within these inclusions, reflecting the cell's failed attempt to degrade the aggregated proteins.

notch.en: Notch signaling pathway that gates the early-to-late SASP switch and establishes paracrine senescence.

world_health_organization.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) is the UN agency for global public health; it coordinates cancer control (WHO cancer programmes) and elimination of infection-linked neglected tropical diseases (onchocerciasis, lymphatic filariasis) with cancer-relevant upstream causes.

mcl_1.en: Mcl-1 (Myeloid cell leukemia 1) is a potent anti-apoptotic member

ucp2.en: UCP2 (Uncoupling Protein 2) is a mitochondrial inner membrane transporter protein belonging to the family of mitochondrial uncoupling proteins, which uncouple oxygen consumption from ATP synthesis by facilitating proton leak across the inner mitochondrial membrane.

integrins.en: Integrins are α/β heterodimeric transmembrane adhesion receptors that mediate cell-ECM and cell-cell adhesion, transduce outside-in and inside-out signaling, and drive Angiogenesis, migration, and Metastasis.

complement_system.en: The complement system is a network of roughly 30 soluble and membrane-bound proteins that provides the fastest-acting antimicrobial defence, links innate and adaptive immunity, and is a major driver of inflammatory and autoimmune disease when dysregulated.

interleukin_1beta.en: Interleukin 1β (IL-1β) is a potent proinflammatory cytokine whose activation

ubiquitin_ligase.en: An enzyme (E3 ubiquitin ligase) that recognizes substrate proteins and

cardiac_fibrosis.en: Pathological process of excessive extracellular matrix deposition in the myocardium, driven by TGF-β-mediated myofibroblast differentiation

cardiomyopathy.en: A group of diseases of the heart muscle that impair its ability to pump blood, leading to heart failure and arrhythmia.

estrogen_receptor.en: Nuclear receptor transcription factors (ERα/ERβ) that mediate estrogen signaling and are key targets in breast and other hormone-sensitive cancers; ERβ in particular gates female-restrained inflammasome/cell-death programs and is an emerging sex-stratified therapeutic axis.

biphasic_dose_response_curve.en: A non-monotonic dose-response relationship in which the slope changes sign, producing an inverted-U (or J-shaped) profile—the quantitative signature of hormesis.

kinetochore.en: Multimeric protein complex assembled on centromeric chromatin that captures spindle microtubules, generates and senses attachment tension, and houses the spindle assembly checkpoint that guards chromosome segregation.

serum_amyloid_a.en: Hepatically derived acute-phase apolipoprotein (SAA1/SAA2) induced by IL-6 and IL-1 that promotes cholesterol transport and, when chronically elevated, forms amyloid fibrils causing AA amyloidosis.

oxygen_consumption_rate.en: Oxygen Consumption Rate (OCR) is a real-time metric of mitochondrial respiration

dynamin.en: Large membrane-remodelling GTPase that polymerises into collars around necked membranes to drive clathrin-mediated endocytosis and synaptic vesicle scission through GTP hydrolysis.

endothelial_nitric_oxide_synthase.en: Endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS, NOS3) is the constitutive

creatine_transporters_crtr.en: Sodium- and chloride-dependent transporters of the SLC6 family (notably

triglycerides.en: Triacylglycerols are the dominant dietary and storage lipid, carried by chylomicrons and VLDL, mobilised by lipolysis, and their plasma elevation is a driver of pancreatitis and metabolic disease.

timp1.en: Tissue Inhibitor of Metalloproteinases-1, a soluble endogenous inhibitor

erythronecroptosis.en: RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL-dependent regulated necrosis of mature erythrocytes — the lytic, hemolysis-like counterpart of eryptosis, triggered by Fas/FasL, CD59 ligation with pore formation, ROS, ceramide and AGEs, and mutually exclusive with eryptosis via caspase-8.

nemo.en: NF-κB essential modulator (IKKγ); regulatory subunit of the IKK complex that relays DNA damage response and cytokine signals to NF-κB activation.

phagophore_assembly_site.en: The dedicated subcellular locus at which the autophagy machinery nucleates and elongates the phagophore, the precursor membrane of the autophagosome.

self_renewal.en: Self-renewal is the intrinsic capacity of a stem cell to produce at least one daughter cell that retains the parent cell's undifferentiated identity, allowing indefinite propagation of the stem cell pool alongside differentiated progeny.

prdx6.en: Peroxiredoxin 6 (PRDX6), a 1-Cys peroxiredoxin with peroxidase, iPLA2, and LPCAT activities; the direct molecular target of apigenin's senomorphic suppression of the SASP in senescent cells.

irs1.en: IRS1 (insulin receptor substrate 1) is a 1242-residue cytoplasmic signalling scaffold with a PH domain, a PTB domain, and a large unstructured tail bearing dozens of phosphotyrosine and phosphoserine motifs. It transduces insulin and IGF1R signals to PI3K-AKT-mTOR and RAS-MAPK, and its serine phosphorylation by S6K is the canonical mechanism of nutritionally induced insulin resistance.

hallmarks_of_aging.en: The hallmarks of aging are the interconnected molecular and cellular changes that drive progressive loss of physiological integrity across organisms.

dasatinib.en: Chemical properties: Dasatinib is a chemical substance with defined molecular structure, functional groups, and physicochemical properties that determine its biological activity.

tlr7.en: Endosomal Toll-like receptor 7 that senses single-stranded RNA in endolysosomal compartments and drives type I interferon and NF-kappaB inflammatory signalling in plasmacytoid dendritic cells and B cells.

carboxyethyllysine.en: N-epsilon-carboxyethyllysine (CEL) is a methylglyoxal-derived advanced glycation

autophagy_inducer.en: An Autophagy Inducer is a substance or intervention that stimulates

optn.en: Autophagy receptor that functions as a primary mitophagy receptor in the PINK1/Parkin pathway and also mediates anterograde axonal mitochondrial transport.

ask1.en: Apoptosis signal-regulating kinase 1 (ASK1), also known as MAP3K5, is a ~155 kDa serine-threonine MAP kinase kinase kinase that activates the JNK and p38 MAPK pathways in response to cellular stresses including ROS, TNF-α, LPS, ER stress, and calcium overload.

non_coding_rna.en: Non-coding RNA (ncRNA) refers to RNA molecules that are not translated

atg.en: Atg (autophagy-related) proteins are a family of evolutionarily conserved

bdnf.en: BDNF (Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor) is a member of the Neurotrophin

gasdermin_d.en: A pore-forming effector protein cleaved by inflammatory caspases to execute pyroptosis and drive IL-1 family cytokine release.

aminochromes.en: Aminochromes are a class of deep-colored, cyclic indole-quinone

wnt.en: The Wnt signaling pathway is a conserved network regulating development and tissue homeostasis; dysregulated Wnt/β-catenin signaling drives colorectal, breast, and many other cancers, and is a target of repurposed agents such as ivermectin.

lkb1.en: Liver kinase B1 (STK11) is a tumor suppressor serine/threonine kinase and the primary upstream kinase activating AMPK under energy stress; deacetylated by SIRT1 and SIRT3 to coordinate metabolic adaptation, autophagy induction, and tumour suppression.

nucleosome_remodeling.en: Nucleosome Remodeling is the ATP-dependent process by which Nucleosome

vamp8.en: VAMP8 (endobrevin) is a broadly expressed v-SNARE that mediates homotypic endosome and lysosome fusion and, in exocrine and endocrine cells, drives granule-to-granule fusion during sequential compound exocytosis.

c_rel.en: NF-kappaB family transcription factor that forms p50/c-Rel and p52/RelB dimers with distinct roles in inflammatory, survival and immune tolerance signalling and is oncogenic in lymphoma.

arginine.en: Arginine (L-arginine) is a basic amino acid involved in protein synthesis,

5_azacytidine.en: 5-Azacytidine (5-aza-CR; trade name Vidaza) is a ribose nucleoside analog of cytidine that functions as a dual DNA Methyltransferase (DNMT) inhibitor and RNA incorporation agent.

bladder_cancer.en: Bladder cancer is a common malignancy of the urinary tract, with approximately 550,000 new cases worldwide annually. It is the 4th most common cancer in men, with a peak incidence at age 65–70 and a male-to-female ratio of 4:1.

microprocessor_complex.en: Nuclear ribonucleoprotein complex of Drosha and DGCR8 that initiates canonical microRNA biogenesis by cleaving pri-miRNA into pre-miRNA.

p16ink4a.en: p16INK4a (encoded by the CDKN2A locus) is a cyclin-dependent kinase

ermit.en: Erythroid mitophagy; the programmed elimination of mitochondria during erythrocyte maturation, driven primarily by BNIP3L/NIX and BIM, essential for red blood cell function.

saha.en: SAHA (vorinostat) is a hydroxamic-acid pan-HDAC inhibitor and the first FDA-approved histone deacetylase inhibitor, increasing histone acetylation and derepressing gene expression.

coordinated_lysosomal_expression_and_reg.en: The CLEAR network, a TFEB-driven transcriptional program coordinating lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy, integrated with mTOR and sirtuin/PGC-1α quality-control pathways.

reprogramming.en: The conversion of a cell's identity or epigenetic state to another — from nuclear transfer and Yamanaka-factor iPSC generation to partial reprogramming for in vivo rejuvenation; the experimental foundation of epigenetic aging research.

sympathetic_nerve_endings.en: The terminals of the sympathetic nervous system where neurotransmitters

dalteparin.en: A low-molecular-weight heparin fragment given subcutaneously as a once- or twice-daily anticoagulant for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis and treatment. Its longer half-life and predictable, weight-based non-monitored dosing distinguish it from unfractionated heparin, and the CLOT trial made it the preferred first-line agent for extended VTE treatment in cancer.

ketogenesis.en: Ketogenesis is the metabolic process by which the liver produces

cobalamin.en: Cobalamin is the cobalt corrinoid vitamin B12, an essential cofactor for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and methionine synthase. It is synthesised exclusively by bacteria and archaea, and its only human cofactor roles are one-carbon remethylation and rearrangements of 1,2-carbon skeletons.

pai_1.en: Plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 (SERPINE1), a key pro-fibrotic SASP factor and leading plasma senescence biomarker.

smurf1.en: HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase that constrains TGF-beta superfamily signalling by ubiquitinating receptor-regulated SMADs; it is a negative regulator of osteoblast differentiation and bone mass, and its loss is embryonic lethal in mice.

pathogenic_threshold_of_neuromelanin.en: The Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin is a hypothesized intracellular level of Neuromelanin accumulation above which neuronal proteostasis and organelle function fail, triggering neurodegeneration as seen in Parkinson's Disease.

phagosome.en: A phagosome is the membrane-bound compartment a phagocyte forms around an ingested particle; its maturation through sequential fusion with early, intermediate, and late endosomes and lysosomes — driven by Rab5 to Rab7 GTPase switching — delivers the cargo to degradative proteases and acid.

cebpbeta.en: CEBPβ (CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein beta) is a transcription factor

g_protein_coupled_receptor.en: GPCRs are the largest family of cell-surface membrane receptors, built from

renal_cell_carcinoma.en: A kidney cancer that originates in the lining of the proximal convoluted

ikk_complex.en: The IκB kinase complex that phosphorylates IκB inhibitors to activate NF-κB signaling.

tlr4.en: Toll-like receptor 4, a cell-surface innate immune receptor for LPS that signals through both MyD88 and TRIF adaptors to drive inflammation.

aneuploidy.en: The presence of an abnormal number of chromosomes in a cell.

caspase_9.en: Initiator protease of the intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway; activated within the Apoptosome formed by Cytochrome c and Apaf-1, and inhibited by XIAP and Akt-mediated phosphorylation.

inflammatory_bowel_disease.en: Chronic, relapsing inflammatory disorders of the gastrointestinal tract, principally ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease; intestinal-epithelial necroptosis via RIPK3 contributes to pathology when the FADD–caspase-8–c-FLIP suppressive complex is lost.

glucose.en: Glucose is a simple sugar with the molecular formula C6H12O6. It is a

ikkbeta.en: IKKβ (IκB kinase β) is the primary catalytic subunit of the IKK

mpeg_pcl.en: Monomethyl poly(ethylene glycol)-poly(ε-caprolactone) (MPEG-PCL) is an amphiphilic block copolymer that self-assembles into polymeric micelles for delivering hydrophobic drugs like fisetin.

26s_proteasome.en: The 26S proteasome is the ATP-dependent holoenzyme (20S core capped by one or two 19S regulatory particles) that recognizes polyubiquitin tags, unfolds the substrate, and translocates it into the catalytic core for degradation — the central effector of the ubiquitin-proteasome system.

fak.en: Focal adhesion kinase (PTK2); a non-receptor cytoplasmic tyrosine kinase that integrates integrin and growth factor signals to regulate cell survival, proliferation, and migration, and is recruited by phosphorylated Caspase-8 to promote metastasis.

abram_hoffer.en: Abram Hoffer is a concept related to Adrenochrome and catecholamine metabolism.

acetylcholine.en: The neurotransmitter and paracrine signalling molecule acting at muscarinic M1-M5 and nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, central to cholinergic anti-inflammatory reflexes, vagal tone and metabolic regulation.

l_arginine.en: L-arginine is an amino acid that serves as a primary precursor for the

eosinophils.en: Eosinophils are IL-5-driven granulocytes of myeloid lineage that degranulate a cationic, peroxidase-rich granule arsenal onto helminths and onto host tissue, making them simultaneously essential for parasite defence and drivers of allergic and fibrotic disease.

upa_upar.en: The urokinase plasminogen activator and its GPI-anchored receptor CD87, which together localize plasmin generation to the cell surface and drive fibrinolysis, matrix remodelling, migration and the lysosomal-transcription signalling axis.

aim2.en: Cytosolic double-stranded DNA sensor that assembles an inflammasome, driving pyroptosis and inflammatory cell death.

f2_isoprostanes.en: F2-Isoprostanes (F2-IsoPs) are prostaglandin-like compounds formed non-enzymatically by free radical-mediated Lipid Peroxidation of Arachidonic acid, widely considered the gold-standard biomarker for endogenous Oxidative Stress.

benzimidazole.en: Benzimidazole is a benz fused imidazole heterocycle serving as the scaffold for anthelmintic drugs (albendazole, mebendazole) and investigated as a tubulin-targeting anticancer chemotype.

microfilariae.en: Microfilariae are the motile larval stage of filarial nematodes (Onchocercidae) released by adult worms into host blood or skin; their clearance by Ivermectin and Diethylcarbamazine defines filariasis treatment success.

pruritus.en: The unpleasant cutaneous sensation that provokes scratching, carried by unmyelinated C fibres and thinly myelinated A-delta fibres to the dorsal horn; unlike pain it is not a defence against tissue injury but a disease in its own right.

cell_survival.en: Cell survival signalling is the set of pro-survival pathways — chiefly PI3K-AKT-mTOR, NF-κB and MAPK — that maintain a cell alive in the face of stress by opposing apoptosis, suppressing death-receptor output and rewiring metabolism.

creb.en: cAMP Response Element Binding Protein (CREB/CREB1) is a 43 kDa basic leucine

selenium.en: Selenium (Se) is an essential trace element that is incorporated

klf4.en: Klf4 (Krüppel-like factor 4) is a zinc-finger transcription factor regulating proliferation, differentiation, and pluripotency; it is one of the four Yamanaka reprogramming factors.

tryptophan.en: Tryptophan (Trp) is an essential amino acid required for protein synthesis and the precursor for serotonin, melatonin, and NAD+ via the kynurenine pathway.

legionella.en: Legionella is a genus of Gram-negative bacteria, chiefly L. pneumophila, transmitted by aerosolised water and causing Legionnaires' disease, a severe atypical pneumonia.

verapamil.en: Phenylalkylamine class IV antiarrhythmic and L-type calcium channel blocker used for supraventricular arrhythmia and hypertension that also inhibits P-glycoprotein and perturbs mitochondrial calcium handling.

sox2.en: Sox2 (SRY-box transcription factor 2) is a core pluripotency transcription factor and Yamanaka reprogramming factor.

avermectin.en: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones produced by Streptomyces avermectinius with potent anthelmintic and insecticidal activity; Ivermectin is the best-known derivative.

nmda_receptor.en: A glutamate-gated ion channel central to excitatory neurotransmission, synaptic plasticity, and Ca2+ signaling; implicated in seizures, stroke, and excitotoxicity, and a target of honokiol.

tfe3.en: TFE3 (Transcription Factor E3) is a member of the MiT/TFE family

foxo1.en: Transcription factor regulated by Akt that controls gluconeogenesis,

txnip.en: Thioredoxin-interacting protein (TXNIP/VDUP1/TBP-2); redox-sensitive negative regulator of thioredoxin and glucose/ROS sensor linking oxidative stress to NLRP3 inflammasome activation, IL-1β maturation, and metabolic dysfunction.

dapsone.en: Dapsone is a sulfone antibiotic and anti-inflammatory drug; its hydroxylamine metabolite is a leading cause of drug-induced methemoglobinemia and hemolysis.

pdgfr.en: Platelet-derived growth factor receptor, a family of type III receptor tyrosine kinases comprising PDGFRA and PDGFRB. Dimeric PDGF ligands bind the extracellular Ig-like domain, triggering trans-autophosphorylation on the intracellular kinase domain and recruitment of PI3K, SHP2 and PLCγ adaptors.

rsk.en: Ribosomal S6 kinase (RSK) is a family of serine/threonine kinases downstream of ERK that promotes cell survival, growth, and proliferation; it inhibits apoptosis by phosphorylating Bim, Apaf-1, and Bad.

foam_cells.en: Macrophages loaded with cholesterol and lipids; hallmark of early atherosclerotic lesions. Formed when cholesterol efflux is impaired and macrophages engulf modified (glycated/oxidized) LDL.

silver_ion.en: Bioactive Ag+ species that inhibits glutathione peroxidase and Na+,K+-ATPase, linking silver to oxidative stress.

usp9x.en: Ubiquitin specific peptidase 9 X-linked (USP9X) is a deubiquitinating enzyme that stabilizes Mcl-1 and other substrates by removing polyubiquitin chains.

loss_of_y_chromosome.en: Mosaic loss of the Y chromosome in blood with age; male-specific driver of fibrosis, immune dysregulation, cancer, and cardiovascular risk.

hippocampus.en: The Hippocampus is a limbic structure essential for memory consolidation and spatial navigation; it expresses COMT, and COMT overexpression models reveal region-specific effects on cognition.

lipid_catabolism.en: Lipid catabolism encompasses the breakdown of lipids via Lipophagy,

hlh_30.en: HLH-30 (Helix-loop-helix 30) is the C. elegans orthologue of the mammalian transcription factor TFEB/TFE3, serving as a master regulator of autophagy and lysosome biogenesis that drives lifespan extension, stress resistance, and nutrient mobilization.

pde.en: Phosphodiesterases, a superfamily of enzymes that hydrolyze the second messengers cAMP and cGMP, modulating cyclic-nucleotide signaling intersected by sirtuin and AMPK pathways.

von_willebrand_factor.en: Multimeric endothelial and platelet adhesion protein that binds platelet GPIb under shear to anchor primary haemostasis and carries and stabilizes factor VIII, with quantitative and qualitative variants causing von Willebrand disease.

elastin.en: Highly elastic structural protein of connective tissue ECM, providing

pex_genes.en: PEX genes encode the peroxins, a family of proteins required for

s_nitrosylation.en: S-Nitrosylation is a reversible post-translational modification

metabolic_plasticity.en: The capacity of cancer cells (and stem cells) to dynamically switch between glycolysis and oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) in response to tumor type, developmental stage, and microenvironmental cues — a key axis of the SIRT3-mediated redox-metabolic interplay.

jak.en: Janus kinase is a family of intracellular tyrosine kinases that transduce cytokine signals.

axon_degeneration.en: Axon degeneration is the pathological loss of axonal integrity in response to injury, disease, or metabolic stress, with SARM1-mediated Wallerian degeneration as its best-characterized execution pathway.

relocalization_of_chromatin_modifiers_rc.en: An aging framework proposing that progressive loss of epigenetic information arises from the repeated recruitment of chromatin-modifying proteins (sirtuins, HDACs, PARP1) away from their genomic loci to DNA repair sites.

natural_killer_cells.en: Innate lymphoid cells with cytotoxic activity against virus-infected and

cyp3a4.en: Catalytic function: CYP3A4 is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

pex19.en: PEX19 encodes a predominantly cytosolic chaperone and import receptor for

calmodulin.en: Calmodulin is a 148-residue four-EF-hand Ca2+ sensor that, on calcium binding, exposes a hydrophobic surface and activates hundreds of targets including CaM kinases, calcineurin, and NOS, making it the cell's most-used calcium decoder.

kif5b.en: KIF5B (Kinesin Family Member 5B) is a microtubule-based motor protein

leukotrienes.en: Leukotrienes are lipid mediators synthesised from arachidonic acid via the 5-lipoxygenase pathway; LTB4 acts mainly through BLT receptors to recruit neutrophils, while the cysteinyl leukotrienes LTC4, LTD4 and LTE4 act at CysLT1 and CysLT2 receptors to cause bronchoconstriction, mucus secretion and vascular permeability.

yerkes_dodson_law.en: The Yerkes-Dodson law is the empirical inverted-U relationship between arousal and performance, first described in 1908 from mouse discrimination-learning experiments; it is the best-known psychological expression of the biphasic dose-response underlying hormesis, though its biological interpretation as a general law is contested.

p_glycoprotein.en: P-glycoprotein (ABCB1/MDR1) is a full-length ATP-binding cassette transporter that pumps a very broad range of hydrophobic drugs and xenobiotics out of cells using ATP hydrolysis; its activity underlies both multidrug resistance in cancer and xenobiotic protection at the gut, kidney, and blood-brain barrier.

retrograde_response.en: The retrograde response (or retrograde signaling) is a communication

demyelination.en: Loss or dysfunction of myelin sheaths in the central or peripheral nervous system, producing slowed conduction, conduction block and secondary axonal degeneration in demyelinating disease.

endmt.en: EndMT is an acronym covering two related mesenchymal transitions of endothelial origin - endocardial-to-mesenchymal transition during heart development, and the pathological endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition that supplies fibroblast-like cells to fibrosis.

hydroxychloroquine.en: Hydroxychloroquine is a 4-aminoquinoline antimalarial and immunomodulator that also inhibits autophagy by raising lysosomal pH.

isourolithin_a.en: Isourolithin A is a gut-microbial ellagitannin metabolite and isomer of urolithin A, sharing mitophagy-inducing and antioxidant activities.

tuberculosis.en: A chronic granulomatous infection caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis, characterised by caseating granulomas, latent infection in about a quarter of the world's population, and a drug regimen complicated by multi-month multidrug therapy and rising antimicrobial resistance.

clathrin.en: Clathrin is a three-legged scaffold protein that polymerises into the lattice of clathrin-coated pits and vesicles, the entry route for receptor-mediated endocytosis at the plasma membrane and at endosomes.

insulin_signaling.en: Insulin signaling is a conserved growth factor pathway that regulates

dysbiosis.en: Disruption of the composition and functional balance of the commensal microbiota, linked to inflammation, metabolic disease, and accelerated aging.

coactivator.en: Transcriptional coactivators such as p300/CBP, PGC-1alpha and the SRC/p160 family translate signalling inputs into chromatin opening and transcriptional output, and are held in check by NAD+-dependent sirtuins and HDACs.

detoxification.en: Detoxification is the physiological or medicinal removal of toxic substances

pulmonary_embolism.en: Obstruction of the pulmonary arterial tree by thrombus, most often from a deep vein thrombosis in the leg, producing ventilation-perfusion mismatch and acute right ventricular strain; a leading cause of preventable death and frequently presenting with shock or cardiac arrest.

lir_motif.en: The LC3-interacting region, a short hydrophobic peptide motif that directs autophagy receptors and cargo proteins to LC3/GABARAP family proteins on the phagophore.

rab7.en: Rab7 is a late endosome/lysosome small GTPase that regulates autophagosome-lysosome fusion, organelle positioning, and endolysosomal maturation downstream of Rab5.

lxralpha.en: Liver X receptor alpha (LXRα) is a nuclear receptor that plays a central

dystrophin.en: A 427 kDa rod-shaped cytoskeletal protein encoded by the DMD gene on Xp21, located at the inner surface of the muscle fibre sarcolemma where it links the actin cytoskeleton to the dystrophin-associated glycoprotein complex in the extracellular matrix. Its absence causes Duchenne muscular dystrophy; its reduction causes Becker muscular dystrophy.

neuronophagia.en: In Parkinson's Disease, neuronophagia is a clear indicator of an active and ongoing neurodegenerative process.

barrett_s_esophagus.en: Barrett's esophagus is the replacement of the normal distal esophageal squamous epithelium by metaplastic intestinal-type columnar epithelium with goblet cells, driven by chronic gastroesophageal reflux; it is the only identifiable precursor lesion of esophageal adenocarcinoma.

strongyloides.en: Strongyloides is a genus of parasitic nematodes (family Strongyloididae); Strongyloides stercoralis is the principal human pathogen, unique for its free-living and autoinfective life cycles, with oncology relevance through immunosuppression-associated hyperinfection.

gm_csf.en: Granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor is a SASP cytokine that recruits and activates myeloid cells and serves as a senolytic-therapy response biomarker.

glucocerebrosidase.en: Glucocerebrosidase (GCase) is a lysosomal enzyme responsible for the breakdown of glucosylceramide.

celastrol.en: Celastrol is a bioactive compound that enhances TFEB-mediated autophagy

nanotechnology.en: Nanotechnology in drug delivery refers to the use of nanoscale carriers (nanoparticles, liposomes, nanoemulsions, nanocrystals) to improve the solubility, bioavailability, and therapeutic index of bioactive compounds.

lpcat3.en: LPCAT3 is a lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase that remodels membrane phospholipids with polyunsaturated fatty acids, supplying ferroptosis substrates.

systemic_inflammatory_response_syndrome.en: Sterile systemic inflammation driven by necroptotic DAMP release, as in severe pancreatitis; precursor concept to sepsis criteria.

lamp1.en: LAMP1 (Lysosomal-Associated Membrane Protein 1) is a major integral

protozoa.en: A convenience grouping of heterotrophic unicellular eukaryotes, most of which move by cilia, flagella or pseudopodia; the medically important members are the apicomplexans (Plasmodium, Toxoplasma, Cryptosporidium) and the kinetoplastid flagellates (Leishmania, Trypanosoma).

wnt16b.en: A Wnt ligand and canonical SASP factor secreted by therapy-damaged stromal cells that promotes cancer therapy resistance; its expression is suppressed by apigenin.

dcr1.en: DcR1 (TRAIL-R3/TNFRSF10C) is a TNF-superfamily decoy receptor that sequesters TRAIL without a functional death domain, sparing normal cells and contributing to tumour resistance to TRAIL-based therapies.

dna_polymerase.en: Family of enzymes that synthesize DNA by adding deoxynucleotides to a growing strand during replication and repair.

bok.en: Pro-apoptotic BCL-2 family protein that regulates mitophagy flux by facilitating Parkin translocation to damaged mitochondria in Alzheimer's disease.

n6_methyladenosine.en: The most abundant internal mRNA methylation mark (m6A), deposited by the METTL3-METTL14 writer complex and implicated in senescence-associated transcriptomic and 3D-genome remodeling.

top1.en: Topoisomerase 1, whose trapped cleavage complexes (TOP1cc) license cGAS recognition of cytoplasmic chromatin fragments to trigger SASP via cGAS–STING.

zbp1.en: Cytosolic Z-nucleic-acid sensor that triggers PANoptosis and cell death, including in viral encephalitis via STING/MAVS.

hepatitis_b_virus.en: Hepatotropic DNA virus causing acute and chronic hepatitis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma

disease_associated_microglia.en: A defined microglial activation signature in neurodegeneration, distinct from the cGAS-driven IFN-I-enriched microglial state.

chelating_agents.en: Substances that form coordinate bonds with metal ions, forming stable ring structures that sequester metals and facilitate their excretion or biological inactivation.

chemokines.en: Chemokines are a family of small chemotactic cytokines that direct immune cell migration and are key components of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP).

chlorpromazine.en: Chlorpromazine is the first antipsychotic phenothiazine; its position-10 side chain destroys methylene blue-like mitochondrial electron-transfer activity, leaving only weak, pro-oxidative neuroprotection.

coumadin.en: The Bristol-Myers Squibb brand name for warfarin sodium, the oral coumarin-derived vitamin K antagonist that inhibits VKORC1 and blocks gamma-carboxylation of the vitamin K-dependent clotting factors; the branded product was discontinued in 2020 and generic warfarin remains available.

alpha_ketoglutarate.en: α-Ketoglutarate (α-KG) is a key TCA cycle intermediate derived from glutamine and glutamate; serves as a metabolic hub linking carbon metabolism to biosynthesis, epigenetic regulation, and signaling.

tet_enzymes.en: Catalytic function: TET enzymes is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

hmgcs2.en: 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2 (HMGCS2) is the rate-limiting mitochondrial enzyme of ketogenesis, converting acetyl-CoA to HMG-CoA; it is activated by SIRT5 desuccinylation.

doramectin.en: Semi-synthetic avermectin endectocide (Dectomax) developed primarily for livestock — cattle, sheep and swine — with a longer half-life than Ivermectin; P-glycoprotein substrate with a narrow margin in MDR1-affected dogs and no dog-labeled indications.

rilp.en: Rab7-interacting lysosomal protein, a Rab effector composed of an N-terminal dynein-dynactin recruiting module and a C-terminal Rab7-binding coiled coil that forms a dyad; it is the principal minus-end motor adaptor positioning late endosomes and lysosomes perinuclearly.

redox_battery.en: A conceptual adrenochrome-protocol term describing a reservable pool of reducing equivalents (NAD+/NADH and glutathione) that buffers redox stress during adrenochrome handling.

promethazine.en: Promethazine is a 10-nitrogen-substituted phenothiazine antihistamine/antiemetic; like chlorpromazine it lacks methylene blue-like mitochondrial electron-transfer activity and shows weak neuroprotection.

bmal1.en: Core circadian clock transcription factor (ARNTL); heterodimerizes with CLOCK to drive rhythmic gene expression and is deacetylated/activated by SIRT1.

wrn.en: Werner syndrome helicase, a DNA-repair enzyme deacetylated and activated by SIRT1, linking sirtuins to genomic stability.

noise_induced_hearing_loss.en: Noise-induced hearing loss is sensorineural hearing damage caused by loud noise exposure, which nicotinamide riboside prevents via a SIRT3-dependent, NAD+-supporting mechanism in the inner ear.

dcr2.en: DcR2 (TRAIL-R4/TNFRSF10D) is a TNF-superfamily decoy receptor that binds TRAIL without a functional death domain, modulating TRAIL-induced apoptosis and representing a target for combination strategies that block decoy receptors.

roscovitine.en: Roscovitine (seliciclib) is a purine analog cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that blocks CDK2, CDK5, CDK7, and CDK9, inducing cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis, with applications in oncology and neuroprotection.

epigenetic_clock.en: An Epigenetic Clock is a biochemical estimator of biological age based on DNA Methylation changes at specific CpG sites that accrue predictably with age.

j147.en: A curcumin-derived small molecule from the Maher lab that potently inhibits ferroptosis/lipid peroxidation; completed Phase 1 clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease.

pyridoxamine.en: Pyridoxamine is a vitamin B6 vitamer that acts as a carbonyl trap, inhibiting

hnf4alpha.en: HNF4α (Hepatocyte Nuclear Factor 4 Alpha, encoded by HNF4A) is an orphan

pidd.en: p53-induced death domain protein (PIDD; LRDD) is a component of the PIDDosome complex involved in Caspase-2 activation, p53-dependent apoptosis, and NF-κB signaling.

24_s_hydroxycholesterol.en: Brain-derived oxysterol made by neuronal CYP46A1; LXR ligand and neurodegeneration biomarker with biphasic amyloid/necroptotic actions.

exercise_hormesis.en: Exercise-induced transient ROS that drives Nrf2-BDNF, autophagy, and mitochondrial adaptation in neurodegeneration models

apoptosome.en: The Apoptosome is a large, wheel-like heptameric multi-protein complex that forms during the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis to activate Caspase-9.

cerebellum.en: The Cerebellum is a hindbrain structure controlling motor coordination, balance, and motor learning; it is largely spared by forebrain-specific COMT-overexpressing transgenes and serves as a control region in COMT research.

cystatin_c.en: Cysteine protease inhibitor and kidney-function biomarker integrated into GrimAge epigenetic clocks.

cyld.en: The K63/M1 deubiquitinase cylindromatosis that strips ubiquitin from RIPK1, TRAF2 and TRAF6 — the enzymatic switch converting TNFR1 complex I survival signaling into complex II death signaling.

bik.en: Bik (Bcl-2-interacting killer) is a BH3-only protein whose degradation is promoted by SRC kinase through an ERK-dependent mechanism, suppressing Apoptosis and favoring tumor survival.

agk2.en: AGK2 is a potent, cell-permeable, and selective small-molecule inhibitor

shp1.en: Protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 6 (PTPN6); dephosphorylates Caspase-8 at Tyr380, restoring apoptotic sensitivity in cancer cells.

deiodinase.en: Iodothyronine deiodinases (DIO1–DIO3) are selenium-dependent selenoenzymes that activate and inactivate thyroid hormone by removing specific iodine atoms, controlling local triiodothyronine availability.

ice_mouse.en: Inducible Changes in the Epigenome (ICE) mouse — a mammalian model using I-PpoI to induce mutation-free double-strand breaks, demonstrating RCM-driven epigenetic aging.

brca.en: BRCA (BReast CAncer gene) refers to BRCA1 and BRCA2 tumor suppressor genes encoding proteins essential for homologous recombination DNA repair; germline mutations predispose to breast, ovarian, and other cancers.

interleukin_33.en: Interleukin-33 is an IL-1-family alarmin and IL-1β-dependent SASP factor secreted by senescent hepatic stellate cells that promotes hepatocellular carcinoma.

cell_migration.en: Directed cell movement via actin remodeling, adhesion turnover, and growth-factor guidance.

slc25a1.en: Mitochondrial citrate carrier (CIC) that exports citrate from the mitochondrial matrix to the cytosol, where it is converted to acetyl-CoA by ACLY. Upregulated in cellular senescence; its inhibition suppresses the SASP and improves healthspan in aged mice.

protein_c.en: A vitamin K-dependent plasma serine protease zymogen that acts as the pivot of the natural anticoagulant system, activated on endothelium by the thrombin-thrombomodulin complex to inactivate factors Va and VIIIa and shut down thrombin generation.

retinal_pigment_epithelium.en: The retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) is a single layer of pigmented cells between the neurosensory retina and Bruch's membrane, essential for phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segments, the visual cycle (RPE65), blood-retina barrier function, and ion/fluid homeostasis; dysfunction underlies age-related macular degeneration and is a target for iPSC-RPE cell therapy.

sh_sy5y.en: A human neuroblastoma cell line differentiated into neuron-like cells, widely used as a dopaminergic neuron model.

methyl_beta_cyclodextrin.en: Cyclodextrin derivative used as a solubilizing vehicle to increase water solubility of poorly soluble drugs.

diaziquone.en: Diaziquone is a chemical compound and aziridinylbenzoquinone that acts as a DNA cross-linker, primarily studied for its potential in treating brain tumors.

kynurenic_acid.en: Kynurenic acid (KynA) is a neuroactive metabolite of the kynurenine pathway that acts as an NMDA receptor antagonist, providing neuroprotection that counterbalances the excitotoxic effects of quinolinic acid.

macromolecular_crowding.en: Macromolecular crowding is the high concentration of macromolecules in the cellular environment, which can physically interfere with intracellular trafficking, signaling, and proteostasis.

BIG1 has also been used in older literature for the casein kinase II regulatory beta subunit, so the expansion "B-cell immunoglobulin gene product 1" should not be treated as authoritative.

rna_polymerase_ii.en: RNA polymerase II is the twelve-subunit eukaryotic enzyme that transcribes all protein-coding genes and most non-coding RNAs; its largest-subunit C-terminal domain is a heptad-repeat landing pad whose phosphorylation pattern coordinates capping, elongation, splicing and termination.

alveolar_macrophages.en: Resident macrophages of the lung alveolus that sample airspace contents and drive inflammatory responses in fibrosis and infection.

pons.en: The Pons is a brainstem region between the Medulla Oblongata and midbrain that houses the Locus Coeruleus, the principal source of central Norepinephrine and a neuromelanin-rich nucleus vulnerable in Parkinson's Disease.

amyloid_precursor_protein.en: A type I transmembrane protein whose proteolytic cleavage produces amyloid-beta peptides implicated in Alzheimer's Disease

gnathostoma.en: Gnathostoma is a genus of parasitic nematodes (gnathostomes, "jaw worms") of which G. spinigerum is the principal cause of human gnathostomiasis. Third-stage infective larvae penetrate the gut wall after ingestion and then migrate through tissues, producing recurrent migratory swellings and occasionally eosinophilic meningitis.

glucose_intolerance.en: A pre-diabetic state of impaired glucose handling in which blood glucose remains above normal but below the diabetic threshold; a recognized metabolic effect of chronic mTOR inhibition.

mptp.en: MPTP is lipid-soluble and can cross the blood-brain barrier.

sv40.en: Simian Virus 40 (SV40) is a polyomavirus whose large and small T antigens dysregulate p53 and Rb tumor suppressors; historically linked (controversially) to human cancers and exploited as a cell-penetrating peptide in anticancer research.

ldl_receptor.en: The LDL receptor (LDLR) is the cell-surface, clathrin-mediated endocytic receptor that clears LDL from plasma by binding apolipoprotein B; it is the rate-limiting step of receptor-mediated cholesterol uptake and the mutated gene in most familial hypercholesterolaemia.

tgfbeta_superfamily.en: A large family of cytokines, including TGF-β1 and activin A, that signal through serine/threonine kinase receptors and SMAD transcription factors to regulate cell fate, proliferation, and inflammation.

cetor.en: CeTOR (let-363) is the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian mTORC1.

hpp.en: HPP+ (4-(4-chlorophenyl)-1-[4-(4-fluorophenyl)-4-oxobutyl]pyridinium) is a toxic pyridinium metabolite of Haloperidol that is structurally similar to MPP+ and may induce neurotoxicity.

citrate_synthase.en: The first and rate-limiting enzyme of the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle, catalysing condensation of acetyl-CoA with oxaloacetate to form citrate. Citrate synthase activity is a marker of mitochondrial content and is induced in muscle by endurance training.

moxidectin.en: Macrocyclic lactone endectocide of the milbemycin class (ProHeart 6, Advantage Multi) used for heartworm prevention and intestinal parasites in dogs; more potent and longer-acting than Ivermectin, with a narrower dose margin in MDR1-affected dogs.

tgf_beta3.en: Transforming growth factor beta 3 (TGF-β3) is a cytokine of the TGF-β superfamily involved in development, tissue repair, and immune regulation; it can exert both tumor-suppressive and pro-metastatic roles, and its RGD motif is exploited for tumor-targeted anticancer peptides.

mitoq.en: MitoQ (Mitoquinone mesylate) is a mitochondria-targeted antioxidant composed of a ubiquinone (Coenzyme Q10) moiety covalently linked to a triphenylphosphonium cation, enabling selective accumulation in the mitochondrial matrix.

macrophage_polarization.en: Functional reprogramming of macrophages toward proinflammatory (M1) or anti-inflammatory/tissue-repair (M2) phenotypes in response to environmental cues

myod.en: MyoD (Myogenic Differentiation 1, also known as MYOD1) is a pioneer basic

cyclic_dinucleotide.en: Second messengers (e.g., 2′3′-cGAMP) and STING agonists that activate STING to drive type I interferon responses.

pcna.en: Proliferating cell nuclear antigen is a homotrimeric ring-shaped sliding clamp loaded onto DNA by RFC that gives replicative polymerases their processivity and acts as a mobile docking platform whose ubiquitin and SUMO modifications switch the cell between translesion synthesis and template switching.

manganism.en: Manganism is a neurological disorder caused by chronic exposure to Manganese, characterized by motor symptoms that resemble Parkinson''s Disease but typically involve different pathological mechanisms.

ifitm3.en: Interferon-induced transmembrane protein 3, an antiviral restriction factor enriched in plasma exosomes of elderly individuals that induces paracrine senescence.

pde5_inhibitors.en: A class of drugs that inhibit phosphodiesterase type 5, used for erectile dysfunction, pulmonary arterial hypertension, and benign prostatic hyperplasia; noted for multi-indication anti-aging potential.

ido2.en: Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 2 (IDO2) is a less active paralog of IDO1 that catalyzes the same tryptophan-to-N-formylkynurenine reaction but with much lower catalytic efficiency, and may act as a negative regulator of IDO1.

nb_4746.en: NB-4746 is a brain-penetrant, clinical-stage SARM1 inhibitor developed by Nura Bio for axon-degeneration disorders, including chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy and traumatic brain injury.

pad4.en: Peptidylarginine deiminase 4 — the calcium-dependent histone-citrullinating enzyme that drives chromatin decondensation in NETosis and marks cit-H3-positive inflammatory death.

quinones.en: Quinones are reactive electrophilic compounds generated from catecholamine oxidation; they contribute to Oxidative Stress, protein adduct formation, and Neuromelanin biosynthesis in catecholaminergic neurons.

mapkapk2.en: Mitogen-activated protein kinase-activated protein kinase 2, a key regulator of SASP mRNA stability.

hdac4.en: Histone deacetylase 4, a catalytically inactive class IIa HDAC that acts as an epigenetic reader of H3K27ac and normally buffers the AP-1-driven SASP program until it is degraded upon senescence entry.
