hannum_clock.en: A blood-based epigenetic clock estimating chronological age from DNA methylation, trained on whole-blood samples.

anaphase_promoting_complex_cyclosome.en: A large, multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase that serves as a master regulator of the cell cycle, driving transitions from metaphase to anaphase and facilitating mitotic exit.

vegfr2.en: The principal receptor for VEGF-A and, after proteolytic processing, VEGF-C on blood vascular endothelium, driving angiogenesis with distinct downstream signaling outputs.

erythropoietin.en: The renal hypoxia-induced hematopoietic cytokine (EPO) driving erythropoiesis — reported protective against eryptosis, though direct anti-eryptotic action is inferred rather than demonstrated.

tgf_beta_receptor.en: TGF-beta receptors are transmembrane serine/threonine kinase receptors that transduce TGF-beta ligand signals via SMAD proteins, regulating cell growth, differentiation, immune tolerance, and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition.

monoacylglycerol_lipase.en: Monoacylglycerol lipase (MGL, MGLL) is the final-step adipocyte lipase that hydrolyzes monoacylglycerol to glycerol and free fatty acid, completing triglyceride catabolism during lipolysis.

neuropilin_1.en: Neuropilin-1 (NRP-1) is a transmembrane co-receptor for VEGF and semaphorins that promotes tumor angiogenesis, vascular permeability, and endocytic uptake of tumor-penetrating peptides.

oxaloacetate.en: The four-carbon TCA-cycle intermediate converted to malate by malate dehydrogenase; central to the oxaloacetate-malate redox couple that sets cytosolic NAD+/NADH and influences senescence.

phenylbutyrate.en: 4-Phenylbutyrate (PB) is an FDA-approved aromatic fatty acid used for urea cycle disorders that functions as a class I/IIA HDAC inhibitor, induces Hsp70 expression, reduces ER stress, and has been investigated in ALS, Huntington's disease, and cancer.

taxanes.en: Taxanes are microtubule-stabilizing chemotherapy agents — paclitaxel, docetaxel and cabazitaxel — that bind the β-tubulin taxane site, suppress microtubule dynamics, arrest mitosis in metaphase, and convert the arrest into apoptosis.

alox15.en: ALOX15 (arachidonate 15-lipoxygenase) is a lipid-peroxidating enzyme that cooperates with p53/SAT1 signaling to execute ferroptosis.

pancreatic_ductal_adenocarcinoma.en: The most common pancreatic cancer, in which NMN supplementation in oncogenic mouse models promotes progression by increasing pro-inflammatory senescence, highlighting context-dependent effects of NAD+ precursors.

iron_sulfur_clusters.en: Iron-sulfur clusters are small inorganic Fe-S cofactor assemblies, most often [2Fe-2S] and [4Fe-4S], built on the ISCU scaffold by the NFS1 desulfurase machinery and inserted into proteins needing electron transfer, catalysis or stress sensing; their loss causes aconitase failure, cluster-free complex II and neurodegeneration.

gardos_channel.en: KCa3.1 (KCNN4), the Ca2+-activated K+ channel of erythrocytes whose opening drives K+ efflux, hyperpolarization, Cl- and water loss, and the cell shrinkage of eryptosis; blocked by charybdotoxin and clotrimazole.

topologically_associating_domain.en: Megabase-scale chromosomal domain within which DNA sequences contact each other more frequently than with outside sequences, organizing enhancer-promoter interactions that regulate SASP in senescence.

amelparib.en: JPI-289, a water-soluble small-molecule PARP-1 inhibitor that targets parthanatos in ischemia-reperfusion; the only parthanatos-directed program to reach clinical testing (Ph2a in acute ischemic stroke, up to now run without sex stratification despite male-biased efficacy in preclinical stroke).

glut4.en: GLUT4 (SLC2A4) is the insulin-responsive glucose transporter that translocates from intracellular vesicles to the plasma membrane of muscle and adipose cells to enable postprandial glucose uptake.

mus_musculus.en: The house mouse, a widely used mammalian model organism in biomedical research, including senescence and aging studies.

iba1.en: Ionized calcium-binding adaptor molecule 1 (AIF1), a microglial/macrophage actin-crosslinking protein used as a marker of myeloid cells.

bmf.en: Bmf (Bcl-2-modifying factor) is a BH3-only protein whose pro-apoptotic activity is suppressed by ERK2 phosphorylation at Ser77 and by sequestration at the actin cytoskeleton.

varicella_zoster_virus.en: Human alphaherpesvirus causing chickenpox (primary infection) and establishing lifelong latency that can reactivate as herpes zoster (shingles).

pvp.en: Polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP, povidone) is a water-soluble synthetic polymer used as an excipient and nanoparticle stabilizer to improve the dissolution and bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs such as fisetin.

socs3.en: Suppressor of Cytokine Signaling 3 (SOCS3) is a negative-feedback regulator of cytokine signaling that targets IDO1 for ubiquitination and degradation.

tfam.en: Mitochondrial transcription factor A, a nuclear-encoded regulator of mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, and nucleoid architecture; induced by mTOR inhibition to support mitochondrial renewal.

p16.en: Cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 2A, a critical tumor suppressor and cell cycle regulator that enforces senescence via the p16/RB pathway

ddcbe.en: DddA-derived cytosine base editors, a class of programmable base-editing tools that make targeted C-to-T edits in mitochondrial DNA without creating double-strand breaks; an emerging approach to correct pathogenic mtDNA mutations.

arn14974.en: A potent and systemically active benzoxazolone carboxamide inhibitor of acid ceramidase (IC50 79 nM) that reduces ACase activity across multiple organs including brain; developed by Pizzirani et al. and related to ARN14794.

interleukin_11.en: Interleukin-11 is a senescence-induced gp130/STAT3-driving osteokine and pro-fibrotic SASP factor linked to osteoporosis, pulmonary and cardiac fibrosis.

mtdna.en: Mitochondrial DNA that can be released into the cytosol to activate

upram.en: Unfolded protein response activated by mistargeting of proteins. A stress pathway triggered when mitochondrial proteins are misdirected to other organelles or accumulate in the cytosol.

n_carboxymethyl_lysine.en: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a well-characterized and major compound

end_stage_renal_disease.en: End stage renal disease (ESRD) is the final, permanent stage of chronic

hmgb2.en: High-mobility-group-box chromatin architectural protein that is depleted upon senescence entry and that protects SASP gene loci from repressive heterochromatinization in oncogene-induced senescence.

sestrin2.en: Sestrin2 is an amino acid sensor that inhibits mTORC1 activity by interacting

liver_x_receptor.en: Nuclear receptor (LXRα/LXRβ) regulating cholesterol and lipid homeostasis; deacetylated and modulated by SIRT1.

t_cell.en: T cells are adaptive immune lymphocytes whose development, activation, proliferation, memory formation, and metabolic fitness depend on autophagy for organelle quality control and nutrient recycling.

butyrate.en: Butyrate is a four-carbon short-chain fatty acid produced by gut bacteria,

srcap.en: SRCAP is an ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler of the SNF2 family that forms the SRCAP complex, the vertebrate Swr1 ortholog responsible for depositing the H2A.Z histone variant into nucleosomes, and also functions as a transcriptional coactivator for CREBBP-dependent steroid receptor signalling.

senp1.en: Sentrin/SUMO-specific protease 1; cleaves SUMO from conjugated substrates (deSUMOylation), regulating protein localization, stability, and activity across stress responses.

senolytics.en: A class of small molecules and peptides that selectively induce death in senescent cells by targeting senescent cell anti-apoptotic pathways (SCAPs).

naked_mole_rat.en: A long-lived, cancer-resistant rodent model exhibiting muted cGAS-STING signaling despite genomic instability.

glucose_oxidase.en: Glucose oxidase (GOx) is an enzyme that generates extracellular H2O2 from glucose; its HT-22 neurotoxicity model is a direct oxidative-stress insult that methylene blue cannot protect against.

inulin.en: Inulin is a non-digestible fructan oligosaccharide used as a prebiotic and as a nanodimensional carrier that enhances the solubility and stability of hydrophobic bioactives such as fisetin.

annexin_v.en: Annexin V is a member of the annexin family of calcium-dependent phospholipid-binding proteins, widely used as a marker for Phosphatidylserine exposure in cells undergoing Apoptosis.

mef2c.en: Myocyte enhancer factor 2C, a transcription factor orchestrating neuronal resilience and axon morphology gene networks suppressed by cGAS-STING/IFN-I signaling.

dot1l.en: Disruptor of telomeric silencing 1-like (KMT4), the sole H3K79 methyltransferase whose inhibition suppresses SASP without releasing the senescence arrest.

sirreal2.en: SirReal2 is a highly potent, selective, and structurally unique

ptp1b.en: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase 1B (PTP1B/PTPN1) is a 50 kDa non-receptor tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and inactivates the Insulin Receptor (IR) and Insulin Receptor Substrate (IRS) proteins, serving as a major negative regulator of insulin signaling.

axonal_degeneration.en: Axonal degeneration is the pathological disintegration of nerve fibers that follows injury or neurodegenerative disease, driven in part by SARM1-dependent NAD+ depletion, and is prevented by NAD+ precursors such as nicotinamide riboside.

snail.en: Snail (SNAI1) is a zinc-finger transcription factor and a key inducer of the Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition, repressing E-cadherin and epithelial adhesion.

teratoma.en: A Teratoma is a germ-cell tumor containing differentiated tissues from multiple lineages; in stem-cell research it validates pluripotency.

fatty_acid_synthase.en: A multifunctional enzyme (FASN) that catalyzes de novo long-chain fatty acid synthesis and is overexpressed in many cancers, making it a metabolic therapeutic target.

saccharomyces_cerevisiae.en: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (budding yeast) is a foundational Model Organism

inflammatory_diseases.en: Chronic diseases driven by unresolved inflammation, from arthritis and IBD to psoriasis and atherosclerosis.

addiction.en: Addiction is a chronic, relapsing disorder characterized by compulsive drug seeking, continued use despite harmful consequences, and long-lasting changes in the brain.

a1_bfl_1.en: A1/Bfl-1 (Bcl-2-related protein A1), encoded by the BCL2A1 gene, is an anti-apoptotic member of the Bcl-2 family.

non_rem_sleep.en: Non-REM (NREM) sleep is the restorative phase of sleep characterized by slow-wave activity, which honokiol promotes by acting at the benzodiazepine site of GABA-A receptors.

premote.en: PREMOTE is a multi-center randomized trial showing berberine lowers HbA1c with gut-microbiome shifts, directly linking metabolic benefit to microbiome mechanisms.

ehlers_danlos_syndrome.en: Ehlers-Danlos syndromes are a heterogeneous group of heritable connective tissue disorders caused by defects in collagen structure or processing, characterised by joint hypermobility, skin hyperextensibility, tissue fragility and, in the vascular type, arterial and organ rupture.

olaparib.en: First-in-class PARP inhibitor exploiting synthetic lethality in BRCA-deficient cancers.

transcriptomic_aging.en: Age-related shifts in gene-expression programs (transcriptome) reflecting dysregulated stress-response, inflammatory, and senescence pathways.

c9orf72.en: C9orf72, an ALS/FTD-associated gene whose repeat expansions drive cGAS-STING activation via nucleocytoplasmic transport defects and DNA damage.

urea_cycle.en: Liver metabolic pathway for ammonia detoxification whose enzymes, including CPS1, are regulated by SIRT5 via desuccinylation/demalonylation.

cyclin_d1.en: A G1/S regulatory cyclin that, with CDK4, phosphorylates Rb and also opposes SIRT1-dependent regulation of cell-cycle genes; the cyclin D1/CDK4 complex is a negative regulator of SIRT1.

skeletal_muscle.en: Overview: Skeletal Muscle is a specialized cellular or anatomical structure with defined functions in tissue organization and physiology.

srebp2.en: Sterol regulatory element-binding protein 2; a basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factor that activates genes of cholesterol biosynthesis and uptake; negatively regulated by SIRT6.

Sulfated GAGs are covalently attached to core proteins to form proteoglycans; hyaluronan is the exception, being non-sulfated and core-protein-free.

conjugated_dienes.en: Products of lipid peroxidation formed during LDL and HDL oxidation; markers of oxidative stress; measured at 234 nm absorbance.

cholesterol_influx.en: The movement of cholesterol from the extracellular environment into cells; opposite of cholesterol efflux; reduced by resveratrol.

honeybee.en: The European honeybee (Apis mellifera) is a species used medicinally for millennia; its products — honey, propolis, and venom — have documented anticancer properties, chiefly via melittin.

thrombin.en: Catalytic function: Thrombin is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

asc.en: Apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a CARD; the adaptor that nucleates inflammasome assembly and ASC specks downstream of AIM2/NLRP3.

somatic_cells.en: Somatic cells are the differentiated, non-germ body cells of an organism

type_i_interferon.en: Family of interferons (IFN-alpha/beta) produced downstream of innate immune sensors that drive antiviral and inflammatory transcriptional programs.

tir_domain.en: The TIR (Toll/IL-1 Receptor) domain is the C-terminal catalytic core of SARM1, harboring the NAD+ glycohydrolase active site whose dimerization drives axonal NAD+ depletion and Wallerian degeneration.

icf_syndrome.en: A rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by DNMT3B mutations, characterized by immunodeficiency, centromere instability, facial anomalies, and hypomethylation of pericentromeric satellite repeats.

ugt1a1.en: UGT1A1 is the uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase 1A1 enzyme, a phase II conjugating enzyme in the ER that glucuronidates bilirubin and the active metabolite SN-38; reduced activity causes Gilbert syndrome and predicts irinotecan toxicity.

pirfenidone.en: Pirfenidone is an antifibrotic and anti-inflammatory drug tested as a senotherapeutic candidate in a flavonoid screen, with no significant senolytic activity at 5 μM.

tauopathy.en: Neurodegenerative diseases characterized by pathological aggregation of the microtubule-associated protein tau.

flavonol.en: Flavonols are a subclass of flavonoid polyphenols characterized by a 3-hydroxyflavone backbone; fisetin and quercetin are prominent members with senotherapeutic and antioxidant activity.

valine.en: Essential branched-chain amino acid that is fully glucogenic, entering the TCA cycle via succinyl-CoA. Valine restriction reduces body weight, improves metabolic health, reduces hepatic senescence, and extends lifespan of male mice; dysregulated valine catabolism contributes to insulin resistance.

vla_4.en: VLA-4 is the alpha4beta1 (CD49d/CD29) integrin that couples T-lymphocyte firm adhesion to VCAM-1 on inflamed endothelium and to fibronectin in tissue; blockade with anti-alpha4 antibodies is an established therapy in multiple sclerosis and Crohn disease.

circadian_rhythm.en: ~24h endogenous oscillator driven by BMAL1/CLOCK; gated by SIRT1 via circadian NAD+ (NAMPT) oscillations.

dna_pk.en: DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit (PRKDC) central to non-homologous end joining.

rubicon.en: A RUN domain-containing protein that inhibits the Beclin 1–Vps34 autophagy complex and negatively regulates autophagosome formation and endocytic maturation.

plk1.en: Polo-like kinase 1 (PLK1) is a serine/threonine kinase and master regulator of mitosis that controls centrosome maturation, spindle assembly, and cytokinesis, and modulates apoptosis by phosphorylating Bcl-xL at Ser62.

silver_sulfide_albuminates.en: Soluble protein-bound silver species that transport silver systemically and drive tissue deposition.

outer_mitochondrial_membrane.en: The outer membrane of mitochondria, the site of mitofusin-mediated fusion and DRP1-driven fission.

mad2.en: Mad2 (MAD2L1) is the checkpoint-sensing component of the mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint; it binds Cdc20 to inhibit APC/C activity until every kinetochore is correctly attached, thereby preventing aneuploidy.

histone_crotonylation.en: Reversible lysine crotonylation (Kcr) of histones, a non-acetyl acylation mark deposited on chromatin from crotonyl-CoA that regulates gene expression; targeted by SIRT3 lysine decrotonylase activity.

il_1r.en: Interleukin-1 receptor — the receptor for IL-1 cytokines (IL-1α/IL-1β) that initiates MyD88/IRAK/TRAF6-dependent NF-κB signaling; a pro-inflammatory node modulated by sirtuins.

tel1p.en: Tel1p is the S. cerevisiae ortholog of mammalian ATM, a 322 kDa PIKK family kinase that functions in DNA damage signaling, telomere maintenance, and mediates mitohormetic lifespan extension through mitochondrial ROS sensing.

verrucomicrobia.en: Verrucomicrobia is a phylum of bacteria that are ubiquitous in soil and water, and in the human gut they are represented primarily by the genus Akkermansia.

heat_shock_proteins.en: Conserved chaperones induced by proteotoxic and thermal stress that refold misfolded proteins and support mitochondrial and cellular proteostasis.

pak2.en: p21-activated kinase 2; a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates and inhibits Caspase-7, contributing to chemotherapy resistance in breast cancer.

minority_momp.en: Sublethal, partial mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization that releases mtDNA and drives the SASP without committing the cell to apoptosis.

cobb.en: The first bacterial sirtuin, discovered in Salmonella enterica, linking cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism to prokaryotic NAD+-dependent deacetylation.

pin1.en: Peptidyl-prolyl cis/trans isomerase that recognizes phosphorylated Ser/Thr-Pro motifs and catalyzes conformational changes; acts as a molecular switch determining pro-survival vs. pro-death outcomes for BAX.

caenorhabditis_elegans.en: A microscopic nematode used as a premier model organism for studying development, genetics, aging, and neurobiology.

mir_101.en: miR-101 is a tumor-suppressive microRNA frequently down-regulated in Hepatocellular Carcinoma and other cancers; it promotes Apoptosis and suppresses tumorigenicity by directly targeting the anti-apoptotic protein Mcl-1.

embryoid_bodies.en: Three-dimensional aggregates formed by embryonic stem cells in suspension that自发 differentiate into derivatives of all three germ layers.

dominant_optic_atrophy.en: Most common inherited optic neuropathy caused by OPA1 mutations impairing IMM fusion.

secondary_necrosis.en: Secondary Necrosis is the post-apoptotic membrane rupture of uncleared cells, converting silent death into DAMP-releasing lysis.

locked_nucleic_acid.en: Locked Nucleic Acid (LNA), a nucleic acid analog with a 2'-O,4'-C methylene bridge that confers high binding affinity and nuclease resistance.

hydrazines.en: Nitrogen-nitrogen bond compounds used to stabilize adrenochrome and prepare hemostatic medicines.

serca.en: SERCA pumps are the sacro/endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+-ATPase family of P-type ATPases encoded by ATP2A1-3, which move cytosolic calcium into the ER/SR lumen against gradient and thereby terminate muscle contraction, buffer cytosolic calcium and shape calcium signalling.

glut1.en: GLUT1 (Glucose transporter 1) is a uniporter that transports glucose across mammalian plasma membranes; it is frequently overexpressed in cancers to support the Warburg Effect.

milbemycin_oxime.en: Milbemycin-class macrocyclic lactone (Interceptor, Sentinel) used for monthly heartworm prevention and intestinal-worm control in dogs and cats; the widest-margin ivermectin-like option and the preferred heartworm preventive for dogs with the MDR1 (ABCB1-1Δ) mutation.

vincristine.en: Vincristine is a Vinca alkaloid chemotherapeutic that inhibits microtubule polymerization, arresting mitosis; dose-limiting peripheral neuropathy is characteristic.

ferrostatin_1.en: A synthetic lipophilic antioxidant that potently inhibits ferroptosis by preventing lipid peroxidation propagation.

trpml1.en: TRPML1 (Mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal calcium channel that regulates

fructosamine_3_kinase.en: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) is an intracellular enzyme responsible for

cathepsin_k.en: A lysosomal cysteine protease involved in bone resorption and degradation

cholangiocarcinoma.en: Cholangiocarcinoma is a malignant adenocarcinoma arising from the bile duct epithelium (cholangiocytes), encompassing intrahepatic, perihilar, and distal subtypes, with poor prognosis and limited therapeutic options.

mucositis.en: Inflammation and ulceration of the mucous membranes (gastrointestinal tract and oral cavity); a dose-limiting adverse effect of mTOR inhibitor therapy, closely related to stomatitis.

t_bet.en: Master transcription factor of Th1 differentiation downstream of IL-12/STAT4; drives interferon-gamma programs.

smac_mimetics.en: Small-molecule IAP antagonists mimicking the Smac/DIABLO IBM motif that trigger cIAP auto-destruction, licensing ripoptosome assembly and death-receptor sensitization in cancer therapy.

excess_post_exercise_oxygen_consumption.en: The transient elevation of oxygen consumption (and thus energy expenditure) above resting levels after an exercise bout. EPOC has a rapid component lasting < 2 h and a prolonged component lasting up to 48 h, and can represent 80–90 % of total energy cost for short high-intensity efforts.

albuminuria.en: Albuminuria is the presence of excess albumin in the urine, most commonly reflecting glomerular damage and a hallmark of diabetic and hypertensive kidney disease.

mrn_complex.en: The MRN complex is the MRE11-RAD50-NBS1 heterotrimer, the primary sensor of DNA double-strand breaks and the activator of ATM, coordinating end resection for homologous recombination repair, alternative end joining, and telomere maintenance.

neuroblastoma.en: Embryonal tumor of the sympathetic nervous system arising from neural crest cells

uk5099.en: Small-molecule inhibitor of the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC). Blocks mitochondrial pyruvate import to suppress the pyruvate–citrate–acetyl-CoA axis in senescence and to inhibit mitochondrial-metabolism-dependent cell death such as necroptosis; also has well-documented MPC-independent effects.

ccl5.en: C-C motif chemokine ligand 5 (RANTES), a SASP chemokine that binds CCR1/3/5 and promotes cancer progression and reproductive aging.

calcineurin.en: calcineurin is a calcium-dependent protein phosphatase that plays

efferocytosis.en: PS-dependent phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells; in erythrocytes it removes eryptotic RBCs within minutes, reprograms macrophages toward an antiinflammatory/antioxidant (HO-1) phenotype, and thereby suppresses DAMP-driven inflammation from hemolysis.

cxcr4.en: C-X-C chemokine receptor type 4 (CD184), the principal receptor for CXCL12 (SDF-1), implicated in stem cell homing, cancer metastasis, HIV entry, and vascular aging.

tau_pathology.en: Tau pathology encompasses hyperphosphorylation, oligomerization, and neuronal accumulation of microtubule-associated protein tau (tauopathy), driving neurodegeneration; autophagy-lysosomal clearance via TFEB is a major therapeutic axis.

acid_sphingomyelinase.en: An enzyme that converts sphingomyelin into ceramide, active in the Lysosome.

senescence_associated_mitochondrial_dysf.en: Senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction (SAMD) is the metabolic and functional impairment of mitochondria in senescent cells that drives SASP via ROS and mtDNA release.

bcl_2_family.en: The Bcl-2 family of proteins consists of both pro-apoptotic and anti-apoptotic

medium_spiny_neurons.en: Medium spiny neurons (MSNs) are GABAergic inhibitory cells constituting ~95% of neurons in the striatum and the principal targets of dopaminergic inputs.

uric_acid_crystals.en: Monosodium urate (MSU) and uric acid crystals are potent NLRP3

levodopa.en: Chemical properties: Levodopa is a chemical substance with defined molecular structure, functional groups, and physicochemical properties that determine its biological activity.

proline.en: Non-essential amino acid that serves as the major nitrogen donor for polyamine synthesis. Proline levels decline with age; supplementation extends lifespan of yeast and C. elegans, and proline may promote longevity through ROS scavenging and effects on senescence.

enhancer_promoter_looping.en: Physical chromatin contacts that bring enhancers into proximity with gene promoters, rewired in senescence to drive SASP gene transcription within TADs.

urolithins.en: Urolithins are a class of microbially derived metabolites produced

dopamine_hypothesis.en: The Dopamine hypothesis of Schizophrenia is a model that attributes

calcium_channel_blockers.en: Calcium channel blockers (CCBs) are a drug class that inhibit L-type voltage-gated calcium channels, divided into dihydropyridines (amlodipine, nifedipine) acting on vascular smooth muscle and non-dihydropyridines (verapamil, diltiazem) acting additionally on cardiac pacemaker and contractile tissue.

isoleucine.en: Essential branched-chain amino acid that has emerged as a key regulator of metabolism and aging. Dietary isoleucine correlates with body mass index and mortality risk; isoleucine restriction consistently improves metabolic health, extends lifespan, reduces frailty, and rejuvenates aged mice.

sahf.en: Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci (SAHF) are specialized facultative

arterial_thrombosis.en: Arterial thrombosis is a vascular occlusion driven by platelet-rich thrombus formation, which honokiol potently inhibits via endothelial protection and prostacyclin stimulation, raising bleeding-risk considerations.

purine_nucleoside_phosphorylase.en: Enzyme that converts nicotinamide riboside to nicotinamide, a variable step possibly explaining the low and interindividually variable oral bioavailability of NR.

sandfly.en: Sandfly is a colloquial name covering several unrelated biting dipteran families; the medically important group is the subfamily Phlebotominae (Psychodidae), female vectors of Leishmania and of phlebovirus sandfly fever.

sting_inhibitors.en: Experimental small molecules that block STING signaling to reduce neuroinflammation and neuronal death.

nfatc2.en: Nuclear factor of activated T-cells 2, a calcium-responsive transcription factor deacetylated by SIRT2 in cardiac hypertrophy

indirect_calorimetry.en: A method for measuring energy expenditure from oxygen consumption and carbon dioxide production, typically using a respiratory quotient to convert gas exchange into energy units. The standard approach for measuring resting metabolic rate and exercise energy cost.

trehalose.en: Trehalose is a natural disaccharide that induces TFEB-mediated autophagy

epipen.en: An EpiPen is a brand of epinephrine auto-injector used for the emergency

queen_palm.en: Syagrus romanzoffiana (jerivá) ornamental palm whose fruit pulp and kernel supply carotenoids, polyphenols, tocopherols and medium-chain lipids — a studied dietary source of lipophilic defense against lipid peroxidation.

coronary_artery_disease.en: Narrowing or blockage of the coronary arteries, typically from atherosclerosis, leading to myocardial ischemia and infarction

ifn_beta.en: Interferon beta is a type I interferon and a primary output of the cGAS-STING pathway in senescent cells, reinforcing arrest and driving sterile inflammaging.

slc19a1.en: Solute Carrier Family 19 Member 1; a folate and reduced folate carrier implicated in methotrexate transport and cGAMP import

gtp.en: Guanosine triphosphate, a purine nucleotide substrate required by cGAS to synthesize 2'3'-cGAMP.

nuclear_envelope.en: The double-membrane boundary of the nucleus that anchors cGAS via BAF1 and hosts STING and NPC1 regulation of cGAS activity.

cambinol.en: Cambinol is a highly promising, cell-permeable $\beta$-naphthol derivative

ccl20.en: C-C motif chemokine ligand 20 (MIP-3α), a SASP chemokine that signals through

mitochondrial_translation.en: The process by which the ~13 protein-coding genes of the mitochondrial genome are transcribed and translated by mitochondrial ribosomes within the organelle; essential for oxidative phosphorylation and a target of quality-control and aging-related regulation.

aquaporins.en: A family of integral membrane channel proteins that conduct water (and in some cases small solutes) across cell membranes.

drosophila_melanogaster.en: Drosophila melanogaster, the common fruit fly, is a premier Model Organism

oxaliplatin.en: Oxaliplatin is a third-generation platinum (1R,2R-cyclohexane-1,2-diamine) complex that forms bulky intra- and interstrand DNA crosslinks, the backbone of chemotherapy in colorectal cancer, with cumulative peripheral neuropathy as its signature toxicity.

cxcl11.en: C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 11 (I-TAC), an IFN-inducible ELR− SASP chemokine that binds CXCR3 and promotes pro-tumorigenic paracrine signaling from senescent endothelial cells.

venetoclax.en: Venetoclax (ABT-199) is an orally bioavailable, BCL-2-selective BH3 mimetic that occupies the BCL-2 hydrophobic groove and displaces BH3-only activators to trigger mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization; it is first-line in CLL and standard-of-care partner in AML.

hesperidin.en: Hesperidin is a citrus flavanone glycoside with anti-inflammatory and vasoprotective effects; lacking a catechol structure, it does not inhibit or compete with COMT and is safe in slow COMT.

neurofibrillary_tangles.en: Intracellular aggregates of hyperphosphorylated tau protein, a hallmark pathology of Alzheimer's disease and other tauopathies.

crohn_s_disease.en: A chronic, relapsing, transmural inflammatory bowel disease that can affect any part of the gastrointestinal tract; the intestinal pathology most closely resembling the spontaneous RIPK3-dependent necroptosis seen when FADD/caspase-8 are deleted from intestinal epithelium.

gram_positive_bacteria.en: Gram-positive bacteria are those whose thick, multilayered peptidoglycan cell wall retains crystal violet-iodine complex, giving a purple Gram stain. They possess a single cytoplasmic membrane, no outer membrane and no lipopolysaccharide, and instead are decorated with anionic teichoic acid and lipoteichoic acid polymers.

trim2.en: TRIM2 (tripartite motif-containing protein 2) is an E3 ubiquitin ligase that promotes ERK-dependent degradation of the pro-apoptotic protein Bim, conferring neuronal and potentially tumor-cell protection from apoptosis.

ptpn23.en: PTPN23 (HD-PTP) is a non-receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase and Bro1-domain protein that functions as a tumor suppressor by regulating endosomal trafficking, EGFR degradation, and apoptosis via Bak.

pediculosis.en: Pediculosis is an infestation of the hairy parts of the body or clothing with eggs, larvae, or adults of lice.

p27.en: p27Kip1 (CDKN1B) is a 198-residue Cip/Kip-family cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that restrains cyclin E-CDK2 and cyclin D-CDK4/6 activity at the G1-S transition. Its abundance is set less by transcription than by proteolysis and subcellular localisation, and low nuclear p27 is one of the most widely reproduced prognostic markers in solid tumours.

gap.en: GAP (GTPase-activating protein) is a family of regulatory proteins that accelerate intrinsic GTP hydrolysis on small GTPases, switching them from GTP- to GDP-bound and thereby terminating their signalling. The clearest cases in this vault are the TSC1/TSC2 heterodimer acting on Rheb to restrain mTORC1, and NF1/neurofibromin acting on Ras.

parasympathetic_nervous_system.en: The "rest, digest, and repair" branch of the autonomic nervous system, governed by the vagus nerve, that raises HRV and drives recovery from hormetic stress.

endocytic_lysosome_reformation.en: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) is the process of regenerating

toluidine_blue_o.en: Toluidine Blue O (TB) is a 3,7-dimethyl phenothiazine dye and the most potent methylene blue analog for neuroprotection, sharing MB's alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer mechanism.

plk3.en: Polo-like kinase 3 (PLK3, also called FN1/Prk) is a stress-responsive Polo-like kinase involved in the DNA damage response, cell cycle checkpoints, and apoptosis by phosphorylating targets including Bcl-xL and p53.

hdac_inhibitors.en: Chemical properties: HDAC inhibitors is a chemical substance with defined molecular structure, functional groups, and physicochemical properties that determine its biological activity.

methionine_synthase.en: Catalytic function: Methionine Synthase is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

methylb12.en: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) is the active methyl-donating form of vitamin B12, essential for homocysteine remethylation and methyl-group supply.

pikfyve.en: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide 5-kinase that converts PtdIns3P to

stimulus_response_learning.en: Stimulus-response learning is habit learning in which a cue automatically elicits a learned action, dependent on striatal dopamine and modulated by COMT.

mevalonate_pathway.en: The mevalonate pathway regulates ferroptosis by controlling selenocysteine tRNA maturation and CoQ10/isoprenoid production that modulate GPX4 and antioxidant defenses.

vascular_remodeling.en: Vascular remodeling is the structural change in vessel wall geometry and composition occurring after injury or chronic disease - intimal hyperplasia, adventitial fibrosis, and constrictive or adaptive change in lumen diameter - driven by smooth muscle phenotypic switching, matrix turnover and hemodynamic feedback.

prdx1.en: PRDX1 (peroxiredoxin-1) is a thioredoxin-dependent peroxidase with a catalytic cysteine that acts as a fast H2O2 scavenger, a redox sensor, and a holdase chaperone, and it constrains ferroptosis by limiting lipid hydroperoxide accumulation.

sodium_valproate.en: Sodium Valproate (valproate) is a branched-chain fatty acid antiepileptic and mood stabilizer that also inhibits histone deacetylases, modulating chromatin and promoting differentiation, with significant teratogenic risk.

tdr.en: The Special Programme for Research and Training in Tropical Diseases (TDR) is a WHO-coordinated global partnership that fosters research to control/eliminate neglected tropical diseases including onchocerciasis, lymphatic filariasis, and others relevant to cancer-burdened populations.

retinoid_x_receptor_alpha.en: Retinoid X receptor α (RXRA, NR2B1) is a nuclear receptor that serves as

selenoprotein_p.en: Selenoprotein P (SELENOP) is a selenium-rich extracellular glycoprotein that transports selenium to tissues and provides antioxidant defense; it contains multiple selenocysteine residues (up to 10 in humans).

atac_seq.en: ATAC-seq (Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing)

cd44.en: CD44 variant isoforms (CD44v) partner with MUC1-C and xCT to sustain GSH and ferroptosis resistance in triple-negative breast cancer.

lactate.en: Biochemical properties: Lactate is an endogenous metabolite involved in cellular energy metabolism, redox reactions, or biosynthetic pathways. Its cellular concentration reflects metabolic flux...

high_throughput_screening.en: An automated experimental method for assaying large libraries of compounds

energy_balance.en: The steady-state relationship between energy intake (food) and energy expenditure (resting metabolism, thermic effect of food, physical activity). Positive energy balance over time drives fat storage and obesity; negative balance drives weight loss.

amphiregulin.en: Amphiregulin is an EGFR-binding EGF-family growth factor and SASP component that drives tissue repair and can promote tumor growth.

epigenetic_inheritance.en: Epigenetic inheritance refers to the transmission of epigenetic information from one generation to the next without altering the DNA sequence.

tca_cycle.en: Tricarboxylic acid (Krebs) cycle, the central mitochondrial pathway oxidizing acetyl-CoA to CO2 while generating NADH, FADH2, and GTP.

malat1.en: Metastasis Associated Lung Adenocarcinoma Transcript 1, a long non-coding

sirtinol.en: Sirtinol is a cell-permeable, small-molecule dual inhibitor of SIRT1

pentosidine.en: Pentosidine is a well-known biomarker and fluorescent cross-link belonging

chromatin_remodeling.en: Definition: Chromatin Remodeling is a fundamental biological process that maintains cellular and organismal homeostasis. It involves coordinated molecular events regulated by signaling pathways...

atr.en: Ataxia Telangiectasia and Rad3-related protein kinase, a central sensor of replication stress and single-stranded DNA that activates the DNA damage checkpoint and drives senescence

tsc2.en: Tuberous sclerosis complex 2 (TSC2), also known as tuberin, is a protein

mitorqc.en: Mitochondrial ribosome quality control is a surveillance pathway that recognizes and degrades nascent polypeptides stalled on mitochondrial ribosomes, preventing proteotoxic accumulation.

tmg.en: Trimethylglycine (betaine), a methyl-donor osmolyte that supports methionine synthesis via betaine-homocysteine S-methyltransferase.

mth1.en: MTH1 (MutT Homolog 1, NUDT1) is a nucleotide pool sanitization enzyme

gram_negative_bacteria.en: Bacteria whose outer membrane contains lipopolysaccharide (LPS/endotoxin); major drivers of innate immune activation, inflammation, and mitochondrial oxidative stress relevant to aging.

cd40l.en: CD40L (CD154, TNFSF5) is a trimeric TNF-superfamily type II transmembrane cytokine expressed on activated CD4+ T cells that engages CD40 on B cells and antigen-presenting cells to drive germinal centre formation, class-switch recombination, and dendritic cell maturation.

jak2.en: Janus kinase 2 (JAK2) is a non-receptor tyrosine kinase that transduces cytokine receptor signals through STAT proteins, driving proliferation and survival; its dysregulation features in myeloproliferative neoplasms and solid tumors.

cell_penetrating_peptide.en: A short (roughly 5-40 residue), typically cationic or amphipathic peptide that crosses biological membranes and escorts covalently linked or non-covalently complexed cargo into the cytosol, most often by macropinocytosis with endosomal escape.

erlotinib.en: Erlotinib (Tarceva) is a small-molecule EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor used in non-small-cell lung cancer and pancreatic cancer that blocks proliferation and induces apoptosis, and is combined with Bcl-2 inhibitors to enhance efficacy.

folinic_acid.en: Folinic acid (leucovorin) is a reduced folateform that bypasses MTHFR for initial conversion, supporting the methylation cycle without the abrupt methyl load of methylfolate; useful in slow COMT.

silica.en: Silica (silicon dioxide) is a crystalline mineral that activates the

asah1.en: The gene encoding acid ceramidase (ACase, aCDase), a lysosomal hydrolase that cleaves ceramide into sphingosine and free fatty acid; mutations cause Farber disease and SMA-PME.

lipl_1.en: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that plays a critical

striatum.en: The Striatum (also known as the neostriatum or caudate-putamen)

phosphatidylethanolamine.en: Phosphatidylethanolamine is a major membrane phospholipid whose polyunsaturated (arachidonate/adrenate) species are the key peroxidation substrates that execute ferroptosis.

brca2.en: BRCA2 (Breast Cancer Type 2 Susceptibility Protein) is a Tumor Suppressor

hepatosplenomegaly.en: Hepatosplenomegaly is the simultaneous enlargement of both liver and spleen. It is a sign rather than a disease, produced by any process that congests, infiltrates, or increases the workload of the reticuloendothelial system — most commonly portal hypertension, chronic infection, infiltrative disease, or haematological malignancy.

threonine_dehydrogenase.en: Threonine dehydrogenase (L-threonine 3-dehydrogenase) catalyses the NAD+-dependent oxidation of L-threonine to aminoacetone, ammonia and carbon dioxide, feeding aminoacetone to the methylglyoxal pathway in rodent liver.

hypotension.en: Hypotension is abnormally low blood pressure that impairs tissue perfusion; severe refractory vasoplegic hypotension is rescued with vasopressors and methylene blue, which inhibits guanylate cyclase and NO signaling.

preparation_for_oxidative_stress.en: Hypoxia-induced upregulation of antioxidant defenses that preconditions animals for reoxygenation, proposed as conditioning hormesis

lens_crystallins.en: Long-lived eye-lens proteins whose glycation and racemization cause age-related cataract.

lipofuscin.en: Lipofuscin is a brownish-yellow, electron-dense pigment composed of lipid-containing residues of lysosomal digestion.

apolipoprotein_b.en: Apolipoprotein B (ApoB) is the primary apolipoprotein of LDL and

mucopolysaccharidosis_iiia.en: Also known as Sanfilippo syndrome type A, a Lysosomal Storage Diseases

selamectin.en: Semi-synthetic avermectin endectocide used topically in dogs and cats (Revolution/Stronghold) against heartworm, fleas, ear mites, sarcoptic mange, roundworms and hookworms; a veterinary analogue of Ivermectin with lower brain penetration and a wider margin in MDR1-affected dogs.

targeted_therapy.en: Cancer treatment modality in which drugs are aimed at a specific molecular dependency of a tumour — an oncogene, a receptor kinase, a blood vessel, or an immune checkpoint — rather than at the nonspecific damage of rapidly dividing cells.

alpha_synuclein_aggregation.en: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation is the process by which soluble Alpha-synuclein monomers misfold and cluster together to form toxic oligomers and insoluble fibrils.

c57bl_6.en: The most widely used inbred laboratory mouse strain, serving as the reference background for genetic and aging research.

p73.en: p73 (Tumour Protein p73, encoded by TP73) is a structural and functional homologue of the tumor suppressor p53. Like p53, p73 is a transcription factor that can induce cell cycle arrest or trigger apoptotic cell death in response to DNA damage and other cellular stress signals.

flavin_containing_monooxygenase.en: Family of FAD-dependent enzymes (FMO1-FMO5) that oxygenate nucleophilic heteroatoms; contributes to drug metabolism.

mthfd1.en: MTHFD1 (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase 1) is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme producing 10-formyl-THF for purine synthesis and contributing to methyl-group flux.

bicuspid_aortic_valve.en: A congenital cardiac defect in which two of the three aortic valve leaflets fuse

fnip1.en: Folliculin-interacting protein 1, which works with Folliculin and FNIP2

endoplasmic_reticulum_pathway.en: The Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) Pathway is an initiation route for

palb2.en: BRCA1/2 scaffold enabling homologous recombination; mutated in breast, pancreatic, and Fanconi anemia disease.

pterostilbene.en: A natural dimethylated stilbenoid polyphenol from blueberries that activates sirtuins and AMPK, mimicking caloric restriction.

prophase_i.en: The extended meiotic prophase comprising leptotene, zygotene, pachytene, diplotene and diakinesis, during which homologous chromosomes pair, synapse, recombine, and undergo programmed genome surveillance before the first meiotic division.

sphingosine_1_phosphate.en: A bioactive sphingolipid signaling lipid phosphorylated from sphingosine; generally pro-survival, pro-proliferative, and anti-apoptotic, counterbalancing ceramide.

triiodothyronine.en: The biologically active thyroid hormone, produced largely by peripheral deiodination of thyroxine (T4). T3 regulates basal metabolic rate via genomic and non-genomic actions across nearly all tissues.

mtor_inhibitor.en: A pharmacological agent that suppresses the mechanistic target of rapamycin, inducing autophagy and mimicking caloric restriction.

basal_lamina.en: The Basal Lamina is a specialized 50–100 nm thick layer of extracellular matrix secreted by epithelial, endothelial, and mesenchymal cells that provides structural support, filtration, and signaling functions.

chromaffin_cells.en: Neuroendocrine cells of the adrenal medulla and sympathetic ganglia that synthesize, store, and secrete catecholamines into the bloodstream.

vegfr.en: Vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (VEGFR-1/2/3) driving angiogenesis; TKI targets.

insulin_secretion.en: Definition: Insulin Secretion is a fundamental biological process that maintains cellular and organismal homeostasis. It involves coordinated molecular events regulated by signaling pathways an...

farber_disease.en: A rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ASAH1 resulting in <5% residual acid ceramidase activity, characterized by painful joint deformities, subcutaneous nodules, and vocal hoarseness.

ikappabzeta.en: Inhibitor of NF-κB zeta, a selective co-activator of NF-κB for SASP genes like IL-6 and IL-8.

redox.en: Definition: Redox is a scientific concept that describes fundamental principles governing biological or chemical systems.

fatty_acid_oxidation.en: Definition: Fatty acid oxidation is a fundamental biological process that maintains cellular and organismal homeostasis. It involves coordinated molecular events regulated by signaling pathways...

brg1.en: ATPase subunit of SWI/SNF chromatin remodelers controlling differentiation and tumor suppression.

hypothalamus.en: Small diencephalic brain structure that integrates autonomic, endocrine, and behavioral responses; regulates feeding, sleep, thermoregulation, and reproduction through nuclei such as the dorsomedial hypothalamus (DMH) and lateral hypothalamus (LH).

tyrosine_kinase_inhibitors.en: Tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) are targeted anticancer drugs that block ATP binding or substrate docking in tyrosine kinases (e.g., EGFR, HER2, BCR-ABL, VEGFR), halting proliferative and angiogenic signaling in cancer.

cyclin_b.en: The G2/M cyclin that partners CDK1 to drive mitotic entry; its mRNA is stabilized by HuR, and loss of cytosolic HuR during senescence represses Cyclin B translation, contributing to cell-cycle arrest.

mir_543.en: DLK1-DIO3 cluster microRNA that represses SIRT1 and other targets, contributing to senescence, inflammation, and epigenetic dysregulation in aging.

lipoxygenase.en: Lipoxygenases (LOXs) are iron-containing dioxygenases that oxidize polyunsaturated fatty acids to bioactive hydroperoxides and signaling lipids such as leukotrienes, linking lipid peroxidation to inflammation and ferroptosis.

pamp.en: Pathogen-Associated Molecular Patterns; conserved microbial molecules recognized by pattern recognition receptors to activate innate immunity

wnt_beta_catenin.en: Canonical Wnt pathway stabilizing beta-catenin for proliferation and stemness programs.

oleacein.en: Oleacein is a secoiridoid phenolic in extra-virgin olive oil with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory actions and dual substrate-inhibitor activity at COMT.

nutlin_3a.en: MDM2 antagonist that stabilizes p53; a senolytic/senescence-inducing and senomorphic agent.

chemical_memory.en: Chemical memory is a hypothesized form of molecular memory in dopaminergic neurons based on the intracellular sequestration and triggered release of Dopamine by Neuromelanin granules.

lamp_2a.en: Lysosomal membrane receptor for chaperone-mediated autophagy. LAMP-2A is one of three alternatively spliced LAMP-2 isoforms; it binds HSC70-delivered KFERQ-containing cytosolic proteins at the lysosomal surface and releases them into the lysosome for degradation.

erk2.en: Extracellular regulated protein kinase 2 (ERK2) is a kinase that phosphorylates

ucp3.en: A mitochondrial inner-membrane carrier expressed predominantly in skeletal muscle that may participate in fatty-acid handling, mild proton conductance, and reactive oxygen species control. Endurance training down-regulates UCP3 in muscle, linking it to exercise efficiency and resting metabolic rate.

monoamine_oxidase_inhibitor.en: Monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) block the enzymatic breakdown of

myeloid_derived_suppressor_cells.en: Immature immunosuppressive myeloid cells recruited and expanded by SASP factors

knockout_mouse.en: A genetically engineered mouse in which a specific gene has been inactivated (knocked out) to study gene function in vivo.

lipin1.en: Lipin-1, a bifunctional enzyme and transcription coactivator that

golgi_apparatus.en: Overview: Golgi apparatus is a specialized cellular or anatomical structure with defined functions in tissue organization and physiology.

protac.en: Proteolysis-targeting chimera technology proposed to degrade cGAS or STING for therapeutic pathway suppression.

stem_cell_research.en: Stem Cell Research explores cells that self-renew and differentiate; transformed

immune_evasion.en: The capacity of senescent and tumor cells to escape cytotoxic immune clearance via checkpoint ligands and immunosuppressive microenvironments.

antigen_presentation.en: Antigen Presentation is a biological process in which cells display fragments of antigens on their surface via MHC molecules to be recognized by T cells.

hrk.en: Hrk (DP5, harakiri, BID3) is a pro-apoptotic BH3-only member of the Bcl-2 family. It is 91 residues long, localises to mitochondria, is transcriptionally induced by p53 and by neuronal stress, and kills by selectively binding the anti-apoptotic proteins Bcl-2 and Bcl-xL rather than by directly activating Bax or Bak.

atg13.en: Atg13 is a structural protein that forms part of the ULK1 initiation

npc1l1.en: Niemann-Pick C1-like 1, the intestinal and hepatic cholesterol uptake transporter that is the molecular target of ezetimibe and a validated human genetic target for lowering LDL cholesterol.

checkpoint_inhibitor.en: A class of cancer immunotherapeutics (notably anti-CTLA-4, anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1 agents) that block inhibitory immune-checkpoint receptors to reinvigorate T-cell anti-tumor immunity.

epigenetic_landscape.en: The ensemble of chromatin states, histone modifications, and DNA methylation that defines cellular identity and gene-expression potential; proposed to erode progressively with age.

arn14794.en: A benzoxazolone carboxamide small-molecule inhibitor of acid ceramidase (ACase, ASAH1), specifically used in the 2026 Soriano-Castell study demonstrating that ACase inhibition protects cells from ferroptosis independently of GPX4/GSH and iron.

nitrogen_gas.en: Nitrogen gas (N₂) is an inert gas commonly used in laboratory and

rutin.en: Rutin is a citrus flavonoid glycoside (quercetin-3-rutinoside) with antioxidant and vascular actions that is metabolized and can inhibit COMT via its catechol moiety.

cd4_t_cells.en: CD4-positive T helper cells are central coordinators of adaptive immunity, orchestrating immune responses through cytokine production and helper functions.

thymopoiesis.en: The process of T cell development, selection, and maturation within the thymus.

glutathione_s_transferase.en: A family of phase II detoxifying enzymes that conjugate glutathione to electrophilic substrates, regulated by the NRF2–ARE pathway and implicated in cellular antioxidant defense and mitophagy.

crispr.en: A family of DNA sequences in bacteria that form the basis of a genome-editing technology, adapted from bacterial adaptive immune systems.

senolytic_therapy.en: Therapeutic strategies that selectively eliminate senescent cells by disabling their anti-apoptotic survival pathways, reducing senescence burden and SASP-driven pathology.

herv.en: Human endogenous retroviruses, dormant retroviral sequences in the genome whose age-related derepression drives cGAS-STING innate immune signaling and SASP expression in senescence.

cdkn1b.en: CDKN1B (p27) is a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor of the Cip/Kip family that regulates the G1/S transition, quiescence, and differentiation.

pex1.en: PEX1 is a critical gene that encodes a peroxisomal membrane protein (peroxin)

c11_bodipy.en: A fluorescent fatty acid analogue used as a probe for detecting lipid peroxidation in live cells by flow cytometry or microscopy.

l_dopa.en: In the brain, L-DOPA is synthesized from the amino acid tyrosine by the enzyme Tyrosine Hydroxylase. It is then converted into Dopamine by the enzyme aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase.

deacetylases.en: Enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues; sirtuins are the NAD+-dependent subclass linking deacetylation to cellular energy state.

cdh1.en: CDH1 encodes E-cadherin, a 120 kDa calcium-dependent transmembrane glycoprotein essential for epithelial cell-cell adhesion and a master suppressor of invasion and metastasis.

gut_brain_axis.en: The gut-brain axis is the bidirectional communication network linking the central nervous system and the gastrointestinal tract through neural, endocrine, immune, and microbial metabolite pathways.

tlr3.en: Toll-like receptor 3, an endosomal pattern-recognition receptor that binds double-stranded RNA and triggers antiviral/inflammatory signaling exclusively through the TRIF adaptor.

m1da.en: 1-methyladenine is a cytotoxic DNA base lesion formed by N1-alkylation of adenine; it blocks replication and transcription and is removed by dedicated glycosylases.

auf1.en: AU-rich element RNA-binding protein 1 (hnRNP D), an ARE-mRNA decay factor inactivated by MK2 to stabilize SASP cytokine transcripts.

cyclin_dependent_kinase.en: Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) are the catalytic subunits of cell cycle regulators, activated by cyclins and restrained by inhibitors.

kinase_inhibitor.en: A small-molecule drug that inhibits a protein kinase; the dominant class of targeted cancer and signaling therapies, and the class in which drug hormesis (biphasic dose response) is frequently observed.

vasoconstriction.en: Vasoconstriction is the narrowing of blood vessels via smooth-muscle contraction, raising vascular resistance and blood pressure; methylene blue induces it in vasoplegic shock.

mtfp1.en: Mitochondrial fission process 1 (MTFP1/MTP18), an inner mitochondrial membrane protein essential for mitochondrial division and cardiac function

erythrocyte_senescence.en: The ~120-day aging program of mature red cells — surface/volume loss, density rise, reduced deformability, cation loss, desialylation, oxidative damage, hemichrome, reduced CD47, AE1 neo-antigen — cleared over days by macrophage/NOAb immunity, distinct from minutes-fast eryptosis.

glutamic_acid_decarboxylase.en: Glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) is the enzyme that synthesizes GABA from glutamate; its activity is increased by honokiol, augmenting inhibitory neurotransmission in the brain.

oral_squamous_cell_carcinoma.en: A head and neck cancer in which SIRT3 is overexpressed, supporting tumor growth and therapy resistance; SIRT3 downregulation has antiproliferative activity and sensitizes cells to radiation and cisplatin.

pp2a.en: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) is a serine/threonine phosphatase that

acute_stress_associated_phenotype.en: The ASAP is the rapid, acute cellular response to stress (ATM/TRAF6/TAK1 activation) that precedes and can transition into the chronic senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP).

nhr_49.en: NHR-49 (Nuclear Hormone Receptor 49) is a key transcriptional regulator

hematopoiesis.en: Hematopoiesis is the lifelong process of blood-cell formation from hematopoietic stem cells in the bone marrow, governed by transcription factors, cytokines, and the niche, and declining with age.

mitoxantrone.en: Mitoxantrone is a synthetic anthraquinonoid and type II topoisomerase inhibitor used in the treatment of certain cancers and multiple sclerosis.

wipi2.en: WIPI2 is a seven-bladed beta-propeller phosphoinositide effector that binds PI(3)P via its FRRG motif and recruits the ATG12-ATG5-ATG16L1 complex to the omegasome, licensing LC3/GABARAP lipidation at the phagophore and creating a positive feedback loop with PI3KC3-C1.

tolcapone.en: A potent nitrocatechol-class COMT inhibitor that crosses the blood-brain barrier, used in Parkinson's disease.

ragulator.en: Ragulator (LAMTOR1-5) is a pentameric lysosome-anchored complex that tethers Rag GTPases to the lysosomal surface and acts as a GEF for RagA/B, activating mTORC1 in response to amino acids.

hek293.en: A human embryonic kidney cell line widely used for recombinant protein expression, transfection, and virology.

chloride.en: Chloride (Cl-) is the dominant extracellular anion and a physiological inhibitor of the oxygen-sensitive prolyl hydroxylase enzymes that gate HIF-1alpha degradation. It is also the required co-substrate for myeloperoxidase-derived hypochlorous acid.

translation.en: The biological process in which ribosomes synthesize proteins from messenger

hfe.en: HFE is an iron-regulatory protein whose best-characterized common variants (C282Y, H63D) cause hereditary hemochromatosis by raising the labile iron pool, shifting the threshold for ferroptosis and lipid peroxidation in every downstream protocol.

lysine.en: Lysine is an α-amino acid that is used in the biosynthesis of proteins.

ago2.en: Argonaute 2, the catalytic core of the RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC) that mediates microRNA- and siRNA-guided mRNA silencing; part of the SIRT3-modulated axis with cytochrome b in diabetic cardiomyopathy.

atg_16_2.en: ATG-16.2 is a C. elegans orthologue of the yeast Atg16 and mammalian

mitomycin_c.en: Mitomycin C is a potent DNA cross-linking alkylating agent used in chemotherapy to inhibit cell division by causing extensive DNA damage.

bet_inhibitors.en: A class of epigenetic drugs that inhibit BET (Bromodomain and Extra-Terminal) family proteins, blocking recognition of acetylated lysines on histones

cdc14b.en: CDC14B (Cell division cycle 14 homolog B) is a highly conserved eukaryotic

mitozfns.en: Mitochondria-targeted zinc finger nucleases that selectively cleave mutant mtDNA to shift heteroplasmy toward wild-type genomes; the first demonstrated mtDNA-editing approach for mitochondrial disease.

soluble_epoxide_hydrolase.en: Soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH/EPHX2), a bifunctional enzyme that degrades cardioprotective epoxy-fatty acids and modulates SIRT3 protein turnover via proteolytic degradation in vascular calcification.

b_cells.en: Antibody-producing adaptive lymphocytes that infiltrate the CNS in neurodegeneration and are shaped by cGAS-STING signaling.

numts.en: Nuclear insertions of mitochondrial DNA origin, also known as nuclear mitochondrial DNA transfer

hypokalemia.en: Serum potassium below 3.5 mmol/L, caused by gastrointestinal and renal potassium loss, aldosterone excess, drugs and alkalosis, producing neuromuscular weakness and cardiac arrhythmia.

cdh5.en: Vascular endothelial cadherin (VE-cadherin), the principal adhesion molecule at endothelial adherens junctions

dohh.en: Deoxyhypusine hydroxylase, the nonheme diiron monooxygenase that catalyses the second and final step of hypusine biosynthesis, hydroxylating deoxyhypusine on eIF5A to hypusine while reducing molecular oxygen. Reported human DOHH variants cause a neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia and intellectual disability, and DOHH is a proposed anti-cancer target.

benzothiazine.en: Benzothiazine is a heterocyclic compound containing a benzene ring fused to a thiazine ring; it is a characteristic structural unit of Pheomelanin and is found in the core of Neuromelanin.

chronic_lymphocytic_leukemia.en: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), the most common adult leukemia in Western populations, characterized by accumulation of mature CD5+ B cells; SIRT3-mediated ROS buffering contributes to chemoresistance.

huntington_s_disease_hd.en: An autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disorder caused by CAG repeat

c_jun.en: Jun proto-oncogene (JUN), an AP-1 family pioneer transcription factor that opens senescence-associated SASP enhancers and partially enforces the senescence growth arrest.

radiosensitizer.en: Agents that increase the cytotoxic effects of ionizing radiation, particularly in hypoxic tumor cells.

retinal_ganglion_cells.en: CNS projection neurons vulnerable in glaucoma whose cGAS-STING activation drives cell death and vision loss.

annexin_a1.en: Anti-inflammatory phospholipid-binding protein (ANXA1) whose tripeptide mimetic Ac2-26 transcriptionally upregulates SIRT3, reducing oxidative damage and promoting mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy.

bh3_profiling.en: Functional assay developed by Anthony Letai that determines a cancer cell's dependence on specific anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins and predicts sensitivity to BH3-mimetic drugs.

acecs2.en: AceCS2 (Acetyl-CoA Synthetase 2, mitochondrial; encoded by ACSS1) is a mitochondrial

cisd2.en: CISD2 is a mitochondrial iron-sulfur protein that suppresses ferroptosis; its loss raises mitochondrial iron and lipid ROS, promoting ferroptosis in head and neck cancer.

adrenal_cortex.en: The steroidogenic outer region of the adrenal gland, organised into zona glomerulosa, zona fasciculata and zona reticularis, which produce aldosterone, cortisol and adrenal androgens respectively from cholesterol.

p15ink4b.en: A cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor encoded by CDKN2B that enforces G1 arrest by blocking CDK4/6 and maintaining Rb in its hypophosphorylated state.

sodium_potassium_atpase.en: Sodium Potassium ATPase (Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase, Na⁺/K⁺ pump) is a transmembrane

hla_e.en: A non-classical MHC class Ib molecule that engages the inhibitory NKG2A/CD94 receptor

atf6alpha.en: ATF6α is the transmembrane bZIP transcription factor of the unfolded protein response arm of ER stress signalling; ER stress triggers its Golgi proteolytic release, after which it drives XBP1 and UPRE-dependent target gene expression.

ryanodine_receptor.en: Intracellular Ca2+ release channel of the sarcoplasmic/endoplasmic reticulum that supplies cytosolic Ca2+ signals to mitochondria.

adm.en: Adrenomedullin vasodilatory peptide; plasma aging biomarker in GrimAge clocks alongside cystatin C.

lipid_rafts.en: Lipid rafts are cholesterol- and sphingolipid-enriched, more-ordered

ferroportin.en: Ferroportin (FPN/SLC40A1) is the sole cellular iron exporter; its activity limits the labile iron pool and thus modulates ferroptosis sensitivity.

folliculin.en: Folliculin is a tumor suppressor and a guanine nucleotide exchange factor

cyp2c9.en: Catalytic function: CYP2C9 is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

heart_rate_variability.en: The beat-to-beat variation in interbeat intervals, a noninvasive marker of autonomic balance and recovery capacity used to guide hormetic stress dosing.

non_homologous_end_joining.en: DNA double-strand break repair pathway that directly ligates broken ends without a homologous template; dominant repair route in G1 phase and in post-mitotic cells.

copper.en: Copper is an essential trace metal cofactor for oxidases including cytochrome c oxidase and superoxide dismutase, and a transition-metal catalyst for free radical generation via the Fenton-type Haber-Weiss reaction.

traf3.en: TNF receptor-associated factor 3, an E3 ubiquitin ligase adaptor that links TLR/TRIF and antiviral receptors to IRF3-mediated interferon induction.

It is involved in chromatin remodeling, DNA repair, apoptosis, and cellular senescence.

green_tea.en: Green tea (Camellia sinensis) is rich in catechins such as EGCG that are COMT substrates; at dietary levels it does not significantly impair COMT, unlike pharmacological catechols.

ptpn5.en: Protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 5 (STEP); dephosphorylates and activates BAK, serving as a licensing signal for mitochondrial apoptosis.

methionine_restriction.en: Dietary restriction of the sulfur-containing essential amino acid methionine. Methionine restriction extends lifespan of many species, reduces body weight, improves metabolic function, and reduces frailty, partially through FGF21 and effects on methyl-donor availability.

klotho.en: An anti-aging transmembrane and secreted protein (hormone) whose deficiency drives premature aging; rapamycin improves function in Klotho-deficient models via stem-cell protection.

icad.en: The inhibitor of the caspase-activated DNase (CAD); cleavage of ICAD by executioner caspases releases CAD to fragment nuclear DNA during apoptosis.

blub_like.en: BluB-like (5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase-like) enzymes are a class

nucleus_accumbens.en: The nucleus accumbens (NAc) is a ventral striatal brain region central to reward, motivation, reinforcement learning, and the actions of drugs of abuse.

calpain_2.en: Calcium-dependent cysteine protease (CAPN2/m-calpain) recruited by the phosphorylated caspase-8 scaffold to drive focal-adhesion turnover, migration and therapy resistance.

1_methylguanine.en: M1dG — the exocyclic guanine adduct formed by lipid peroxidation, a marker of oxidative DNA damage that is repaired by ALKBH2 and OGG1 and whose urinary levels track inflammation and lipid oxidation.

sod1.en: Catalytic function: SOD1 is an enzyme that catalyzes biochemical reactions essential for cellular metabolism and homeostasis.

phenelzine.en: Phenelzine is a non-selective, irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) antidepressant; its MAO-blocking mechanism parallels the low-dose MAO-A inhibition of methylene blue.

topoisomerase.en: Topoisomerases are enzymes that regulate DNA supercoiling by cleaving and religating DNA strands; fisetin is a topoisomerase inhibitor, contributing to its anti-cancer activity.

cataract.en: Cataract is a clouding of the eye lens that leads to decreased vision.

igfbp5.en: Insulin-like growth factor-binding protein 5, a SASP factor that modulates IGF signaling

haptoglobin.en: Plasma glycoprotein that binds free hemoglobin released by hemolysis with high affinity, forming the haptoglobin-hemoglobin complex cleared via CD91 receptors; a front-line scavenger of intravascular hemolysis.

comt_inhibitors.en: Chemical properties: COMT Inhibitors is a chemical substance with defined molecular structure, functional groups, and physicochemical properties that determine its biological activity.

phosphoglycerate_mutase.en: Glycolytic enzyme deacetylated by SIRT2 at Lys100 to promote tumor glycolysis and NADPH production, illustrating SIRT2's context-dependent metabolic face.

cyp2c19.en: CYP2C19 is a hepatic cytochrome P450 enzyme encoded by CYP2C19 that metabolizes ~10% of clinical drugs, including proton-pump inhibitors, anti-epileptics, antiplatelets, and benzimidazole anthelmintics; its polymorphisms alter efficacy and toxicity.

sirtuin_fluorimetric_activity.en: Sirtuin fluorimetric activity assays (e.g., Fluor de Lys) are fluorescence-based methods that measure sirtuin deacetylase activity using substrates that become sensitive to developer/fluorophore release after deacetylation; used for high-throughput screening of sirtuin inhibitors.

cyanosis.en: A bluish or grayish discoloration of skin and mucous membranes caused by increased deoxygenated or abnormal hemoglobin in the blood.

temozolomide.en: Temozolomide (TMZ) is an orally bioavailable imidazotetrazine alkylating prodrug that yields MTIC and O6-methylguanine DNA adducts, and is the standard-of-care chemotherapeutic backbone of glioblastoma when combined with radiotherapy.

p66shc.en: 66 kDa Src-homology-2-domain-containing isoform of the ShcA adaptor; a mitochondrial ROS generator and longevity regulator negatively controlled by SIRT1.

carotenoids.en: Carotenoids are C40 isoprenoid pigments — carotenes (β-, α-, γ-carotene, lycopene) and xanthophylls (lutein, zeaxanthin, β-cryptoxanthin) — that color plants, quench singlet oxygen and lipid radicals in membranes, and, for three of them, serve as provitamin A precursors converted to retinol with feedback control.

g6pd.en: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase, the rate-limiting enzyme of the pentose phosphate pathway that also stabilizes PINK1 and regulates mitophagy.

melanoidins.en: Final Maillard reaction products in foods that show prebiotic effects on gut bacteria, contrasting with pro-inflammatory AGEs.

phb2.en: Inner mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a mitophagy receptor when exposed upon OMM damage, binding LC3 to initiate autophagy.

cd36.en: Cluster of differentiation 36, a scavenger receptor essential for NF-κB activation and SASP signaling downstream of lipid ligands.

bipolar_ii_disorder.en: Bipolar II Disorder is a mood disorder defined by recurrent hypomanic and major depressive episodes, with implicated dopaminergic and methylation-pathway contributions involving COMT and MTHFR variants.

xbp1.en: X-box binding protein 1 (XBP1), especially its spliced form XBP1s, is a key unfolded-protein-response transcription factor that also regulates hepatic autophagy by activating TFEB; SIRT6 regulates it to alleviate ER stress.

valsartan.en: Valsartan, an angiotensin II receptor blocker used to treat hypertension and heart failure

lysosomal_membrane_permeabilization.en: The disruption of lysosomal membrane integrity that releases cathepsins and other hydrolases into the cytosol, triggering controlled cell death and inflammatory signaling.

hemopexin.en: Plasma heme-binding glycoprotein that scavenges heme released by hemoglobin breakdown, delivering it to CD91 receptors on hepatocytes and macrophages for HO-1-dependent recycling to bilirubin and iron; its depletion is a marker of intravascular hemolysis.

m1dg.en: M1dG (pyrimido[1,2-a]purin-10(3H)-one deoxyguanosine) is the exocyclic DNA adduct formed when malondialdehyde reacts with deoxyguanosine; the principal mutagenic lesion marking lipid peroxidation damage to the genome.

onchocerca_volvulus.en: A filarial nematode causing onchocerciasis (river blindness); transmitted

um34.en: Um34 (2′-O-methyluridine at position 34) is a tRNA[Ser]Sec modification installed by FTSJ1 that is required for efficient UGA recoding of selenocysteine and for melanoma metastasis.

ischemia.en: Ischemia is the restriction of blood supply causing hypoxia, ATP depletion, and necrotic or regulated cell death on reperfusion.

eltrombopag.en: Eltrombopag (EO) is an FDA-approved drug that acts as a direct inhibitor

emt6.en: Cloned mouse mammary tumor cell line used as an in vitro and in vivo model for studying anticancer agents and radiation.

medulla_oblongata.en: The Medulla Oblongata is the lower part of the brainstem that connects the spinal cord to the Pons and midbrain. It houses the Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus, which contains neuromelanin-pigmented neurons that degenerate early in Parkinson's Disease.

cyanidin_3_glucoside.en: Anthocyanin abundant in elderberries; a natural SIRT6 activator with antioxidant activity and immunomodulatory potential.

oxyhemoglobin.en: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) is the oxygen-bound ferrous form of Hemoglobin; its

acat1.en: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) is an enzyme that acetylates TFEB

propionate.en: Propionate is a three-carbon short-chain fatty acid produced by gut microbiota fermentation of fiber; it fuels hepatic gluconeogenesis and modulates appetite, immunity, and inflammation.

gsis.en: Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) is the process by which pancreatic beta cells sense rising glucose and exocytose insulin, maintaining glucose homeostasis; its failure underlies type 2 diabetes.

uv_induced_photoaging.en: UV-induced photoaging is the premature aging of skin caused by chronic

th2.en: Type 2 helper T cells are a CD4+ T cell subset that drives humoral and anti-helminth immunity through IL-4, IL-5, and IL-13 production.

apaf_1.en: Apaf-1 (Apoptotic protease-activating factor 1) is a key cytoplasmic

selective_serotonin_reuptake_inhibitors.en: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) are a major class of antidepressants that raise synaptic serotonin; dangerous with MAO inhibitors.

enzalutamide.en: Enzalutamide is a second-generation, nonsteroidal androgen-receptor (AR) signaling inhibitor used in castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC) for which drug resistance is a major clinical problem; preclinical studies show ivermectin can overcome enzalutamide resistance and synergize with docetaxel.

ifosfamide.en: Ifosfamide is a nitrogen-mustard alkylating chemotherapeutic prodrug whose neurotoxic metabolite chloroacetaldehyde can cause encephalopathy, effectively reversed by methylene blue.

epithelial_cells.en: Epithelial cells are polarized, tightly adhered sheets that line surfaces and cavities, providing barrier, secretory, absorptive, and transport functions and serving as the origin of most carcinomas.

mlh1.en: Core mismatch-repair gene; germline loss causes Lynch syndrome and microsatellite instability.

age_1.en: C. elegans PI3K catalytic subunit downstream of DAF-2; founding longevity gene of insulin/IGF-1 signaling.

anti_tnf_therapy.en: Therapeutic blockade of tumor necrosis factor-alpha that interrupts the TNF-to-ROS feed-forward loop and reduces systemic oxidative stress.

guanylate_cyclase.en: Guanylate cyclase enzymes (soluble sGC and particulate pGC) convert GTP to cyclic GMP (cGMP); the NO-activated soluble isoform is central to vascular relaxation, and its inhibition by methylene blue underlies vasoconstrictive rescue.

adrenochrome_hypothesis.en: The Adrenochrome Hypothesis was a theory proposed in the 1950s by

eea1.en: Early endosome antigen 1, a 1413-residue FYVE-domain-containing tethering protein that localises exclusively to Rab5-positive early endosomes via binding to phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate, and couples endosomal membrane docking to SNARE-mediated fusion.

translation_initiation.en: Translation initiation is the complex process of assembling the ribosome

foxo3.en: Forkhead box O3 transcription factor that forms a feed-forward stress-resistance loop with SIRT1 and is central to longevity-associated signaling.

dai.en: RHIM-containing DNA sensor identical to ZBP1 that nucleates a RIPK1-independent necrosome with RIPK3.

cdh2.en: CDH2 encodes N-cadherin (neuronal cadherin), a 130 kDa calcium-dependent adhesion glycoprotein critical for neural development, cardiomyocyte cohesion, and mesenchymal cell behavior.

red_palm_oil.en: Crude/minimally refined oil from Elaeis guineensis fruit mesocarp that co-delivers provitamin-A carotenoids, tocotrienol-rich vitamin E, CoQ10, and squalene on an oleic/palmitic lipid vehicle — the Tier-1 dietary source of lipophilic membrane antioxidants relevant to lipid peroxidation and ferroptosis defense.

brosimine_b.en: Prenylated flavan flavonoid from Brosimum acutifolium with quantified hormetic neuroprotection in retinal OGD

th17.en: T helper 17 cells are a CD4+ T cell subset differentiated by the SASP factors IL-6 and IL-1β in the presence of TGFβ, linking senescence to adaptive immunity.

non_exercise_activity_thermogenesis.en: The energy expended on all physical activity other than volitional sporting exercise — fidgeting, posture maintenance, standing, walking, and general ambulatory activity. NEAT is a highly variable component of daily energy expenditure implicated in resistance to fat gain.

restriction_point.en: A checkpoint in late G1 of the animal cell cycle at which the cell becomes committed to DNA replication independent of external growth signals.

retinoic_acid_inducible_protein_i_like_r.en: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors (RLR) are a family of

trem2.en: Triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2, a microglial immunoglobulin-superfamily receptor that gates cGAS-STING/IFN-I signaling and senescence.

folfiri.en: FOLFIRI is a chemotherapy regimen combining 5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, and irinotecan, commonly used for colorectal and other gastrointestinal cancers. It induces NAD+ depletion and Nrk2 downregulation in skeletal muscle.

oxysterols.en: Oxysterols are oxygenated derivatives of Cholesterol formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP27A1, CYP46A1, CYP7A1) or non-enzymatically by Reactive Oxygen Species, acting as LXR ligands and toxic lipid peroxidation products.

nucks1.en: Nuclear casein kinase and cyclin-dependent kinase substrate 1, an abundant intrinsically disordered nuclear phosphoprotein with HMG-box-like DNA/RNA binding that regulates chromatin organization, transcription, DNA repair, and metabolism; linked to cellular senescence through SIRT7-dependent deacetylation.

thrombocytopenia.en: A hematological condition defined by abnormally low blood platelet counts; a common, usually mild and reversible side effect of chronic mTOR inhibition.

irisin.en: Exercise-induced myokine cleaved from the FNDC5 membrane protein that drives browning of white adipose tissue, promotes bone formation, enhances BDNF-dependent neuroprotection, and exerts cardiovascular and SIRT3-dependent redox effects.

fccp.en: FCCP (carbonyl cyanide-4-trifluoromethoxy phenylhydrazone) is a mitochondrial uncoupler used to maximally stimulate cellular oxygen consumption in Seahorse bioenergetic assays of methylene blue.

mitochondria_associated_membranes.en: Mitochondria-ER contact sites (MERCs) are regulatory hubs for Ca2+ signaling, lipid exchange, mitochondrial dynamics, and stress adaptation. Their remodeling during aging weakens inter-organelle communication and contributes to stem cell decline and inflammaging.

huntingtin.en: The protein encoded by the HTT gene, whose mutated form with expanded

cyclin.en: Cyclins are regulatory proteins that control the progression of the cell cycle by activating cyclin-dependent kinases.

sk61_2.en: Ribosomal protein S6 kinase 1 and 2 are AGC-family kinases downstream of mTORC1 that drive translation and exert negative feedback on insulin/PI3K signaling; in the rapamycin-hormesis model their mTORC1-mediated activation has a low Michaelis-Menten constant.

suramin.en: Suramin is a medication used to treat African sleeping sickness and Onchocerciasis.

kaempferol.en: A natural flavonol (3,5,7,4′-tetrahydroxyflavone) with antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer activities, frequently studied alongside apigenin and quercetin.

myostatin.en: A secreted TGF-β family member (GDF-8) that acts as a negative regulator of skeletal muscle mass; its inhibition promotes muscle growth.

mthfd2.en: MTHFD2 (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase 2) is the mitochondrial bifunctional enzyme of one-carbon metabolism that generates NADPH; deacetylated by SIRT3 and linked to tumor redox balance, chemoresistance, and metabolic plasticity.

pnmt.en: Phenylethanolamine N-methyltransferase, the final enzyme of catecholamine biosynthesis, which methylates norepinephrine to epinephrine using SAM as the methyl donor.

mcpip1.en: An RNase (monocyte chemoattractant protein-induced protein 1) that alleviates inflammatory responses by promoting SIRT1 expression through modulation of miR-9, creating an anti-inflammatory circuit that suppresses NF-κB-driven inflammation.

samd.en: Senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction, a programmed metabolic derangement that actively drives the senescent phenotype.

immunoglobulin_g.en: Immunoglobulin G (IgG) is the most common type of antibody found in blood circulation.

mpc.en: Mitochondrial pyruvate carrier, a heterodimeric complex of MPC1 and MPC2 in the inner mitochondrial membrane that imports pyruvate into the matrix for the TCA cycle. Upregulated in cellular senescence; its inhibition suppresses the SASP without affecting cell cycle arrest.

trisomy.en: Trisomy is a type of Aneuploidy in which a specific chromosome is present in three copies instead of the normal two, usually arising from meiotic nondisjunction.
