flavone.en: The parent scaffold of flavonoids such as apigenin (4',5,7-trihydroxyflavone); the chemical class to which the senomorphic apigenin belongs.

sephs2.en: SEPHS2 (selenophosphate synthetase 2) generates monoselenophosphate from selenide and ATP, providing the activated selenium donor used by SepSecS to make selenocysteine.

yy1.en: YY1 is a ubiquitously expressed GLI-Kruppel zinc finger transcription factor that acts as both an activator and a repressor. Its four C-terminal C2H2 zinc fingers and acidic/glycine-rich N-terminal region make it a structural regulator of enhancer-promoter looping and a component of the INO80 chromatin remodelling complex.

cross_linking.en: Protein cross-linking is the covalent bridging of adjacent protein molecules — accelerated by glycation and Advanced Glycation End Products — that stiffens the extracellular matrix and is proposed to drive aging and diabetic complications.

parg53.en: PARG53 is a catalytically active ~53-kDa splice isoform of PARG (exon 1–8); its existence revises the PARG55/60 annotation and helps explain discrepancies between PARG knockout and PARG inhibitor experiments in parthanatos.

hemostatics.en: Hemostatics (or haemostatics) are substances or agents that stop bleeding

wi_38.en: A diploid human fetal lung fibroblast cell line derived by Leonard Hayflick in 1962, widely used as a model for replicative senescence and aging research; the cell line in which the ACase-ferroptosis connection was discovered.

dhps.en: Deoxyhypusine synthase, the NAD-dependent enzyme that performs the first step of hypusine biosynthesis, transferring the 4-aminobutyl moiety of spermidine to a specific lysine (Lys50) on eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5A to form deoxyhypusine. Biallelic loss-of-function variants cause a neurodevelopmental disorder with seizures and hypotonia.

foxm1.en: Forkhead box protein M1 (FoxM1) is a proliferation-associated transcription factor that drives cell-cycle genes, DNA repair, and senescence bypass; it is frequently overexpressed in cancer and is regulated by sirtuins.

dauer_larva.en: An alternative, non-feeding, stress-resistant third-stage larval state of Caenorhabditis elegans entered when conditions are poor. Dauer entry is a rich and reversible state with a thickened cuticle, arrested development and altered metabolism, made possible by the skin and the ability to store and re-use internal energy.

tocotrienols.en: Tocotrienols are the four unsaturated forms of vitamin E (alpha, beta, gamma, delta) carrying an isoprenoid tail with three double bonds; chain-breaking antioxidants with distinct anti-inflammatory, anticancer, and hypocholesterolemic properties.

ca2_overload.en: Cytosolic Ca2+ overload is the calcium-flooded intermediate linking ATP collapse to calpain and mPTP execution in necrosis.

cardiac_function.en: Cardiac function describes the pumping performance of the heart, which is preserved by NAD+ precursor supplementation in heart failure and dilated cardiomyopathy models through maintained NAD+ homeostasis.

glutamate_gated_cl_channels.en: Glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls) are the primary target of Ivermectin and other avermectins in invertebrates. They are not present in vertebrates, which contributes to the safety profile of these drugs in humans.

magnetic_resonance_imaging.en: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a non-invasive imaging technology that produces three dimensional detailed anatomical images. Neuromelanin-sensitive MRI is used to visualize the Substantia Nigra and Locus Coeruleus.

slc7a11.en: SLC7A11 (xCT) is the catalytic light chain of the system Xc- cystine/glutamate antiporter and a key determinant of ferroptosis susceptibility.

sth.en: Soil-transmitted helminths (STH) are the intestinal nematodes Ascaris lumbricoides, Trichuris trichiura, and the hookworms Ancylostoma duodenale and Necator americanus; with roughly 1.5 billion people infected they are among the most prevalent neglected tropical diseases worldwide.

gabpbeta1.en: GA-binding protein subunit beta-1 (GABPβ1) is the DNA-binding beta subunit of the GABP (GA-binding protein) ETS transcription factor complex that drives expression of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes.

indoline_5_6_dione.en: Indoline-5,6-dione is the chemical structure corresponding to Adrenochrome.
